prs.title: feat(hooks): add FileChanged notifications for local sessions
prs.body:
Latest verification / 最新验证: [author report / 作者报告](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13969#issuecomment-6253488649).

## What this PR does

Adds `FileChanged` notifications for local, non-managed sessions. Hooks can register literal cwd filenames or absolute files and recursive directories through successful synchronous `SessionStart` and `FileChanged` output. Notifications identify the listening session, absolute path and `add`, `change` or `unlink`, including changes made by external processes.

Subscriptions follow session rotation, skill hook registration/removal and cwd changes. Static registrations exclude regex fragments and directories. Initially absent siblings and deeply missing roots are discovered through surviving ancestors, deleted/recreated roots recover, retained queued events survive reconfiguration, and watcher errors permit registration retries. Recursive discovery skips implicit `.git` and `node_modules` subtrees while honoring explicit paths inside them; ordinary recursion has no depth limit. Linked English/Chinese design and user documentation explain the same behavior.

ACP bootstrap and MCP reconnect temporary configs do not start host subscriptions. Managed execution engines, remote environments and shell sandbox workers remain excluded. Late reload or skill registration after rotation rebinds the current owner; ended sessions and stale results remain disarmed.

CI repairs preserve behavior assertions, bundle-size limits and main's complete Java fault gates. Test-local idle observations wait for actual asynchronous settlement. Reference archives are verified in fresh extraction directories, and persistent runners use their existing local Maven seed without a redundant remote cache upload; fresh hosted release builds retain remote Maven caching.

## Why it's needed

Memory integrations need notifications from editors, shells and other writers, including directories outside cwd and multiple accessible workspaces. This provides a general filesystem event. Integrators register actual directories and route by absolute path; initial reconciliation and offline synchronization remain their responsibility.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Configure `.env|.envrc` while both files are absent. Create either first, atomically replace one and delete it; expect corresponding notifications. Unrelated cwd subdirectories stay silent.
- Register absolute files or a directory outside cwd. Future nested additions, changes and deletions, initially missing siblings and deeply missing roots must notify. Delete a root for 200ms and recreate it; later additions and changes must still arrive. Replacing or clearing dynamic paths retains static registrations.
- Register a repository root: implicit `.git` and `node_modules` changes stay silent, ordinary nested files notify. Explicitly register a path inside an excluded subtree to observe that path; unrelated siblings stay silent.
- Change cwd: static registrations move, old static paths stop notifying and explicit dynamic roots remain active. Reconfigure during a running hook: retained queued events continue, removed-root events are dropped. Watcher errors permit retries; shutdown cancels intake and pending registration.
- Rotate without SessionStart, then reload or register a skill; expect current-session notifications. ACP bootstrap, MCP reconnect, managed, remote and sandbox configs must not observe the host.

### Evidence (Before & After)

R19 (`5397c24`): no new CR repair. Java failed waiting for the host lock; Serve initialization timed out and is not reproduced locally. CI remains red; [details](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13969#issuecomment-6253488649).

R18 verified commit `5397c241b1d8ae13748d9f40906482bc60b92b05` merges main `2cba716faf2b8ca807e3d89ab82e605c5247e1a8` to resolve one Hosted test file’s three wait-option conflicts, keeping the existing 5000ms observations, retaining both upstream changes and the existing FileChanged fixes. Build/bundle/typecheck pass; CLI1,245, three conflict cases (590 filtered), Core934, workflow448/10conditional skips and archive10 pass. Four-class Java verify has144pass, Checkstyle0/0 and SpotBugs0. The interrupted full Hosted run is excluded. The preceding `24287a0c` completed its executed product checks; its complete CI census was 27 successful, thirteen skipped and one automatic review queued. Web Smoke was 285 passed plus one flaky case (first-attempt 10s SSE wait timeout, retry one passed); these results belong to that preceding head. No new mandatory CR repair; prior individual deferrals remain recorded and formal CHANGES_REQUESTED awaits reviewer reassessment. New-head CI at 04:31:54 UTC /12:31:54 Shanghai:12 runs/29 checks/jobs,6 success/8 skipped/9 running/6 queued,0 failed. Selector used synthetic4cae (tree2f75), distinct from tested head; its Hosted test file differs but keeps all three5000ms observations/assertions. Downstream checkout SHAs are unverified.

Preceding R16 commit `24287a0c26909988f9e8eecc93f43dfd53735659` repairs only thirteen lines of leading indentation in one Runtime Broker callback. Java tokens, line count, runtime logic, tests, POM, Checkstyle rules and workflow gates remain unchanged. The preceding c8f run completed its SDK suite (391 tests, nine skipped) and Managed suite (4,656 tests, 21 skipped), both with zero failures/errors, then failed twelve indentation checks; the second red check only propagates that failure. Its actual synthetic checkout tree equals c8f. Complete census: 26 runs / 97 checks / 97 jobs, 31 successful / 63 skipped / two failed / one superseded automation cancellation; the PR rollup separately omits eleven skipped automation checks. Ubuntu Unit and the original 49-case budget file passed; Web Smoke completed 286 passing cases without a flaky/failed summary. These are preceding-head results, not acceptance borrowed for the new head. Local execution of the original Checkstyle goals reproduces exit 1 with twelve violations, then exits 0 with both checks clean after the repair; the same 104 Broker Java files are checked. The three affected test classes pass all 266 cases. Full Managed Agent `mvn verify` also exits 0: 4,656 total, 4,638 passed, eighteen skipped, zero failures/errors/flaky results; it includes those 266 cases. Both Checkstyle checks and SpotBugs report zero findings/errors. Root build, bundle and all workspace/integration typechecks exit 0. Verification uses portable Temurin 21.0.12.1+1 on macOS ARM64 and Maven 3.9.11; CI uses 21.0.12-101 on Linux x64, so platform coverage differs. Heavy fault/MySQL, real SSH and optional real-worker bundle gates are not claimed by this default local run. Post-build comparison confirms Core/CLI production JavaScript differs only in generated commit metadata; a compiled test and build metadata also differ, while fifteen internal dependency output trees are byte-identical. No relevant production logic changed, so no redundant Maven run was added.

The fresh review confirms R5-1 fixed and the review bot has resolved that thread. It introduces no new mandatory repair; its sixteen explicitly nonblocking topics and ten repeated Suggestions retain individual dispositions in the appended author report. The two Critical contract topics remain separately documented and await reviewer reassessment; no thread is resolved or approval submitted by this author. New-head census at 2026-10-19 02:02:29 UTC /10:02:29 Asia/Shanghai covers all twelve runs and 39 checks/jobs: 24 successful, thirteen skipped, one running and one queued, with no failure, timeout, action-required or cancellation. Java 21 and the Managed fast summary pass; both original Checkstyle goals now report zero violations. Remote SDK has 391 tests/nine skips and Managed has 4,657 tests/21 skips, both zero failures/errors; Java 11 daemon passes four cases. Serve A/B reports zero changed fields; Visual passes 81 PR and 77 base cases, with one comparator image at 0.02% difference. Unit still runs, automatic review is queued and Web Smoke has not started. JS profile is full; Java tier is fast with five heavy lanes skipped. Java actually tested synthetic commit `ba28961cf20be4862aeb4288166e48192616f508` (main `402e9590` plus this head), tree `2baf0d1c`, which differs from head tree `bf8a6cb3`; the fixed Java file blob is identical. Unit actually checks out this head. The PR is MERGEABLE/BLOCKED and formal CHANGES_REQUESTED remains; no all-CI-green claim is made.

Preceding R14 commit `c8f7f1fc73f68e5af43f787f24adc85251632548` merges main `ebb2ef7e9e51b9510196e01d6ff7c4c1106024b2`. The 111 incoming paths are 107 exact-main blobs and four combinations preserving existing FileChanged changes alongside main. The two conflicting linked design tables now use main in full; the preceding PR divergence was padding only. Independent whole-file/inverse/AST checks preserve main's complete current assertions, the ACP watcher opt-out, Config/session ownership and three previous five-second observations. Main itself replaces some older Hosted assertions; those upstream changes are not described as literal preservation of every older assertion. The seven additional authored paths are the narrow repairs and bilingual clarification below.

Latest CR at the preceding exact head has 70 threads / 91 inline comments / 27 reviews / eight issue comments: three new threads, four new inline comments and two new reviews. ## Risk & Scope

- Notifications are best effort: events can be coalesced, duplicated or missed during downtime and reconfiguration. Handlers must avoid self-trigger loops.
- Remote/hosted event producers, durable synchronization, symlink traversal and memory toggles are outside scope. Discovery may enumerate the nearest existing ancestor; remaining scan-cost and queue-policy suggestions are recorded in the PR thread.
- Dynamic registrations use the last valid explicit list and reset with session ownership. Explicitly registering an excluded subtree intentionally observes that declared scope.

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): Safely settle recovery and continue sessions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Keeps a possibly submitted Managed Workspace Turn under its original recovery/cancellation driver until durable native settlement, continuation readiness and blocking cleanup prove that the same Session can accept another message. Adds a conservative five-state recovery view, read-only queries and original-Turn rechecks, with synchronized public/WebShell contracts and Java SDK support. The current rebase preserves main's durable manual context compression routes, Session projections and independent send gate alongside recovery; the public API contract advances to 1.82.0. A subsequent rebase incorporates the current lint gate and removes a duplicate test import inherited from main so the combined tree compiles.

WebShell displays the recovery reason and valid actions, gates sending on recovery evidence, preserves the original cancellation key/operation across refreshes, and offers an editable text handoff of at most 32 KiB UTF-8 through the existing new-Session form. Handoff preparation never creates or sends a Session automatically.

## Why it's needed

After some post-admission failures, Java previously marked a Turn terminal when cancellation was only acknowledged, while the Harness input could still be running. The UI then treated the missing active Java Turn as permission to send again. Delayed Session-scoped cancellation could also affect the following Turn. Recovery now retains the original identity, replays the real terminal and confirmed output, and keeps unproven outcomes blocked with a usable fallback.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Fail recovery after native admission while the original tool is held. Confirm that cancellation ACK/HTTP 202 does not end the Java recovery driver or enable sending; rechecks retain the original Turn, retry budget and execution identity.
2. Let the original input settle, including a coordinator restart between cancellation admission and terminal delivery. Confirm that real output/terminal are projected, cleanup debt remains visible, the tool executes once and the same Session can complete a later Turn. Replay the original cancellation while that later Turn is active and confirm it still completes.
3. Exercise stale owner/generation, old Harness capabilities, corrupt or unreadable evidence, and cold cleanup after a Harness restart. Confirm conservative blocking, no model/tool resubmission, no ordinary-load fallback and no release of a newer owner's resources. A proven pristine initial state must still permit legitimate first-message admission.
4. Refresh during cancellation and check that the original key/operation remains tracked until terminal confirmation. Open the new-Session fallback and confirm authorized source Workspace/cwd/Agent defaults, editable bounded quoted text, exclusion of partial/tool/approval/execution content and no automatic create/send. Existing Workspace admission must still apply.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: four assertions against exact main `21337f0e5131` reproduced premature Java termination after cancellation admission; the baseline UI used Java activity alone and generated a new cancellation key for each action. A real-process negative control also showed an old delayed cancellation stopping the following Turn.

After: three real Chromium cases verify evidence-gated sending, reload-safe original cancellation tracking and editable authorized handoff without automatic execution, using a controlled HTTP adapter. The real Java/Harness/Broker/worker fault test retains the original tool exactly once, projects the original native terminal and completes the same Session's following Turn with `FOLLOW_UP_OK` despite replaying the original cancellation while that Turn is active. Browser evidence establishes UI behavior; deterministic model responses establish the exercised execution protocol, not live-model quality.

Current-candidate verification: root build/bundle/typecheck passed; the corrected core test file passed all 606 tests; WebShell passed 552 tests and Chromium passed seven cases without skips or retries (three recovery, two context compression and two SSH registration). The complete CLI suite passed all six files / 768 tests without skips. The full Hosted profile verify passed again with the newly built bundle: two methods, all nine actual fault windows, zero failures/errors/skips, and clean Checkstyle/SpotBugs. It confirms one original tool execution, a completed following Turn and an ignored delayed original cancellation. All eight latest-main lint-gate commits are incorporated; the freshness helper's nine tests pass. Source-tree and integration ESLint, Prettier and diff whitespace checks passed. The first bare local ESLint invocation encountered only 953 diagnostics in 22 untracked Maven target outputs; that failure is preserved. Its source-only rerun excludes `**/target/**`, which excludes no tracked file, and changes no repository lint configuration.

Java results are reused from `9046a3ac8eec` after independently matching all 1,222 tracked Java/POM inputs, 122 dependency JARs and 2,127 compiled outputs: SDK 406 tests with nine conditional skips; complete unit/H2 5,306 tests with 18 conditional skips and zero failures/errors; complete MySQL 8.4 rerun 54 classes / 1,075 tests without failures, errors or skips; and static `mvn verify -DskipTests` with Checkstyle and SpotBugs clean. These are identical-input results, not a second unit/MySQL run. The initial clean verify remains recorded as failed: a 32 MiB + 1 byte fixture exceeded the task server's 64 MiB packet budget before the assertion, while CI requires 128 MiB. Aligning only that isolated fixture made the original method and complete unchanged MySQL roster pass. The static command did not rerun unit tests, and the direct Failsafe retry makes no new coverage claim.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS; Node 24.12.0; JDK 21.0.8; Maven 3.9.14; disposable native MySQL 8.4.11 with performance_schema and CI's 128 MiB packet budget, using an isolated V16 catalog and task-only runtime paths. Current candidate is `2e6eb32d459b`, based on `257b9f5413ca`. Its 62 recovery feature files are byte-identical to the fully checked `9046a3ac8eec`; the additional test-only commit deletes one duplicate import from main. A freshly built CLI bundle exercises the newly incorporated core changes, while the identical Java inputs justify the explicitly recorded reuse above. SDK verification skips local GPG signing. Only task-owned MySQL and Hosted descendants were stopped after verification; offline data and all reports were preserved, and other deployments/processes were left alone. Subsequent main/CI state is recorded separately from local evidence.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: false-positive readiness, losing cancellation-only intent across a crash, or stale-identity cancellation/cleanup. Missing proof remains blocked; negotiated original-prompt targeting and cleanup-only loading avoid silently falling back to Session-wide execution.
- Not validated / out of scope: Linux physical-Workspace/cgroup acceptance, Windows, optional remote SSH/Kubernetes rigs, cross-host HA, full history cloning, permanent journal repair, MCP/Hooks automatic continuation and signed release artifacts. macOS results do not establish Linux physical-Workspace/cgroup acceptance.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no database migration, new recovery operation kind or lifecycle status. Recovery fields are optional; older Harness versions without affirmative proof/capabilities remain conservative.

Complete synchronized designs: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/2e6eb32d459b806f5e87380bbb70bc9d85cba076/docs/design/2026-10-22-managed-recovery-continuation.md) and [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/2e6eb32d459b806f5e87380bbb70bc9d85cba076/docs/design/2026-10-22-managed-recovery-continuation.zh-CN.md). E2E plans: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/2e6eb32d459b806f5e87380bbb70bc9d85cba076/docs/plans/2026-10-22-managed-recovery-continuation-e2e.md) and [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/2e6eb32d459b806f5e87380bbb70bc9d85cba076/docs/plans/2026-10-22-managed-recovery-continuation-e2e.zh-CN.md).

## 本 PR 的作用

对于已可能提交的 Managed Workspace Turn，持续保留原恢复／取消驱动，直到持久原生终态、continuation 就绪和阻挡性清理共同证明同一 Session 可以接收下一条消息。增加保守的五态恢复视图、只读查询和针对原 Turn 的复查，同步公开接口、WebShell 契约与 Java SDK 支持。本次 rebase 同时保留主干持久手动上下文压缩的路由、Session 投影与独立发送门禁；公开 API 契约升级到 1.82.0。后续 rebase 同步当前 lint 门禁，并删除主干带入的一处重复测试导入，使组合代码正常编译。

WebShell 展示恢复原因和有效操作，依据恢复证据控制发送，跨刷新保留原取消 key／operation，并通过现有新 Session 表单提供最多 32 KiB UTF-8 的可编辑文字交接。准备交接不会自动创建或发送 Session。

## 为什么需要

部分已可能提交后的失败此前会在取消仅被确认受理时，就让 Java 将 Turn 写成终态，而 Harness 输入仍可能运行。界面随后将没有活跃 Java Turn 解释为可以继续发送。延迟的 Session 级取消还可能影响下一轮。现在恢复流程保留原身份，投影真实终态及已确认正文，并让无法证明安全的结果保持受阻，同时提供可用退路。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 原生输入已受理且原工具仍被阻挡时触发恢复失败。确认取消 ACK／HTTP 202 不会结束 Java 恢复驱动或开放发送；复查保留原 Turn、重试预算和执行身份。
2. 让原输入结清，包括在取消受理到终态投递之间重启协调器。确认真实正文／终态得到投影、清理欠账仍可见、工具只执行一次，且同一 Session 可完成后续一轮。后续一轮活跃时重放原取消，确认它仍能完成。
3. 覆盖旧 owner／generation、旧 Harness 能力、损坏或不可读的证据，以及 Harness 重启后的冷态清理。确认保守受阻、不重新提交模型／工具、不回退到普通加载、不释放更新 owner 的资源。可证明的原始初始状态仍应允许合法首条消息准入。
4. 取消过程中刷新，确认持续跟踪原 key／operation，直到终态得到确认。打开新 Session 退路，确认预选仍有权限的源 Workspace／cwd／Agent、文字为可编辑且受限的引用内容、排除部分输出／工具／审批／执行内容，并且不自动创建或发送。现有 Workspace 准入仍须生效。

### 证据（修改前后）

修改前：针对准确主干 `21337f0e5131` 的四项断言复现了取消受理后 Java 提前结束；基线界面仅依据 Java 活跃状态判断发送，每次操作生成新的取消 key。真实进程负向对照还证明，旧的延迟取消会停止后续一轮。

修改后：三项真实 Chromium 场景通过受控 HTTP adapter 验证证据控制发送、刷新后跟踪原取消，以及具有授权默认值、可编辑且不自动执行的交接。真实 Java／Harness／Broker／worker 故障测试确认原工具仅执行一次、原生终态得到投影，并在后续一轮活跃时重放原取消后，仍使同一 Session 的该轮完成并输出 `FOLLOW_UP_OK`。浏览器证据证明界面行为；确定性模型响应证明所覆盖的执行协议，不证明真实模型质量。

当前候选验证：根目录 build／bundle／typecheck 已通过；修正后的 core 测试文件 606 项全部通过；WebShell 552 项测试与 Chromium 7 项场景通过，均无跳过或重试（恢复 3 项、上下文压缩 2 项、SSH 注册 2 项）。完整 CLI 组 6 个文件／768 项测试通过，无跳过。使用新构建 bundle 的完整 Hosted profile verify 再次通过：两个方法、九个实际故障窗口，零失败／错误／跳过，Checkstyle／SpotBugs 零问题；确认原工具仅执行一次、后续 Turn 完成、延迟原取消被忽略。已包含最新主干全部 8 个 lint 门禁提交，门禁脚本 9 项测试通过。源码树及 integration ESLint、Prettier 和 diff 空白检查通过。首次本地全树 ESLint 仅在 22 个未跟踪的 Maven target 输出中报 953 条诊断，原失败保留；源码复核只排除 `**/target/**`，不排除任何跟踪文件，也未修改仓库 lint 配置。

独立核对全部 1,222 个跟踪 Java／POM 输入、122 个依赖 JAR 与 2,127 个编译输出完全一致后，复用 `9046a3ac8eec` 的 Java 结果：SDK 406 项测试，其中 9 项条件性跳过；完整单测／H2 5,306 项，其中 18 项条件性跳过，无失败或错误；完整 MySQL 8.4 重跑 54 个类／1,075 项，无失败、错误或跳过；静态 `mvn verify -DskipTests` 的 Checkstyle 和 SpotBugs 为零问题。这些是输入完全一致的结果，没有另跑一轮单测／MySQL。首次 clean verify 仍保留为失败：32 MiB 加 1 字节 fixture 在断言前超过任务服务器 64 MiB packet 配额，而 CI 要求 128 MiB。仅对齐隔离 fixture 后，原方法与完整未变的 MySQL 清单通过。静态命令没有重跑单测，直接 Failsafe 重跑不声明新增覆盖率证据。

### 已测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 已测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未测试 |

### 环境

macOS；Node 24.12.0；JDK 21.0.8；Maven 3.9.14；开启 performance_schema、配置与 CI 一致的 128 MiB packet 配额的一次性原生 MySQL 8.4.11，使用隔离 V16 catalog 与任务自有运行目录。当前候选为 `2e6eb32d459b`，基于 `257b9f5413ca`。其 62 个恢复功能文件与已完整检查的 `9046a3ac8eec` 逐字节一致；额外的纯测试提交删除主干的一行重复导入。重新构建的 CLI bundle 覆盖新合入的 core 变化，而完全一致的 Java 输入支撑上述明确标注的结果复用。SDK 验证跳过本地 GPG 签名。验证后仅停止任务自有 MySQL 与 Hosted 后代，保留离线数据和全部报告，其他部署／进程未受影响。后续主干／CI 状态与本地证据分开记录。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：误判 ready、崩溃丢失仅用于取消善后的意图，或者旧身份取消／清理。缺少证明时继续受阻；协商后的原 prompt 定向取消与仅清理加载避免静默回退到 Session 级执行。
- 未验证／范围之外：Linux 物理 Workspace／cgroup 验收、Windows、可选远程 SSH／Kubernetes 环境、跨主机 HA、完整历史克隆、永久 journal 修复、MCP／Hooks 自动续跑及带签名发布产物。macOS 结果不能作为 Linux 物理 Workspace／cgroup 验收证据。
- 破坏性变更／迁移说明：不增加数据库迁移、恢复 operation 种类或生命周期状态。恢复字段为可选；旧 Harness 缺少明确证明／能力时保持保守。

完整同步的设计：[英文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/2e6eb32d459b806f5e87380bbb70bc9d85cba076/docs/design/2026-10-22-managed-recovery-continuation.md)和[简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/2e6eb32d459b806f5e87380bbb70bc9d85cba076/docs/design/2026-10-22-managed-recovery-continuation.zh-CN.md)。E2E 计划：[英文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/2e6eb32d459b806f5e87380bbb70bc9d85cba076/docs/plans/2026-10-22-managed-recovery-continuation-e2e.md)和[简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/2e6eb32d459b806f5e87380bbb70bc9d85cba076/docs/plans/2026-10-22-managed-recovery-continuation-e2e.zh-CN.md)。

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): Add session lifecycle UI and reading exports
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Managed Web Shell exposes close, close-and-archive, archive, restore and delete through shared row/detail menus and ordinary/archived history views. Closed conversations remain readable and cannot accept another turn. Per-session operation identity and composite stages survive refreshes and selection changes; the browser confirms asynchronous completion and offers explicit stop/retry controls without stopping tasks automatically. HTML and Markdown exports collect one immutable public snapshot after it covers the captured watermark, enforce a 32 MiB budget and preserve messages, public reasoning, tool labels/published previews and attachments. Missing tool arguments or previews are explicitly marked. HTML remains readable offline without running conversation HTML/scripts or loading remote resources. The English/Chinese export menus state that Markdown preserves original HTML/remote image references and requires an external viewer blocking scripts and remote requests, while HTML provides the offline reading guarantee.

## Why it's needed

Java already owns durable lifecycle operations and public history snapshots, but Managed users could not manage retained sessions or download their conversation history from the browser. This connects those mechanisms while retaining server authority over permissions, active turns and recovery, and preserving shared Workspace files.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. As a creator, finish or explicitly stop an isolated turn, close its session and confirm the selected history becomes read only. Archive it, find it under archived history, restore it and confirm it stays closed. Close-and-archive must finish close before submitting archive. Deleting the selected session opens a draft in the same Workspace; shared files and other sessions remain. Acting on another row preserves the current selection.
2. Check English/Chinese menus, search and Workspace grouping at desktop and narrow widths, including multiple history pages. A readable non-creator can export without lifecycle commands. Revoked permissions and unsupported execution profiles retain server admission. A mixed page must not give an unsupported custom-agent row the approval-change capability from another row; its eligible lifecycle actions stay available.
3. Lose lifecycle responses, refresh and switch sessions. Unknown outcomes reuse the original key; explicit Retry after failure creates a new key. In particular, after close succeeds and archive is definitively refused without an operation ID, two refreshes must issue no new archive POST. Retry submits only archive with a new key. Admitted failures query their original operation; recovery-blocked operations remain observable.
4. Export active, closed and archived history in both formats. Include all pages and the final captured turn, mixed reasoning/answer content parts, a reasoning-only message, actual public tool labels/previews, attachments, Unicode, code and truncated output. Missing arguments/previews must be labelled, with no mutable tool-details/private-journal backfill. New messages cannot change a fixed snapshot. Expired/inconsistent cursors, preparation beyond 30 seconds and over-budget output fail without a partial download. Offline HTML has inert script text, safe inline images and no remote fetches; Markdown preserves transcript source for the reader's renderer. Before selection, both row/detail menus must visibly describe the HTML/Markdown safety boundary in English and Chinese at desktop/narrow widths.
5. In an embedding host with a delegated document link router, both export downloads must leave the host URL/state intact. Check built-library compatibility with matching React/ReactDOM 18 and 19 hosts. Identical global/detail errors produce one accessible alert, while distinct errors remain visible.

Review-fix validation at `17c35735371bd01717d32a1616c63c8ab045a832`: root build, typecheck and bundle passed, as did focused ESLint/Prettier and the OpenAPI version gate. Nine frontend files passed 359 tests; four Chromium smoke files passed ten desktop/narrow scenarios without retries. JDK 21 targeted checks passed 403 tests with zero failures/errors and one profile-dependent skip. Full clean Maven verification passed 5,193 tests with zero failures/errors and 18 conditional skips; both Checkstyle gates and SpotBugs were clean. All 62 distinct real-MySQL cases passed: 54 profile integrations, four explicit paging tests and four snapshot/registration lock cases, with zero failures/errors/skips. Full builds completed before Maven; no CLI/core build ran concurrently with Java verification.

All five review defects were independently reproduced before the fixes, then verified with the same actual Chromium/Java-service probes. The primary server JAR built at that review-fix commit passed 25 real-backend checks (ten English lifecycle/export, five Chinese narrow-screen and ten immutable-snapshot checks), with zero page errors; old sequence-9 cursors excluded a new turn that advanced the session to 13, and fresh closed/archived downloads included the latest turn. The real backend browser lane uses the text-only profile and a deterministic OpenAI-compatible HTTP model with production Java/Hosted Harness and a private MySQL database; controlled response-loss/tool-shape/host-router probes are recorded separately. Historical React 18.3.1/19.2.4 built-library import/download acceptance remains separate from the review-fix verification. The prior channel-fixture correction remains unchanged; its repeated observer established H2 binary-key binding stability, not a new proof of atomic UPDATE guards.

Merge-integration commit `ce037842cefdef6756c675db8333f7a868fefa03` incorporates main `8a9ae631a3f396f76e166c341a896e300d843e4c` through a normal merge, preserving existing review references and satisfying the unchanged lint freshness helper. A frozen-lockfile install and full root build/bundle passed on the identical source tree; Core/CLI metadata were then rebuilt and bundled at this head. Checks at that merge head passed full root lint and typecheck, all 359 frontend tests, all ten Chromium smoke scenarios without retries, and JDK 21 Maven verification of 436 affected/native-CLI tests with zero failures/errors and one conditional skip; both Checkstyle gates and SpotBugs were clean. At that merge commit, all 37 PR file blobs and the entire Java module were identical to the review-fix commit above. The earlier full 5,193-test Java run, 62 MySQL cases and 25 real-backend browser checks are retained as separate evidence at that earlier head; they were not rerun at this merge head. Remote CI is reported separately from local verification.

Latest disclosure-fix validation at `9aedff6b957a622ea65fdd53db88ed8885dfeb49`: full root build, bundle and typecheck passed, as did focused ESLint/Prettier and all 194 related frontend tests across six files. Independent Chromium acceptance passed 12 scenarios with 22 actual downloads and zero page errors: English/Chinese source row/detail menus at 1280/390 px, built-library row menus at the same four combinations, keyboard download, exporting-state disable/restore and a provider without export support. All descriptions fit without clipping. Markdown matches the original source export apart from the export timestamp; all downloaded HTML files opened offline with zero script execution and zero remote requests, while host URL/state stayed intact. These browser checks use controlled public transport and do not claim a new live Java/backend run. Java, SQL and the export serializer are unchanged; earlier Java/MySQL/backend results retain their original commit provenance.

Current integration validation at `6cc40c21e2f7a7a178e85b0cc82761a12f04b248`: a normal merge incorporates main `257b9f5413ca2606092cfd5bc58cae77271b0534`; the only additional Core change against main deletes one duplicate test import of the same re-exported history helper. The prior synthetic merge could not compile because main imported that binding twice, so its TUI and SDK Java jobs failed before behavior tests. Frozen-lockfile install, full root build/bundle/typecheck, 1,830 Core tests across eight files and 125 frontend/export/artifact tests across four files now pass. JDK 21 Maven verification passes 549 affected/native-CLI/connector cases with zero failures/errors and one conditional skip; both Checkstyle gates and SpotBugs are clean. Build completed before Maven. Both clean audit passes and independent source/compiler observers confirm the minimal correction. All 37 feature file blobs and the complete Java module are identical to `9aedff6b`; earlier full Java/MySQL/browser runs are retained at their original heads and were not rerun here. Fresh remote CI is tracked separately.

Published head `d2b3fb1bc819c842f4eee349f55b86af7c2eeb16` also preserves the concurrent remote main-sync merge `5d5fa2a687c8efd0fc29dac6f0803086ff65f85f` through a normal merge. Its complete Git tree is identical to verified commit `6cc40c21`; Core/CLI commit metadata and the bundle were refreshed at the published head. This preserves the remote work without a force push, and does not relabel the preceding test runs as reruns at a different commit.

### Evidence (Before & After)

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| Chromium at 1280/390 px showed mixed ordinary/archived history, no lifecycle menu and list requests without an archive filter. | Ordinary/archived views explicitly request their matching filter; row/detail menus expose permitted actions and closed history visibly stays read only. |
| Managed users had no history download. | Real Java/Hosted Harness sessions download both formats including the final captured turn from closed/archived history; an old snapshot stays at sequence 9 while later output advances the session to 13. Offline HTML has no scripts or remote requests. |
| A refused archive after successful close was automatically POSTed again on each refresh. | Refresh restores the failed archive and waits for Retry; explicit Retry persists a new archive key without repeating close. |
| Tool fixtures claimed nonexistent public arguments; exported reasoning lost its distinction, and an embedding host could swallow the download and navigate away. | Actual tool wire shapes show explicit omission markers and published previews; public reasoning/answer text stays labelled and ordered; a host link router receives no synthetic download click. |
| Both export menu entries showed only a format name. | English/Chinese row/detail menus describe offline HTML and original Markdown source before selection; the Markdown description directs readers to block scripts and remote requests. |
| A mixed page advertised approval changes for an unsupported row although singular lookup denied them. | Per-row profile eligibility agrees with singular lookup, while independent lifecycle ownership stays intact. |

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS ARM64, Node.js 24.19.0, JDK 21.0.8, Maven 3.9.14, disposable MySQL 8.4.11 and headless Chromium. All work used an isolated checkout and exclusively owned service ports/databases. All owned browser/backend/Harness/model services and the disposable MySQL instance were stopped, with their listeners verified closed; user services/databases were not used.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: operation recovery and snapshot collection span asynchronous browser/server state. Frozen keys, server operation identities, filter-bound cursors and watermark validation keep unknown outcomes from being treated as success. Public snapshots omit tool arguments and some result previews, so exports identify those gaps; full Artifacts remain separately authorized downloads. Markdown is source for an external renderer; the script-free/offline rendering guarantee applies to HTML.
- Not validated / out of scope: native Workspace/tool browser execution, Windows/Linux local runs, opt-in SSH/Kubernetes workers, reopening/import, bulk actions, Workspace deletion and database migrations. English read-only header text remains crowded at 390 px although menus/actions are usable; noncritical copy/focus/performance and extra coverage suggestions are recorded in review threads and deferred in the critical-only round.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no database migration. Omitting `archiveState` retains the existing `all` list behavior; optional provider APIs preserve other providers. Lifecycle actions retain shared Workspace files. Upstream manual-context-compression contracts and behavior are preserved; the merged API contract is 1.82.0 above main's 1.81.0.

Complete synchronized designs: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/d2b3fb1bc819c842f4eee349f55b86af7c2eeb16/docs/design/2026-10-22-managed-session-lifecycle-ui.md) and [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/d2b3fb1bc819c842f4eee349f55b86af7c2eeb16/docs/design/2026-10-22-managed-session-lifecycle-ui.zh-CN.md).

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 做了什么

Managed Web Shell 通过行/详情共享菜单和普通/归档历史视图提供关闭、关闭并归档、归档、恢复归档和删除。关闭后仍可阅读，不能提交下一轮。按会话保存的操作身份及组合阶段跨刷新和切换恢复；浏览器确认异步完成，提供显式停止/重试入口，不自动停止任务。HTML 和 Markdown 导出在覆盖捕获水位后收集单份不可变公开快照，执行 32 MiB 预算，保留消息、公开思考、工具标签/已发布预览及附件。缺失的工具参数或预览会明确标注。HTML 可离线阅读，不运行会话 HTML/脚本，不加载远程资源。中英文导出菜单明确说明：Markdown 保留原始 HTML/远程图片引用，需使用禁用脚本和远程请求的外部阅读器；HTML 提供离线阅读保证。

## 为什么需要

Java 已负责持久化生命周期操作和公开历史快照，但 Managed 用户无法在浏览器管理保留的会话或下载历史。本改动接通已有机制，保持服务端对权限、活动轮次及恢复的最终判断，并保留共享 Workspace 文件。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 以创建者身份完成或显式停止一个隔离轮次，关闭会话并确认仍选中的历史变为只读。归档后在已归档历史中找到它，恢复后确认仍关闭。关闭并归档必须等待关闭完成后才提交归档。删除当前会话进入同一 Workspace 的草稿；共享文件及其他会话保持。操作其他行保留当前选择。
2. 在桌面和窄屏下检查中英文菜单、搜索及 Workspace 分组，覆盖多页历史。可读非创建者可导出但无生命周期命令；权限撤销和不支持的执行 profile 保持服务端准入。混合列表不能让不支持的 custom-agent 行继承另一行的审批切换能力，其独立满足条件的生命周期操作保持可用。
3. 丢失生命周期响应、刷新并切换会话。未知结果复用原 key；明确失败后的主动重试生成新 key。尤其是关闭成功后归档被明确拒绝且没有 operation ID 时，两次刷新均不能重新 POST 归档。重试仅以新 key 提交归档。已受理失败查询原操作；恢复阻塞操作保持可观察。
4. 从活动、关闭及归档历史导出两种格式。包含全部分页及最后一个捕获轮次、混合思考/回答内容片段、纯思考消息、真实公开工具标签/预览、附件、中文、代码及截断输出。参数/预览缺失必须标注，不能通过可变工具详情或私有 journal 补齐。新消息不能改变已固定快照。cursor 过期/不一致、准备超过 30 秒及超预算均应失败，不下载部分文件。离线 HTML 中脚本文本不执行、安全图片内嵌且无远程请求；Markdown 为阅读者的渲染器保留会话源文本。选择前，行/详情菜单必须在中英文桌面/窄屏下可见地说明 HTML/Markdown 的安全边界。
5. 嵌入宿主有 document 委托链接路由时，两种导出都应下载且不改变宿主 URL/状态。检查构建库在 React/ReactDOM 匹配的 18 和 19 宿主中的兼容性。相同全局/详情错误只产生一个可访问告警，不同错误仍可见。

prs.title: feat(ci): restore a MariaDB leg for the non-Hosted IT family
prs.body:
Depends on #14936; merge that PR first. This PR targets `main` so normal CI and the repository's ongoing closeout loop can validate and track it. Until #14936 lands, the diff also includes that dependency; it will narrow automatically after the parent merges.

## What this PR does

Adds a MariaDB leg back to the Java integration lane. The `mysql-integration` job becomes a two-leg matrix — MySQL 8.4 and MariaDB 10.11.18 — and both legs run the same non-Hosted `*IT` family, so the engine split only changes the database, not the tests. The image, its startup arguments, its client binary, and its readiness signal come from the matrix entry; the container name carries the engine so two legs on one pool host cannot collide. The MySQL leg keeps its exact current behavior, including the disabled native AIO and the skipped binlog.

This is stacked on #14936 and only makes sense on top of it, so the base branch is `fix/java-ci-mariadb-initialization` rather than `main`. Once #14936 merges, this retargets to `main` and its own diff is just the MariaDB leg.

## Why it's needed

Before #14936, `mysql-integration` ran the non-Hosted `*IT` family against a real `mariadb:10.11.18` server. #14936 replaced that service with a hand-run MySQL 8.4 container, which is the right shape for the pool, but it also removed the last real MariaDB server from CI.

MariaDB is still supported product code: the schema catalog has MariaDB-only branches, and the published V12 migration carries a repair written specifically for MariaDB's refusal of an indexed generated column that depends on a `CHAR` source (the error-1901 class). MySQL 8 trims `CHAR` on retrieval and dropped `PAD_CHAR_TO_FULL_LENGTH` in 8.0.13, so `RTRIM` in that migration has no observable effect there — a MySQL-only lane stays green even if the repair is deleted or another indexed generated column is added over a `CHAR` source. That defect class has already shipped once (`CHANGELOG.md:153`, #14618). Restoring the leg makes the repair falsifiable again.

This is route A from #14971 item 1. Items 2 and 3 of that issue are a separate, text-only change (#14995).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Run `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js` and `node --test .github/scripts/ci-runner-routing.test.mjs`.
- Read the `mysql-integration` job in `sdk-java.yml`: expect one matrix with two `include` entries, MySQL 8.4 and MariaDB 10.11.18, and both legs invoking the same `-Pmysql-integration` Maven profile.
- Confirm the startup step contains no `${{ }}` expression: the image, args, and client arrive as job env so the shell tests can execute the step verbatim. The test suite runs that step against both engines with a fake `docker`, including the readiness path each image uses (`healthcheck.sh` for MariaDB, `mysqladmin` for MySQL).
- In CI, expect two `Runtime Broker and Managed Agent … / Java 21` jobs per trusted SDK Java run, one per engine.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — CI definition and its tests; no user-visible surface.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Windows is N/A: the shell tests are skipped there, as before. The MariaDB image contents were verified by exporting `mariadb:10.11.18`: it ships `/usr/local/bin/healthcheck.sh`, the `mariadb`, `mysql` and `mysqladmin` clients, and its entrypoint accepts the legacy `MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD` alias. What is unverified is an actual server boot — the local Docker VM had no free disk space — so the first real MariaDB start happens in CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk: one extra full non-Hosted failsafe run per trusted lane, about 60 minutes of measured Maven work, and both legs contend for the same per-host `sdk-java` lock. The per-leg ceiling stays at 200 minutes, which already absorbed the 90-minute lock wait for a single leg; the first CI run is the real check on that assumption. Sizing that budget for two ~3600 s holders instead of one is tracked in #14566 (lock starvation) and #15064 (sizes this lane's ceiling); this PR records the dependency rather than re-deriving a budget it does not own.
- Not validated: no MariaDB server was started locally. The migration's MariaDB-only behavior is not re-proven here — the point of the change is that CI will prove it from now on.
- Out of scope: #14936 itself (this branch is stacked on it), the doc and comment corrections in #14995, and any change to product code.

## Linked Issues

Refs #14971 and #14936 — no closing keyword: #14971 still needs a maintainer decision recorded once both PRs land, and this branch must merge after #14936. Also refs #14566 and #15064: the shared per-host `sdk-java` lock's 5400 s acquisition budget is derived for a single ~3600 s holder, and this PR's second full-tier leg is a second holder. Both issues own that arithmetic; neither is closed or re-derived here.

Patrol-Run: qwen-pr-conflict/jmvgz448zlp

* fix(ci): skip the MySQL binlog, drop the unused database, correct the reaper bound

Three independent corrections to the mysql-integration lane this PR reworks.

1. MySQL 8 enables the binary log by default (MariaDB 10.11 did not in the
   configuration this lane replaced), and the datadir is an uncapped tmpfs.
   Nothing in packages/managed-agent-server/src or packages/sdk-java reads a
   binlog (0 hits for binlog|log_bin|GTID|SHOW MASTER STATUS), and the
   container is disposable with no replica, so `--skip-log-bin` is appended
   after the image name beside --innodb-use-native-aio=0. Without it the
   ~67 MiB hex-encoded LONGBLOB query this lane already raises
   max_allowed_packet for is serialized a second time into host RAM.

2. `--env MYSQL_DATABASE='runtime_broker_test'` had no consumer: the lane's
   only connection is -Dmysql.url=.../managed_agent_test?createDatabaseIfNotExist=true.
   The declaration invited a cleanup that drops createDatabaseIfNotExist and
   dies at first connect with Unknown database. Dropping it lets the JDBC URL
   own the schema and shrinks the diff.

3. The cleanup comment and removal-failure warning said the host reaper
   reclaims a stranded container "after a 24h age gate" / "up to a day".
   The real bound is ~48h: qwen-docker-cleanup.sh:31 gates on a strict
   `now - created_at > 86400` (exactly 24h is SKIPPED) and
   qwen-docker-cleanup.timer fires once a day, so a container created just
   after a fire is skipped at the next one and reaped at the one after.

Test pins updated in the same change: the start-step assertion, the exact
docker-run trace literal, and the cleanup warning literal. All three were
mutant-verified red (drop --skip-log-bin / re-add MYSQL_DATABASE / restore
"after 24h") and restored byte-identical.

Only this PR's own copy of the reaper wording is corrected; the two
pre-existing copies (sdk-java.yml's event-transport-multi-node job and
release-managed-agent-reference.yml) are untouched to keep this diff scoped.

prs.title: fix(rewind): resolve legacy turns by source identity
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Conversation rewind associates the visible user message, model-history anchor and recorded boundary by a unique source identity, or refuses before mutation. Legacy records can recover a conversation-only identity from their existing record UUID; that key cannot authorize file restore. Retry, resume, compression sidecars and JSON history rollback preserve the association.

The live Ink selector omits identity-less targets. ACP keeps raw file-snapshot positions, while daemon-backed Web Shell, VS Code and SDK consumers use the existing admitted prompt identity to select and apply a rewind. A retry can create a gap in raw positions; neither the displayed ordinal nor the rank in a filtered catalog is an identity. Admission reuses the existing optimistic-message binding, including a failed submission retried without appending another row.

## Why it's needed

A legacy placeholder-shaped prompt could disappear from the visible transcript while remaining in model context. Independent position counting also misaligned recorder boundaries when a retry added a snapshot without adding a user turn. The retained ACP producer exposed that gap to clients: after A failed and was retried, editing B could report no snapshot; with another turn C, ordinal matching could select B instead of C.

This follows #9437. Stable identified-turn support in #9466 and retained-snapshot counter seeding in #13729 are already merged and are not reimplemented here.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Resume `hello`, `[Old inline media cleared: image/png]`, `world` and their replies. Rewind the second prompt: the visible and next-request histories should retain only `hello` and its reply. A recovered record key must not restore files.
- Fail A, retry it successfully, then submit B. Edit B and resend: A remains, the original B/reply disappear and the edited B appears once. Repeat with chat recording disabled.
- After the same retry, submit B and C, then edit C: B must remain in the next model request. The raw catalog can be `[0,2,3]`; the selected target must still be C.
- Cancel a new prompt before output: return its text to the composer and remove only its own turn when the daemon confirms the association. Missing or duplicate identity must not fall back to another turn.
- Check a retained target after a compressed prefix, a tool-loop cancellation and a JSON history echo. A continuation belongs to its turn but is not a second prompt anchor. Unique source associations resolve; missing or duplicated associations refuse before mutation. Rewind metadata must not reach the model.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The [current local runtime report](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13737#issuecomment-6311356723) covers delivered `f2002a5864`: two baseline reproductions and seven passing candidate runs, recording on/off, real daemon/ACP/SDK, actual provider-request receipts and matched captures. It compares the current review repair, not the whole PR against original main. Earlier reports remain historical and are not relabeled as evidence for this revision.

Local focused checks: build, typecheck, changed-file lint/format, and 963 tests across the relevant core, CLI, ACP bridge, SDK, Web Shell and VS Code cases passed. This is not a full-suite run. The previously reported local AppContainer/jsdom limitation did not recur with the synchronized dependencies: the selected rewind cases passed.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ focused checks and real local daemon/browser verification |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.22.3, isolated checkout and profiles, actual source CLI/ACP daemon with repository Web Shell and SDK source. The model boundary is a deterministic loopback OpenAI-compatible provider, not a real model. Provider request receipts, HTTP/SSE, DOM, screenshots and owned-process cleanup are retained locally.

## Risk & Scope

- Identity-less or ambiguous legacy history deliberately refuses conversation rewind rather than guessing. File restore still requires a real file-snapshot identity. Legacy numeric rewind notifications retain their old interpretation for older senders.
- Daemon client changes are included only to complete the retained producer contract and remove the demonstrated wrong-target regression. No new daemon route, persisted schema, identity counter, setting or dependency. The old proposed local binding event is not added; existing admission binding is reused.
- Native model-driven compression, Windows/Linux runtime behavior, actual VS Code host execution and changed-file byte restoration were not exercised in this local UI run. Compressed-prefix and embedded-client behavior have focused regression tests.
- Remaining unrelated Suggestions stay in #13869. #13794 stays deferred; the unwired OpenTUI selector and broader cleanup are not part of this repair. No full test suite, passive CI wait, approval or merge is performed.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/fix-9437-rewind-contract-20261009/docs/design/rewind-stable-prompt-identity.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/fix-9437-rewind-contract-20261009/docs/design/rewind-stable-prompt-identity.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Refs #9437. No issue is auto-closed.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

对话回退通过唯一来源身份关联可见用户消息、模型历史锚点和录制边界，无法关联则在变更前拒绝。旧记录可从既有 UUID 恢复仅用于对话的身份，不能据此恢复文件；重试、恢复、压缩 sidecar 和 JSON 历史回滚保留关联。

实时 Ink 选择器不列出无身份目标。ACP 保留文件快照的原始位置，daemon 的 Web Shell、VS Code 和 SDK 消费者通过既有的准入 prompt 身份选择并应用回退。重试可能造成原始编号空洞；显示序号与过滤列表中的排名都不是身份。准入复用现有的乐观消息绑定，包括重试时不再追加新行的提交失败消息。

## 为什么需要

旧占位符形状的 prompt 可能从界面消失，却仍留在模型上下文。重试新增快照但不新增用户轮次时，独立计数还会使录制截断错位。保留的 ACP producer 将这个空洞暴露给客户端：A 失败并重试后，编辑 B 可能报告没有快照；再增加 C 后，按序号匹配可能误选 B。

本次跟进 #9437；#9466 的已标识轮次支持与 #13729 的保留快照计数器种子已分别合并，不在这里重复实现。

## 验证

- 恢复 `hello`、`[Old inline media cleared: image/png]`、`world` 及回答，回退第二轮：可见和下一请求历史应只保留 `hello` 与回答；恢复出的记录 key 不能恢复文件。
- 让 A 失败后重试成功，再提交 B，编辑重发 B：保留 A，移除旧 B/回答，编辑后的 B 只出现一次。关闭录制后重复。
- 同样重试后提交 B、C，再编辑 C：下一模型请求必须保留 B。即使原始列表为 `[0,2,3]`，选择的目标仍须为 C。
- 在新 prompt 输出前取消：文本回到输入框，只有 daemon 确认关联后才移除该轮。关联缺失或重复时不得改选另一轮。
- 检查压缩前缀后的保留目标、工具轮取消和 JSON 历史回传：续跑属于该轮但不是第二个 prompt 锚点；唯一关联可解析，缺失或重复则在变更前拒绝。身份元数据不得发给模型。

[本轮运行报告](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13737#issuecomment-6311356723)对应已交付的 `f2002a5864`：两次基线复现、七次候选通过，覆盖录制开关、真实 daemon/ACP/SDK、实际 provider 请求与对照截图。报告比较的是本轮 review 修复，不是整个 PR 对原始 main 的前后验收；较早报告仅保留为历史证据。本机 build、typecheck、改动文件 lint/format 与相关 core、CLI、ACP bridge、SDK、Web Shell、VS Code 的 963 个定向测试已通过，不是全量测试。同步依赖后，先前报告的 AppContainer/jsdom 环境限制未再出现，选定的 rewind 用例已通过。

本地实测为 macOS；Windows/Linux 未实测。环境为 Node 22.22.3、隔离工作区与 profile，实际源码 CLI/ACP daemon 与仓库 Web Shell/SDK。模型边界是确定性的本地 OpenAI 兼容服务，不是真实模型；实际请求接收记录、HTTP/SSE、DOM、截图和进程清理记录保存在本地。

## 风险与范围

- 无身份或有歧义的旧历史明确拒绝对话回退，不按位置猜测；文件恢复仍要求真实快照身份。旧数字回退通知保留旧发送方兼容语义。
- daemon 客户端修改仅为补全已保留的 producer 契约，修复已复现的错选回归。不新增路由、持久化 schema、身份计数器、设置或依赖，也不恢复旧方案的新绑定事件，而是复用现有准入绑定。
- 本轮 UI 未覆盖自然模型压缩、Windows/Linux、实际 VS Code 宿主和文件字节恢复；压缩前缀与嵌入客户端有定向回归测试。
- 其余 Suggestions 留在 #13869；#13794 继续后续处理，未连接的 OpenTUI 选择器与广泛清理不混入本次。不跑全量测试、不被动等待 CI、不代为审批或合并。

</details>

prs.title: feat: project agent identity and Agent Team delivery onto the ACP/daemon wire (refs #13785)
prs.body:
## What this PR does Projects agent identity and Agent Team coordination onto the ACP/daemon wire, in two deliberately distinct collaboration columns. Subagent column (parent→child delegation): every projected subagent frame (thought, message, tool call, tool call update) now carries `_meta.agent = { agentName, depth, kind }` with a path-style name (`/root/general-purpose`), mirroring OpenAI Responses' per-item `agent` identity; the Web Shell keeps that path on the subagent panel name as a `title` tooltip only — no visible path chip ships in this slice (`SubAgentPanel.tsx:345`; pinned by `SubAgentPanel.test.tsx` `keeps the path on the name title without rendering it as a chip`). `agentName` is a readable role path, not a unique execution id: concurrent same-type subagents share it, and renaming the agent definition changes it. `parentToolCallId` distinguishes subagent executions; that boundary is documented on both the producer and the normalizer. Agent Team column (peer complete agents): an ACP-hosted session now attaches a leader sink (`team-sink.ts`). Before this, `TeamManager.pollLeaderInbox()` returned before consuming on this host (teammate reports stayed unread in the leader inbox) and `TEAMMATE_APPROVAL_REQUEST` was void-emitted — the coordination never reached anyone. Now teammate reports are delivered as `peer` background notifications carrying structured sender identity (`kind: 'teammate'`, minted from the inbox entry's `from`, never parsed from message text), roster joins/exits are projected as peer notifications so an already-attached client can track membership transitions (there is no current-state snapshot for late attach or reconnect), and teammate tool approvals route to the client's `requestPermission` (fail-closed: Cancel plus a `` to the leader when the host cannot answer; YOLO auto-approve only when the request carries no renderable details). ## Why it's needed #13785 records the gap: the public vocabulary names child agents and teams, but nothing a client receives says which agent produced what. Both reference protocols (OpenAI Responses multi-agent, Anthropic Managed Agents) treat agent identity as contractual. This slice delivers the identity dimension on the daemon/ACP projection and removes the "ACP host has no leader sink" failure class — the zero-signal class among the three host classes in #13785 M4 — giving M1b a reference wire shape. Peer delivery reuses core's existing `'peer'` background-notification channel (idle wake, loss accounting, kind-agnostic drain/display), without a new peer runtime. Team-binding approval retirement now uses one private, versioned `qwen/notify/session/teammate-binding-ended` notification on the existing SDK 0.14.1 connection; it adds no daemon REST route or public mediator API. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify At `3499b027c4faa`, 2,106 focused cases, targeted ESLint/Prettier, five affected workspace typechecks and integration typecheck passed on the exact committed candidate. Approval retirement, status identity, activity isolation and canonical START behavior were mutation-checked. A serialized ACP component probe verified old-binding cancellation and replacement approval at cap 1; a local macOS browser rendered the real transcript pipeline with injected protocol frames without splitting leader output or taking its usage. Main was synchronized to supply the current CI budget helper; obsolete assistant-activity handling was removed, and the rebuilt transcript's size ceiling was **raised** from 1,338,000 (main) to 1,340,000 in `packages/web-shell/client/build-artifact.test.ts` — merged with main the entry measures 1,338,274 UTF-16 units, past both main's ceiling and the 1,338,500 this branch carried. See the [current repair report](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#issuecomment-6192665587) for build results and verification limits. No real-provider or full daemon/browser E2E was run for this repair. The [real-model report and screenshots at `df760052100d1`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#issuecomment-6138227209) and the runtime observations below are historical evidence, not current-head acceptance. Real machine: boot the daemon from this branch with `QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_AGENT_TEAM=1 node scripts/dev.js serve --port

--token --workspace

`, create a session, send a team prompt (`team_create`, then spawn teammate `correctness` asking it to report one sentence ending in a marker). Expected and observed on SSE: peer notifications `teammate-roster-1` (status joined) and `teammate-message-2/3`, each carrying `_meta.agent={"agentName":"/root/correctness","depth":1,"kind":"teammate"}`, plus leader-reply frames with `source=background_notification_response`; the same capture contains zero subagent-column frames. Contrast run without a team: 47 `parentToolCallId`-chained frames carrying `kind:'subagent'` and zero peer markers — the two columns are mutually attributable at a glance. The Web Shell rendered the peer rows (`ⓘ … · peer`) and the verbatim teammate report in a real headless Chromium against the same daemon. ### Evidence (Before & After) Before: on this host an ACP session with a team delivered 0 teammate reports (retained unread in the leader inbox) and emitted 0 approval signals; no projected object carried any agent identity. After: the SSE markers and browser rendering described above. ### Tested on (earlier runtime acceptance) | OS | Status | | :--------: | :-------------: | | 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ not tested | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested | | 🐧 Linux | ✅ tested | ### Environment (optional) Linux host; daemon via `node scripts/dev.js serve` (no bundle step); headless Chromium (playwright) for Web Shell rendering; unit suites via vitest with `env -u QWEN_CODE_SERVE -u QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR`. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: identity is additive `_meta`; older readers ignore it. Teammate identity is minted only for single-sender batches — mixed-sender batches stay unattributed rather than misattributed. Status/idle team events are deliberately not projected (each would wake the leader into an automatic turn). Join/exit notifications are incremental, so a client that attaches late still needs a non-waking roster snapshot/query before it can claim authoritative current membership. - Not validated / out of scope: managed-agent public-contract projections (#13785 M1a/M2/M3) and client intervention verbs (M4) remain design surfaces; foreground nested subagents do not project their own frames today (verified on real machine: single `parentToolCallId` layer, depth values only 1), so depth ≥ 2 identity has no wire producer yet — nested trees remain record-projection work (M1a); cross-session teammate projection is M1b/M3. Mailbox consumption and model-visible delivery are not transactional; crash-safe redelivery after process/session destruction remains follow-up work, and reversible-close retention does not provide that guarantee. - Breaking changes / migration notes: identity fields are additive. Approval retirement requires this CLI/bridge pair; older bridges that ignore the new private notification retain the previous stale-approval behavior. No new daemon REST routes, public mediator APIs, dependencies or persisted formats. ## Linked Issues Refs #13785 (referenced without a closing keyword: the public-contract milestones remain open design work).
中文说明 ## 本 PR 做了什么 把 agent 身份与 Agent Team 协调投影到 ACP/daemon 的 wire 上，分为刻意保持区分的两条协作列。 subagent 列（父子委派）：每个投影出的 subagent 帧（thought、message、tool call、tool call update）现在都带 `_meta.agent = { agentName, depth, kind }`，名字为 path 风格（`/root/general-purpose`），与 OpenAI Responses 的逐 item `agent` 身份同形；Web Shell 本片只把该 path 挂在 subagent 面板名字的 `title` tooltip 上，不渲染可见的 path chip（`SubAgentPanel.tsx:345`；由 `SubAgentPanel.test.tsx` 的 `keeps the path on the name title without rendering it as a chip` 钉住）。`agentName` 是可读的角色 path，并不是唯一执行 ID：同类型并发 subagent 会共享它，agent 定义改名也会改变它；`parentToolCallId` 用于区分 subagent 执行，这一边界在生产侧与 normalizer 两侧都有文档。 Agent Team 列（对等完整 agent）：ACP 托管会话现在会挂一个 leader sink（`team-sink.ts`）。在此之前，本宿主上 `TeamManager.pollLeaderInbox()` 会在消费前早退（队员报告留在 leader inbox 里未读），`TEAMMATE_APPROVAL_REQUEST` 空 emit——协调过程到不了任何人手里。现在队员报告以 `peer` 背景通知投递，带结构化发送者身份（`kind: 'teammate'`，从 inbox 条目的 `from` 铸造，绝不从消息文本解析）；roster 的加入/退出投影为 peer 通知，已挂载的客户端可跟踪成员变化（晚挂载或重连时没有当前状态快照）；队员的工具审批路由到客户端 `requestPermission`（fail-closed：宿主无法应答时 Cancel 并向 leader 注入 ``；仅当请求不带可渲染细节且处于 YOLO 时才自动批准）。 ## 为什么需要 #13785 记录了缺口：公共词表里有 child agent 与 team，但客户端收到的任何东西都不说明「哪条输出是哪个 agent 产的」。两个参照协议（OpenAI Responses multi-agent、Anthropic Managed Agents）都把 agent 身份当契约内容。本片在 daemon/ACP 投影侧交付身份维度，并消掉「ACP 宿主没有 leader sink」这一失效类——即 #13785 M4 三类宿主中的零信号类——为 M1b 给出参考 wire 形状。peer 投递复用 core 既有的 `'peer'` 背景通知通道（空闲唤醒、丢失记账、kind 无关的 drain/display），不增加 peer runtime。队绑定审批回收新增一条私有、版本化的 `qwen/notify/session/teammate-binding-ended` 通知，走既有 SDK 0.14.1 连接；不添加 daemon REST 路由或 public mediator API。 ## 评审测试计划 ### 如何验证 `3499b027c4faa` 的精确提交候选通过 2,106 条聚焦用例、定向 ESLint/Prettier、五个相关 workspace 的类型检查和 integration 类型检查；审批回收、status 身份、活动隔离与 START canonical 行为做过变异反证。真实 ACP 串行化组件链路以 cap 1 验证旧绑定取消和新绑定审批；本地 macOS 浏览器通过真实 transcript 流水线渲染注入的协议帧，leader 答案与 usage 未被活动切断或夺走。已同步 main 补齐当前 CI 预算脚本，并删除旧 assistant 活动路径；重建 transcript 的体积阈值是**上调**的——由 main 的 1,338,000 提到 `packages/web-shell/client/build-artifact.test.ts` 里的 1,340,000，因为与 main 合并后该 entry 实测 1,338,274 UTF-16 单位，同时超出 main 的阈值和本分支此前携带的 1,338,500。构建结果与验证限制见[本轮修复报告](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#issuecomment-6192665587)。本轮未跑真实模型或完整 daemon/browser E2E。[`df760052100d1` 的真实模型报告与截图](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#issuecomment-6138227209)及下方真机记录仅为历史证据，不作为当前 head 验收。 真机：从本分支起 daemon（`QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_AGENT_TEAM=1 node scripts/dev.js serve --port

--token --workspace

`），建会话，发 team prompt（`team_create`，再派 teammate `correctness` 要求其回一句以 marker 结尾的话）。SSE 上期望并实测到：peer 通知 `teammate-roster-1`（status joined）与 `teammate-message-2/3`，均带 `_meta.agent={"agentName":"/root/correctness","depth":1,"kind":"teammate"}`，以及 `source=background_notification_response` 的 leader 回话帧；同一抓帧中 subagent 列帧为零。不带 team 的对照跑：47 帧 `parentToolCallId` 链帧带 `kind:'subagent'`、peer 标记零命中——两列形状互斥、可一眼归因。Web Shell 在真 headless Chromium 中对同一 daemon 渲染出了 peer 行（`ⓘ … · peer`）与队员原话。 ### 证据（Before & After） Before：本宿主上带 team 的 ACP 会话投递 0 条队员报告（留在 leader inbox 未读）、0 个审批信号；任何投影对象都不带 agent 身份。After：上述 SSE 标记与浏览器渲染。 ### Tested on（较早版本的真机验收） | OS | Status | | :--------: | :-------------: | | 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 未测试 | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 | | 🐧 Linux | ✅ 已测试 | ### 环境（可选） Linux 宿主机；daemon 走 `node scripts/dev.js serve`（无 bundle 步骤）；Web Shell 渲染用 headless Chromium（playwright）；单测走 vitest 并加 `env -u QWEN_CODE_SERVE -u QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR`。 ## 风险与范围 - 主要风险或权衡：身份是 additive `_meta`，旧读者会忽略它。teammate 身份只为单发送者批次铸造——混合发送者批次宁可无身份也不张冠李戴。status/idle 队事件刻意不投影（每条都会唤醒 leader 起一个自动 turn）。加入/退出通知是增量流，晚挂载客户端仍需要一个不会唤醒 leader 的 roster 快照/查询，才能声称拿到了权威当前成员表。 - 未验证 / 超出范围：managed-agent 公共契约投影（#13785 M1a/M2/M3）与客户端干预动词（M4）仍是设计面；foreground 嵌套 subagent 今天不投影自身帧（真机验过：parentToolCallId 仅一层、depth 取值仅 1），故 depth ≥ 2 身份暂无 wire 生产者——嵌套树仍是记录投影工作（M1a）；跨 session 的 teammate 投影属 M1b/M3。mailbox 消费与模型可见投递不是事务；进程崩溃或会话销毁后的安全重投递留到后续，可逆 close 时保留队列不构成这一保证。 - 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：身份字段为 additive。审批回收需要本轮配套 CLI/bridge；忽略新增私有通知的旧 bridge 仍保留此前的陈旧审批行为。不添加 daemon REST 路由、public mediator API、依赖或持久化格式。 ## 关联 Issue Refs #13785（不用 closing 关键字引用：公共契约里程碑仍是开放的设计工作）。

prs.title: test(managed-agent): keep a sibling run alive past a cancel (FG11d)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds one cell to the FG11d cancellation matrix. After a parked run is cancelled, the next manual fire is admitted, starts its own Turn and reaches `completed`; the first run stays `cancelled`, the schedule stays `live`, and each key keeps exactly one Turn.

## Why it's needed

The matrix still lists "a queued input cancelled before any attempt settles with no model call" as open. Building it as written turned out to be impossible from the public surface, and that impossibility is itself the property worth pinning: without a cell on the refusal, the queue could start forming silently — for instance if admission dropped its open-Turn check — and the assertion would rot into something nobody can execute.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Read the new cell next to the cancel cells it sits among: the first fire is parked on the fixture model before the second POST, so the refusal is answered against a Session that provably carries an open Turn. Both admission arms answer `overlap` — the open Turn and the definition's overlap policy — so the cell pins the answer, not which arm produced it.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: a second manual fire under a fresh key during a parked Turn had no cell at all, so nothing in CI distinguished "refused with `overlap`" from "queued silently and cancelled later".

After: `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0 -- in HostedAutomationFaultGatesIT` (12.27 s, then 13.39 s after a comment-only edit) on JDK 21 + MySQL 8.0.46. The cell is booked at 25 s (2× its slower sample), moving the fork to 10696 s and Verify to 189 minutes.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   N/A  |

JDK 21 (`Zulu 21.0.11`) and MySQL 8.0.46 on `127.0.0.1:3401`, selected with `-Phosted-automation-gates`.

### Environment (optional)

N/A.

## Risk & Scope

No production code changes; this is a test cell plus the budget ledger that carries it. The ledger step is the real tradeoff: the cell books 25 s against samples of 12.27 s and 13.39 s, and 2× the slower sample is what moves `Verify` from 188 to 189 minutes — a ceiling raised on two local samples rather than a fleet measurement, which is the same convention every other cell in this class uses. Not validated: the scheduled-slot path for the same refusal (the cell fires manually), and the same-instant race where a fire is admitted as another turn opens.

## Base

Based on `test/14446-fg11d-cancel-retry` rather than `main`, stacked on #14997, #14996. The three cells edit the same four budget carriers (pom ledger, workflow job and step ceilings, the CI meta-test, and both language versions of the design doc), so parallel branches would only reproduce the same conflict in every PR. The chain merges in order.

## Verification

- `HostedAutomationFaultGatesIT#fg11dSecondFireIsRefusedWhileTheFirstRunsOnMySql` green locally (12.27 s, then 13.39 s).
- `npx vitest run scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js` — 73/73.
- `mvn -o -Phosted-automation-gates -DskipTests test-compile` — BUILD SUCCESS.

prs.title: test(ci): pin daemon E2E build ordering and correct the install warning
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Corrects the daemon E2E install retry warning to reflect that this lane skips prepare's build. Adds regression guards that keep the explicit Build, Bundle and Java daemon E2E steps in order, unconditional and attached to their intended commands, and that keep each install warning consistent with that lane's prepare behavior.

## Why it's needed

The prepare skip already landed in #14873. The build heap repairs landed separately in #14822 and #14827. This follow-up corrects the warning left behind by that change and protects the existing explicit build pipeline; it does not introduce the prepare skip or fix the original build failure recorded in #14870.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- After an absorbed install retry, the daemon E2E warning should say that prepare's build is skipped; install lanes that still build during prepare should retain their corresponding warning.
- The explicit Build, Bundle and Java daemon E2E steps must remain in that order. Changing a command, making one conditional or allowing its failure should fail the workflow guard tests.
- The lane should continue producing its bundle through the existing explicit steps. This change does not alter the commands, heap budgets or retry counts.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — CI warning text and regression guards, with no product UI change.

Existing verification at head `a72883767c68d6a0817291f6e594a32b88ecb005`: [the retained head report](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14884#issuecomment-6314795888) records 1,151 assertions passing and nine expected mutation failures. This closeout pass inspected the complete two-file diff and changed PR metadata only; it did not rerun that test matrix. Current CI failures remain separately visible and are not certified by this report.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ existing exact-head verification linked above |

### Environment (optional)

Existing head verification used Linux. This closeout pass performed GitHub metadata and diff checks only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the guards intentionally require the existing explicit build, bundle and execution steps to remain mandatory; a future pipeline redesign must update those guards.
- Not validated / out of scope: the original build OOM, heap sizing, the already-landed prepare skip, unrelated Web Shell failures and additional timeout-comment cleanup from #14895.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The sole workflow output change is the retry-warning wording.

## Linked Issues

Refs #14870, whose behavioral repairs landed separately. Consolidates the overlapping warning/build-order guard work from #14895 into this narrower PR.

prs.title: fix(web-shell): preserve composer draft attachments across views
prs.body:
## What this PR does Keeps unsent images and files with their text drafts across session switches and page reloads. Main and split views of the same session share live text, references and attachments; different sessions retain independent drafts. Attachments use IndexedDB under the existing draft key, while text keeps its current localStorage format and save debounce. Restoration blocks submission until archived attachments are ready, merges additions made during loading, and respects explicit removal or clear. Session allocation moves pending attachments to the assigned session, and delayed acceptance clears the submitted draft while protecting newer edits. The existing IndexedDB transaction handling is shared with directory grants and managed pending requests. Whole-matrix runtime test budgets allow the complete existing checks to finish, while individual command deadlines and assertions stay intact. An unrelated existing core test issue is excluded from this PR. The complete design is available in [English](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/8bb627ff90bd1357db8a710e8fe15bfe367021bd/docs/design/composer-draft-attachments.md) and [简体中文](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/8bb627ff90bd1357db8a710e8fe15bfe367021bd/docs/design/composer-draft-attachments.zh-CN.md); decisions, constraints and acceptance criteria are synchronized. ## Why it's needed Switching sessions or reloading currently loses staged attachments even when the text draft survives. Multiple editors showing one session can also retain stale snapshots. A draft should behave as one draft across those views, without reviving removed attachments or letting a late send acknowledgement erase new input. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify - Add an image and a file to A, switch to B, then return to A and reload. A should retain its original text and attachment payloads; B should retain only its own draft. - Open A in a split pane, edit its text and attachments from both views, remove an attachment, then reload. Both views should reflect the same current draft, including removals; adding Y in split and Z in main must keep both. - Open two different sessions in split panes. Editing, removing or submitting in one must leave the other session's draft intact. - While attachment restoration or file reading is pending, confirm submission cannot omit the pending attachments. Add a same-name file during restoration and confirm both original payloads survive with distinct names. Clear during restoration and confirm cleared attachments do not return. - Submit a pending draft that allocates a session, then navigate away before acceptance. Returning should not restore already-sent attachments. Edits made before or after allocation must survive an old acknowledgement, including on mobile textarea remounts. ### Evidence (Before & After) Before: text drafts could survive navigation/reload while staged attachment state disappeared, and separate views could retain stale attachment snapshots. After: the real browser scenarios below retain draft payloads and protect newer input. These are actual Chromium UI captures with a **simulated daemon**; native File objects, IndexedDB transactions/structured cloning, reload and serialized upload bytes are real. Screenshots do not establish real daemon/model or Git backend behavior. **Reload restores the image, file and text.** **A same-session split retains the image plus Y and Z after edits from both views.** **A delayed acceptance preserves the newer text and Y draft.** Verification: **421/421 relevant permanent tests**, **9/9 complete Web Shell UI browser scenarios**, **9/9 additional actual-hook/native-browser fixed and control groups**, and **7/7 focused DOM probes** passed. The separately reproduced R1-8 known gap is excluded from those counts. Full root build, bundle, typecheck, final Web Shell rebuild/bundle, changed-file ESLint and formatting passed. All 32 final browser screenshots were individually inspected; image/file bytes and native same-name File contents were checked exactly. [Detailed bilingual evidence](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/e2f69f7c13257af8d34c489071b33624a610354c/composer-draft-attachments/e2e-report.md). Screenshots and the report are on an independent assets branch, pinned to a fixed commit, and absent from the implementation branch. **An identical folded-text payload restored during loading produces one card.** ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :---: | :--- | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ Unit/DOM regressions, Chromium E2E, build/bundle/typecheck | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally | | 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally | ### Environment (optional) Node.js 22; repository Vite Web Shell with Chromium Playwright and mock daemon HTTP/SSE/202 admission. Targeted migration/layout tests exercise the real hook with jsdom/fake IndexedDB; mobile coverage uses textarea DOM regressions. Local verification covers `8bb627ff90`, based on `021dc1fdd6`. The subsequent remote merge of main (`d1d69c90fe`, including Managed UI updates) is preserved and has not been rerun locally. Remote CI results are tracked separately; this evidence does not claim the full remote smoke suite is green. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: IndexedDB is best-effort browser storage. Quota failures or eviction can prevent attachment restoration; the in-memory composer remains usable. - Not validated / out of scope: cross-tab conflict resolution, retention policy, real daemon/model or Git backend behavior, server-side payload storage, mobile devices, and local Windows/Linux execution. - Deferred follow-up: R1-8, submission before workspace resolution followed by allocation, retains the baseline text-cleanup gap and its attachment archive. It is documented in both design languages and the PR discussion under the repeated-review scope rule. - Breaking changes / migration notes: no new dependency, daemon protocol field or text-draft format change. Existing session IDs/draft keys are reused; unread attachment archives are preserved when capability information is initially unavailable. ## Linked Issues No linked issue.
中文说明 ## 此 PR 的改动 让未发送的图片、文件与文字草稿一起跨会话切换和页面刷新保存。同一会话的主视图与分屏即时共享文字、引用和附件；不同会话的草稿保持独立。附件使用现有草稿 key 存入 IndexedDB，文字保留当前 localStorage 格式与保存防抖。 存档附件恢复完成前阻止发送，合并读取期间新增的附件，并遵循显式删除或清空操作。分配会话时将待创建草稿附件迁移至对应会话；迟到的接受确认会清理已提交草稿，同时保护新的编辑。输入框、目录授权和托管待处理请求复用现有的 IndexedDB 事务处理。独立运行时测试仅调整整组累计预算，保留每条命令的超时与断言；无关的既有 core 测试问题不在此 PR 修改范围。 完整方案提供 [English](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/8bb627ff90bd1357db8a710e8fe15bfe367021bd/docs/design/composer-draft-attachments.md) 与 [简体中文](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/8bb627ff90bd1357db8a710e8fe15bfe367021bd/docs/design/composer-draft-attachments.zh-CN.md)，设计决策、约束与验收项保持同步。 ## 为什么需要 当前切换会话或刷新页面时，即使文字草稿保留，已添加的附件仍会丢失。展示同一会话的多个输入框也可能保留过期快照。它们应表现为同一份草稿，不能恢复已删除附件，也不能让迟到的发送确认清掉新输入。 ## Reviewer Test Plan（审阅者验证计划） ### How to verify（如何验证） - 给 A 添加图片与文件，切到 B，再返回 A 并刷新。A 应保留原文字及附件载荷，B 仅保留自己的草稿。 - 将 A 打开为分屏，从两个视图编辑文字与附件、删除一个附件后刷新。两侧应展示同一份当前草稿，包括删除结果；分屏添加 Y、主视图添加 Z 后应同时保留两者。 - 在分屏中打开两个不同会话。一个会话中的编辑、删除或发送不能影响另一个会话的草稿。 - 附件恢复或文件读取尚未完成时，确认发送不能遗漏待读取附件。恢复期间添加同名文件，两份原始载荷应以不同名称保留；恢复期间清空后，已清空附件不能再出现。 - 提交会分配新会话的待创建草稿，在接受确认前切走。返回后不能恢复已经发送的附件。分配前或分配后的新编辑都应避开旧确认的清理，包括移动端 textarea 重新挂载的情况。 ### Evidence (Before & After)（前后证据） 修复前：文字草稿可能在导航/刷新后保留，但已添加附件丢失，不同视图也可能保留过期附件快照。修复后：上述真实浏览器场景会保留草稿载荷并保护新输入。截图来自实际 Chromium UI，使用**模拟 daemon**；原生 File、IndexedDB 事务/结构化克隆、刷新及序列化上传字节为真实执行。截图不能证明真实 daemon/模型或 Git 后端行为。 对应截图：① [刷新后恢复图片、文件和文字](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/e2f69f7c13257af8d34c489071b33624a610354c/composer-draft-attachments/01-reloaded-attachments.png)；② [同会话分屏保留两侧编辑后的图片及 Y/Z](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/e2f69f7c13257af8d34c489071b33624a610354c/composer-draft-attachments/02-shared-split-attachments.png)；③ [迟到接受确认后保留新文字和 Y 草稿](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/e2f69f7c13257af8d34c489071b33624a610354c/composer-draft-attachments/03-newer-draft-preserved.png)。 验证结果：**421/421 条相关永久测试**、**9/9 条完整 Web Shell UI 浏览器场景**、**9/9 组额外实际 hook/原生浏览器修复及保护性对照**、**7/7 条专项 DOM probe**均通过。独立复现的 R1-8 已知缺口不计入这些通过数。全仓构建、bundle、类型检查、最终 Web Shell 重建/bundle、改动文件 ESLint 与格式检查通过。最终 32 张浏览器截图已逐张目视；图片、文件上传字节及原生同名 File 内容均精确核对。[完整中英文证据](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/e2f69f7c13257af8d34c489071b33624a610354c/composer-draft-attachments/e2e-report.md)。截图和报告位于独立素材分支，链接固定 commit，未进入实现分支。 **读取期间恢复的相同折叠文字只生成一张卡片。** [对应截图](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/e2f69f7c13257af8d34c489071b33624a610354c/composer-draft-attachments/04-folded-overlap-single-copy.png)。 ### Tested on（测试平台） | OS | 状态 | | :---: | :--- | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ 单元/DOM 回归、Chromium E2E、构建/bundle/类型检查 | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 本地未测试 | | 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 本地未测试 | ### Environment (optional)（环境） Node.js 22；仓库 Vite Web Shell、Chromium Playwright 和模拟 daemon HTTP/SSE/202 接受响应。迁移/layout 专项通过 jsdom/fake IndexedDB 执行真实 hook；移动端覆盖来自 textarea DOM 回归。本地验证覆盖基于 `021dc1fdd6` 的 `8bb627ff90`；后续远端合并 main 的 `d1d69c90fe`（含 Managed UI 更新）已保留，尚未本地重跑。远端 CI 结果另行跟踪，此处证据不宣称远端全量 smoke 全绿。 ## 风险与范围 - 主要风险或取舍：IndexedDB 是浏览器尽力保存的存储，配额不足或回收可能导致附件无法恢复；内存输入框仍可使用。 - 未验证/范围外：跨标签页冲突处理、保留策略、真实 daemon/模型或 Git 后端、服务端载荷保存、移动设备以及本地 Windows/Linux 执行。 - 延后事项：R1-8，无工作区时提交、确定工作区后再分配会话，仍保留基线文字清理缺口及其附件归档。按仓库多轮 review 后收敛范围的规则，已在双语方案及 PR 讨论中记录。 - 破坏性变更/迁移说明：不新增依赖、daemon 协议字段或文字草稿格式变更。复用现有 sessionId/草稿 key；初始能力信息尚不可用时保留未读取的附件存档。 ## 关联 Issue 无关联 Issue。
