prs.title: test(managed-agent): keep the FG12d lifecycle cells' writer lease past the close window
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Gives every case in `HostedMcpRestartFaultGatesIT` a 30 s Session writer lease instead of 3 s, so the FG12d close preamble stops failing intermittently. A killed Harness cannot release its lease, so `killHarness()` now expires the leases that writer held in the database and asserts that it found one. That stands in for waiting the lease out and lets the replacement take over at once; the update is scoped to the dead writer's id, so no other Session's lease is touched. The FG12d design doc, in both languages, rewrites Decision 2 of the R1-1 cell for the new lease and gains a "Writer lease" section that records why.

## Why it's needed

Once a v2 close is admitted, the store fences ordinary writer renewals, and the Harness renews under the claim only when the first lifecycle phase reaches it (#15011). The client renews at half the lease, so with a 3 s lease a fenced renewal leaves at most 1.5 s for the claim to arrive. When it arrived later, `effects` failed at the route with `hosted_lifecycle_recovery_required` (503); the store-level cause is "The Managed Session writer grant is stale or unavailable." #15010 fixed the two sibling variants of this window. This third variant needs a product decision (see the discussion in #15011), so the gates should not fail on it in the meantime.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

```bash
cd packages/managed-agent-server
JAVA_HOME=<jdk21> mvn test-compile failsafe:integration-test failsafe:verify \
  -Dit.test=HostedMcpRestartFaultGatesIT -Dfailsafe.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false \
  -Dmysql.url='jdbc:mysql://127.0.0.1:<port>/hosted_harness_test?allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true&useSSL=false' \
  -Dmysql.user=root -Dmysql.password=<password> \
  -Dnode.executable="$(command -v node)" -Dqwen.cli.entry=<repo>/dist/cli.js
```

Expected: 9/9.

### Evidence (Before & After)

A local-only probe repeats the shared FG12d close preamble (create Session, baseline turn, admit and claim a v2 close, `effects`, full close) in one Spring boot and stops at the first failure. Both arms run on Linux aarch64, JDK 21 and MySQL 8.4.6, with the packaged Harness built from `main` (which includes #15010):

| Writer lease | Runs | Preambles | `effects` "writer grant is stale or unavailable" |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 3 s (before) | 3 | 75 | 3 |
| 30 s (this PR) | 2 | 80 | 0 |

The rate depends on the host. On another Linux aarch64 host a review round saw 0 of 150 preambles at either lease, but with a 2.5 s gap injected before the first claimed renewal, the 3 s lease failed 4 of 6 preambles in one round and 3 of 6 in another, and the 30 s lease none in either (https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15068#issuecomment-6320138297, https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15068#issuecomment-6328790126).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

- Linux aarch64, JDK 21, MySQL 8.4.6, `dist/cli.js` built from `main` at `7bda51a070`, at head `ddc74a079d`: `HostedMcpRestartFaultGatesIT` passes 9/9 twice (104.4 s and 105.9 s). The three Harness-kill cells keep their earlier timings (11.8, 12.4–12.5 and 13.1–13.2 s); without the lease expiry each would wait out the full 30 s, as a review round measured (+27 s per cell). The R1-1 cell takes 10.8–11.4 s, against its recorded 11.4–11.9 s, so the fork budget ledger is unchanged. Disabling #13673's branch still turns the R1-1 cell red at "detach recovers after the Spring restart".
- At `eff4620a26` (writer-scoped expiry with its assertion), same rig and Harness: 9/9 (104.8 s), Harness-kill cells 12.0–13.3 s. Expiring under a writer id that does not exist turns `harnessKillDuringConfigureResolvesThroughStatusOnMySql` red at "the dead writer held a lease to expire", so the expiry is now asserted rather than inferred from timings.
- The run used exactly the committed test file (hashes matched). `test-compile` and both Checkstyle executions are clean on JDK 21, `hosted-process-ci.test.js` passes 73/73, and Prettier is clean.

### Environment (optional)

The packaged Harness, durable worker and real stdio fixture, as in the rest of the class. MySQL ran in a throwaway container with the binary log disabled.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: with a 30 s lease the class no longer exercises the 1.5 s window, so it cannot catch it. The window is a product issue tracked in #15011, and the gates were failing on it rather than testing it. Expiring the killed writer's lease skips the replacement's wait-out loop in `reload()`; the cells assert what the replacement does, not how long the lease takes to lapse.
- Not validated / out of scope: other Hosted IT classes that drive a v2 close with a short lease were not surveyed. A separate preamble race, where the lifecycle coordinator's scan claims a just-admitted close before the test does, is tracked in #15088. The production window itself is #15011. macOS was not run.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; test and docs only.

Design doc: [English](docs/design/2026-10-18-mcp-release-fault-gates-d.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-10-18-mcp-release-fault-gates-d.zh-CN.md). Both gain the same "Writer lease" section.

## Linked Issues

Related to #15011 and #14447. Follow-up to #15010.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

给 `HostedMcpRestartFaultGatesIT` 的每个用例设置 30 s 的 Session 写者租约（原为 3 s），让 FG12d 关闭前置不再偶发失败。被杀的 Harness 无法释放租约，所以 `killHarness()` 现在会在数据库中把该写者持有的租约置为过期，并断言确实找到了一条。这代替了等待租约过期，让替换的 Harness 立即接管；更新按死掉写者的 id 限定，不会触及其他 Session 的租约。FG12d 设计文档中英两版为新的租约改写了 R1-1 格的 Decision 2，并新增"写者租约"一节记录原因。

## 为什么需要

v2 关闭被准入之后，store 会 fence 普通写者续租，而 Harness 要等第一个 lifecycle 阶段到达时才带 claim 续租（#15011）。客户端每半个租约续一次，所以在 3 s 租约下，一次被 fence 的续租最多只留给 claim 1.5 s。claim 晚于此到达时，`effects` 会在路由层以 `hosted_lifecycle_recovery_required`（503）失败；store 层的原因是 "The Managed Session writer grant is stale or unavailable."。#15010 修复了这个窗口的两个兄弟情形；第三种情形需要产品决定（见 #15011 中的讨论），在此之前门禁不应因它而失败。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

```bash
cd packages/managed-agent-server
JAVA_HOME=<jdk21> mvn test-compile failsafe:integration-test failsafe:verify \
  -Dit.test=HostedMcpRestartFaultGatesIT -Dfailsafe.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false \
  -Dmysql.url='jdbc:mysql://127.0.0.1:<port>/hosted_harness_test?allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true&useSSL=false' \
  -Dmysql.user=root -Dmysql.password=<password> \
  -Dnode.executable="$(command -v node)" -Dqwen.cli.entry=<repo>/dist/cli.js
```

预期：9/9。

### 证据（前后对比）

一个仅在本地使用的探针，在同一次 Spring 启动中反复执行 FG12d 共享的关闭前置（创建 Session、baseline turn、准入并认领 v2 关闭、`effects`、完整关闭），遇到第一次失败即停。两臂都运行在 Linux aarch64、JDK 21、MySQL 8.4.6 上，打包 Harness 由 `main`（已含 #15010）构建：

| 写者租约 | 轮数 | 前置次数 | `effects` 报 "writer grant is stale or unavailable" |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 3 s（修改前） | 3 | 75 | 3 |
| 30 s（本 PR） | 2 | 80 | 0 |

失败率与主机有关。另一台 Linux aarch64 主机上的评审轮在两种租约下都是 150 次前置 0 次失败；但在第一次带 claim 的续租之前注入 2.5 s 间隔时，3 s 租约在一轮中 6 次前置失败 4 次、另一轮 6 次失败 3 次，30 s 租约两轮都没有失败（https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15068#issuecomment-6320138297、https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15068#issuecomment-6328790126）。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

- Linux aarch64、JDK 21、MySQL 8.4.6，`dist/cli.js` 由 `main` 的 `7bda51a070` 构建，head 为 `ddc74a079d`：`HostedMcpRestartFaultGatesIT` 两次 9/9 通过（104.4 s 与 105.9 s）。三个杀 Harness 的格保持原有耗时（11.8、12.4–12.5 与 13.1–13.2 s）；评审轮实测，若不置过期，每个格都要等满 30 s（每格多 27 s）。R1-1 格耗时 10.8–11.4 s，此前记录为 11.4–11.9 s，因此 fork 预算账本不变。关掉 #13673 的分支后，R1-1 格仍在 "detach recovers after the Spring restart" 处变红。
- 在 `eff4620a26`（按写者限定的置过期及其断言），同一 rig 与 Harness：9/9（104.8 s），杀 Harness 的格耗时 12.0–13.3 s。用一个不存在的写者 id 置过期，`harnessKillDuringConfigureResolvesThroughStatusOnMySql` 会在 "the dead writer held a lease to expire" 处变红，因此置过期现在由断言钉住，而不再靠耗时推断。
- 运行使用的正是提交中的测试文件（哈希一致）。JDK 21 上 `test-compile` 与两套 Checkstyle 均干净，`hosted-process-ci.test.js` 73/73 通过，Prettier 干净。

### 环境（可选）

与该类其他格相同：打包 Harness、durable worker 与真实 stdio fixture。MySQL 跑在关闭 binlog 的一次性容器中。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：在 30 s 租约下，该类不再经历 1.5 s 的窗口，因此无法发现它。这个窗口是 #15011 跟踪的产品问题，而门禁此前是被它弄挂，而不是在测试它。把被杀写者的租约置为过期，会跳过 `reload()` 中等待租约过期的循环；这些格断言的是替换 Harness 的行为，而不是租约多久失效。
- 未验证 / 不在范围：未普查其他以短租约驱动 v2 关闭的 Hosted IT 类。另一个前置竞态（lifecycle 协调器的扫描先于测试认领了刚准入的关闭）在 #15088 跟踪。生产中的窗口本身见 #15011。未在 macOS 上运行。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无；仅测试与文档。

设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-10-18-mcp-release-fault-gates-d.md) · [中文](docs/design/2026-10-18-mcp-release-fault-gates-d.zh-CN.md)。两版都新增同一个"写者租约"小节。

## 关联 Issue

与 #15011、#14447 相关。#15010 的后续。

</details>

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): narrow Hosted tool profiles to Todo
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Narrows #15089 to its Todo tool slice by removing native web fetch from the new Hosted profiles, both Worker paths and Action previews. The shared local web-fetch implementation returns to its pre-PR behavior. Todo remains declared only by the new profiles; its description no longer promises an automatic reminder that the Hosted model loop does not receive.

**This is a patch PR targeting #15089's branch, `feat/15076-managed-web-fetch-todo-write`.** It is intended to be incorporated into that PR. It does not independently deliver the full Todo workflow on main.

## Why it's needed

The recorded decision in [#15076](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/15076#issuecomment-6321618001) defers native web fetch. Keeping it in a files-only profile adds outbound access to a session that has no Shell, contrary to the original shared-egress rationale. Removing this half makes the remaining Todo work reviewable without making a new network-policy decision.

The synchronized [English design](docs/design/2026-10-22-managed-workspace-fetch-and-todos.md) and [Chinese design](docs/design/2026-10-22-managed-workspace-fetch-and-todos.zh-CN.md) now separate the tool slice from the unfinished enablement, public-profile wiring, cross-Runtime recovery and WebShell projection. The original PR should use `Refs #15076` while those original requirements remain unresolved.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

On both new `/3` profiles, verify that declarations contain Todo but not web fetch, and that a model-generated fetch call is refused before Broker acquisition, reservation or execution. The Worker tool set must also exclude fetch. Existing `/1` and `/2` vocabulary stays unchanged; Todo argument correction, same-runtime task updates and dependency validation should retain their existing behavior. Java and TypeScript Action previews must agree.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the `/3` profiles and Workers admit fetch; the Todo description promises automatic reminders. After, by source inspection: fetch is absent from those paths and the unsupported reminder promise is removed. Added negative regression coverage was inspected but not executed. The core web-fetch source is byte-identical to the original PR's merge base. Focused Prettier and `git diff --check` passed, and the final full patch received an independent source review. No runtime behavior is claimed as verified.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| macOS | ⚠️ Static review and formatting only |
| Windows | ⚠️ Not run |
| Linux | ⚠️ Not run |

### Environment (optional)

Isolated macOS worktree. Local tests, builds and runtime/UI checks were not run under the requested no-local-test workflow. CI is reported separately without waiting.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: deliberately removes a proposed capability from an unmerged profile; existing production profile defaults are unchanged.
- Not validated / out of scope: no test/build or Java→Harness→Broker→Worker acceptance run. Todo enablement, Java/public `/3` wiring, durable recovery and client display remain unfinished in the original PR and are documented explicitly. This patch is not evidence that #15089 is ready for production.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no schema change. Existing local web fetch and Hosted `/1` / `/2` behavior are preserved. This patch targets the original feature branch, not main.

## Linked Issues

Refs #15076, #15084. Follow-up to #15089; no automatic issue closure.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

将 #15089 收窄为 Todo 工具切片，移除新 Hosted profile、两处 Worker 和 Action 预览中的原生 web fetch。共享的本地 web-fetch 实现恢复到原 PR 之前。Todo 仍只由新 profile 声明；工具描述不再承诺 Hosted 模型循环没有接收的自动轮间提醒。

**这是以 #15089 分支 `feat/15076-managed-web-fetch-todo-write` 为目标的补丁 PR**，供原 PR 合入；它不独立向 main 交付完整 Todo 工作流。

## 为什么需要

[#15076 的既有决定](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/15076#issuecomment-6321618001) 已暂缓原生 web fetch。将它留在纯文件 profile 中，会为没有 Shell 的会话新增出站访问，与原先“复用 Shell 出站”的理由不符。移除这一半后，可以独立评审 Todo，不必在此作新的网络策略决定。

完整同步的[英文设计](docs/design/2026-10-22-managed-workspace-fetch-and-todos.md)与[中文设计](docs/design/2026-10-22-managed-workspace-fetch-and-todos.zh-CN.md)区分了工具切片和未完成的启用契约、公共 profile 接线、跨 Runtime 恢复及 WebShell 展示。这些原需求未完成前，原 PR 应使用 `Refs #15076`。

## 审阅测试计划

### 如何验证

检查两种 `/3` profile 声明包含 Todo、不包含 web fetch；模型生成的 fetch 调用必须在 Broker 获取、预留和执行之前拒绝，Worker 工具集也不包含 fetch。旧 `/1`、`/2` 工具集保持不变；Todo 参数纠正、同 Runtime 任务更新及依赖校验保持既有行为。Java 与 TypeScript 的 Action 预览必须一致。

### 证据（前后对比）

修改前：`/3` 和 Worker 准入 fetch，Todo 描述承诺自动提醒。静态检查修改后：这些路径不再包含 fetch，未实现的提醒承诺已删除。新增负向回归用例已审查，未执行。核心 web-fetch 源码与原 PR 的 merge base 逐字节一致。定向 Prettier 和 `git diff --check` 通过，最终完整补丁经过独立源码审查；不声称已验证运行时行为。

### 已测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| macOS | ⚠️ 仅静态审查与格式检查 |
| Windows | ⚠️ 未运行 |
| Linux | ⚠️ 未运行 |

### 环境（可选）

隔离 macOS worktree。按用户不运行本地测试的工作流，未运行测试、构建或运行时/UI 验证；CI 单独记录，不等待。

## 风险与范围

- 主要取舍：有意从未合入 profile 移除一项提议中的能力，生产 profile 默认值不变。
- 未验证/范围外：未跑测试、构建或 Java→Harness→Broker→Worker 验收。原 PR 中 Todo 启用、Java/公共 `/3` 接线、持久恢复和客户端展示仍未完成，文档明确记录；本补丁不代表 #15089 可生产使用。
- 兼容性/迁移：无 schema 变化。本地 web fetch 和 Hosted `/1`、`/2` 行为保留。本补丁以原功能分支为目标，不以 main 为目标。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #15076、#15084。跟进 #15089，不自动关闭 issue。

prs.body:
## What this PR does

Updates the no-AK integration gate's inventory so the three TUI parity suites added by the OpenTUI input, editing, and status-line alignment change are explicitly classified. The suites are recorded as runtime-budget exemptions, matching the existing interactive and TUI suites, because they already run in the dedicated TUI parity workflow across the Node+Ink, Bun+Ink, and Bun+OpenTUI legs.

## Why it's needed

Main CI failed at `8a9ae631a3` because the no-AK inventory guard introduced in #14989 correctly rejected three new runnable integration tests that were neither selected by the no-AK script nor explicitly exempted. The guard exists to force a deliberate selection-or-exemption decision for every new integration test, so the correct repair is to make that decision explicit rather than weaken or bypass the guard.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the focused contract suite on the current change; all 16 assertions should pass. To confirm the guard still catches unclassified tests, temporarily remove one of the three new exemption entries and rerun the same suite — it should fail and name that file. Restore the entry before finishing.

The three suites can also be run directly with the fake OpenAI server; they pass without credentials and take about two minutes locally, which is why they stay out of the 20-minute no-AK gate and remain covered by the TUI parity workflow.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the contract suite fails with `Every runnable test must be selected or explicitly exempted with a reason` and lists `interactive/statusline-parity.test.ts`, `interactive/tui-editor-parity.test.ts`, and `interactive/tui-input-ownership.test.ts`.

After: the same suite passes all 16 tests, and the three suites themselves pass 22 tests in about 118 seconds locally.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Local Linux checkout, Node.js 22, dependencies installed with the pinned pnpm via corepack, no sandbox. The changed contract test reads repository files and does not depend on the host runtime beyond Node and `git`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the three suites will not run on every PR through the no-AK gate. They remain covered by the `tui-parity` workflow, which triggers on PRs touching integration tests or packages and runs all three renderer/runtime legs.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS and Windows runners; the contract test is platform-independent and only reads tracked files. Enrolling these suites in the no-AK gate would need a separate runtime-budget decision.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

prs.title: fix(ui): bottom-align short VP content so blank space is at top
prs.body:
## What this PR does

In VP mode (`useTerminalBuffer`, default on), when the conversation fits within the viewport the content was top-aligned, leaving a blank gap between the last message and the composer (reported in #9300, happens in every session). This bottom-aligns short bottom-stuck content: blank space moves to the TOP and the latest message sits directly above the composer, matching standard chat TUIs.

Implementation: in `VirtualizedList`, when `isStickingToBottom` and content fits (`maxScroll === 0`), compute `bottomAlignGap = scrollableContainerHeight - totalHeight`, render it as a leading spacer, and keep the root at full `containerHeight` so there is room. Overflow (`maxScroll > 0`) and scrolled-away cases are unchanged.

## Why it's needed

#9300: default-on VP mode showed a large blank area between the last message and the composer in every session (short conversations and collapsed thinking blocks). High-frequency, default-on visual regression on the primary surface — worth a quick fix.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/components/shared/VirtualizedList.test.tsx` — 32 tests pass, including the 3 updated to the new bottom-aligned layout.
2. `npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/components/MainContent.test.tsx packages/cli/src/ui/components/shared/ScrollableList.test.tsx` — 36 pass (no layout regression).
3. Manual (iTerm2, VP mode): start a short session — content should sit at the bottom above the composer with blank at top; collapse a thinking block (Ctrl+O) — released space appears at top, not between content and composer.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: content top-aligned, blank gap between last message and composer. After: content bottom-aligned, blank at top. (Needs a live terminal to visually confirm; unit tests pin the new frame layout.)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️ needs manual confirm (reported on iTerm2) |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅ (unit tests) |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: changes the short-content layout from top-aligned/collapsed to bottom-aligned; three tests that pinned the old collapse behavior were updated to the new expectation. Scrolling/overflow math is untouched (`scrollableContainerHeight` unchanged).
- Not validated / out of scope: live iTerm2 visual confirmation (reporter's environment); height-overestimation cases where `totalHeight >= containerHeight` (those already bottom-show via `clampedScrollTop = maxScroll`).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #9300

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

VP 模式（默认开启）下，当会话内容高度小于视口时，内容顶部对齐，导致最后一条消息与输入框之间出现大片空白（#9300，每个 session 都出现）。本 PR 将短的、贴底的内容改为底部对齐：空白移到顶部，最新消息紧贴输入框上方，与主流 chat TUI 一致。

实现：`VirtualizedList` 中当 `isStickingToBottom` 且内容放得下（`maxScroll === 0`）时，计算 `bottomAlignGap = scrollableContainerHeight - totalHeight` 作为顶部占位，并保持 root 为满 `containerHeight`。溢出或已上滚的场景不变。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：短内容布局从顶部对齐/折叠改为底部对齐，3 个固定旧行为的测试已更新；滚动数学未动。
- 未验证：iTerm2 真机视觉确认；`totalHeight >= containerHeight` 的高度高估场景（该场景本就通过 `clampedScrollTop = maxScroll` 底部显示）。
- 破坏性变更：无。

</details>

prs.title: feat(cli): support exact-version updates without npm discovery
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds `qwen update --target-version <version>` for standalone installations. An explicit target skips npm version discovery and installs that exact release through the existing download and verification flow, including `QWEN_UPDATE_BASE_URL`. Omitting the option preserves normal update discovery.

Concrete stable and prerelease versions accept an optional leading `v`. Explicit requests allow same-version reinstalls and downgrades. Invalid targets are rejected before downloading, and a downloaded executable reporting a different version is rejected before activation. Unsupported installation methods return an actionable error instead of suggesting an unpinned upgrade. Help and error text are localized.

## Why it's needed

Operators may already have selected a release while npm registry access is unavailable. Configuring a reachable artifact source alone does not help because the current update command performs registry discovery first. Explicit selection makes that dependency unnecessary and prevents discovery from choosing a different release.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Run an explicit-version update with a custom HTTPS release root while npm registry access is unavailable. It should install exactly the selected version without invoking npm or contacting a registry.
- Try a concrete prerelease, a same-version reinstall and an explicit downgrade. Each should use the specified version and retain the previous installation for rollback.
- Try a mutable tag, malformed version, missing argument, unavailable archive, incorrect checksum or an archive whose executable reports a different version. Failures must preserve the original installation and clean up update locks and temporary files.
- For a non-standalone installation, expect a nonzero exit and instructions to install the selected version manually, without an unpinned package-manager command.
- Omit the target option and confirm that normal version discovery remains in use.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the installed CLI's update help has no target-version option; source always runs version discovery before downloading.

After: focused unit tests pass, and isolated CLI tests use a local HTTPS release source with registry access unavailable to verify exact installation and failure preservation. Detailed E2E evidence is posted separately.

Validation: full build, workspace typecheck, bundle, 170 focused tests, changed-file ESLint and Prettier checks passed. The npm lockfile was used for final validation; the optional pnpm layout exceeded an unrelated document-export asset budget, while the npm build passed that gate.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | Tested: build, typecheck, unit tests and isolated CLI E2E |
| Windows | Not tested locally |
| Linux | Baseline update help only; new implementation not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 22.23.1. E2E runs use isolated home directories and disposable installations, a local HTTPS server with a temporary trusted CA, and network/subprocess guards. Downloaded fixtures contain a real Node runtime and a small version-reporting CLI; this verifies updater behavior, not the functionality of a complete new release. No real installation was updated.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: explicit requests intentionally permit reinstalls and downgrades. Version equality is now checked before activation for all standalone update entrypoints.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows deferred replacement, full release-package acceptance, daemon/UI upgrade orchestration and release approval policies.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: existing calls without the option retain version discovery; malformed versions are rejected more strictly.

## Linked Issues

Closes #11484

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

为独立安装新增 `qwen update --target-version <version>`。指定目标时跳过 npm 版本查询，通过现有下载与校验流程安装该精确版本，并继续支持 `QWEN_UPDATE_BASE_URL`。不指定参数时保留原有版本查询行为。

支持具体稳定版和预发布版本，以及可选的 `v` 前缀。显式请求允许同版本重装和降级。非法目标在下载前拒绝；下载后若程序报告的版本与目标不一致，则在激活前拒绝。不支持的安装方式返回可操作的错误提示，避免建议一个未固定版本的升级命令。帮助与错误文案已本地化。

## 需求背景

用户可能已经确定要安装的版本，但无法访问 npm registry。仅配置可访问的制品源仍然不够，因为当前升级命令会先查询 registry。指定版本可以移除这个依赖，并避免版本发现选择另一个版本。

## 审查者验证计划

### 验证方法

- 在 npm registry 不可用时，结合自定义 HTTPS 下载源执行指定版本升级。应准确安装目标版本，不调用 npm，也不访问 registry。
- 验证具体预发布版本、同版本重装和显式降级。每种情况均应使用指定版本，并保留旧安装以供回退。
- 验证可变标签、非法版本、缺少参数、制品不存在、校验不匹配和包内程序版本不匹配。失败必须保留旧安装，并清理锁与临时文件。
- 非独立安装应返回非零退出码，提示手动安装指定版本，不输出未固定版本的包管理器升级命令。
- 不提供目标参数时，应继续执行原有版本查询。

### 修改前后证据

修改前：已安装 CLI 的升级帮助中没有指定版本参数；源码在下载前始终查询版本。

修改后：相关单测通过；隔离 CLI 测试使用本地 HTTPS 制品源，在 registry 不可用的条件下验证准确安装及失败保护。详细 E2E 证据单独评论发布。

验证通过：完整构建、工作区类型检查、bundle、170 项相关测试，以及改动文件的 ESLint 和 Prettier 检查。最终验证使用 npm 锁文件；可选 pnpm 布局触发了无关的文档导出体积限制，npm 构建通过了同一门禁。

### 测试平台

- macOS：构建、类型检查、单测和隔离 CLI E2E 已验证。
- Windows：未在本地验证。
- Linux：仅检查基线升级帮助，未在本地验证新实现。

Node.js 22.23.1。E2E 使用隔离 HOME、临时安装、本地 HTTPS 服务、临时受信 CA，以及网络和子进程监测。下载制品由真实 Node 运行时和精简的版本输出 CLI 组成，证明的是升级器行为，而非完整新版本的功能验收。未升级任何真实安装。

prs.title: fix(memory): report omitted index entries at write time
prs.body:
## What this PR does

I make rebuilt memory indexes name index-budget entry omissions and scan-capped topic-file omissions separately, with up to three bounded names per set. The next prompt preserves the writer's diagnostic. Counts remain separate because one grouped team entry can represent several files.

Scan-only omissions describe an incomplete catalog and give a file-count remedy. Budget advice targets durable topic-file changes, not hand edits that disappear on rebuilding. Overlong generated entries already omit descriptions, so their remedy names paths and frontmatter names. Reader length advice is used only when the candidate character budget binds, never for a pure line-count overflow. Extra blank notice separators no longer claim lost entries. Arbitrary-root rebuilding reports scan omissions while preserving its existing ordering.

## Why it's needed

The writer previously emitted a generic warning, or no warning when the scan cap hid files. The reader could not recover those names. This follows the agreed diagnostic scope in #14877; retention and headless post-write lifecycle remain out of scope.

## Reviewer Test Plan

1. Rebuild 190 long-description topics: the same 165 entries survive, with 25 omissions counted and bounded examples named. Changing only the generated index must not be presented as a durable remedy.
2. Rebuild 205 short topics through scoped and arbitrary-root paths: retain the same 200 entries, report five omitted files and name bounded examples. Preserve newest-first private selection, deterministic normal team selection and the compatibility arbitrary-root mtime order.
3. Check mixed budget/file omissions and grouped team entries: separate units, no mixed total, intact links and no deleted files.
4. Load exactly 200 entries plus either known writer notice with extra blank separators: preserve all entries without a false reader truncation warning.
5. Combine a bounded writer notice with genuine reader overflow: both diagnostics must survive. Short multiline or oversized warning-like tails must remain budgeted.
6. Check short bidi/backtick names, astral name bounds, live team-root symlink rejection, and the existing count-versus-length controls.

### Evidence

Current PR head: **5f93cd5dcb**, after a normal merge of main **8a9ae631a3** to include lint-gate change **0ac1fcca9179**. All ten PR files and the complete net PR diff are byte-identical to the audited **0ff2926534** change. On current **5f93cd5dcb**, upstream lint/static, no-AK integration (276 tests), TUI parity and no-flicker passed. The [Linux job](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39709809487/job/119598458730) passed CLI (44,058; 101 skipped), core (38,220 passed, including all 32 diagnostic regressions; 22 skipped) and web-shell unit tests (12,810); their uploaded JUnit reports contain no failures/errors. The job remains red: standalone provisioning received HTTP 502 from npm for Bun 1.3.14 before executing the standalone regression; subsequent script tests did not run. That provisioning script is byte-identical on exact base 8a9ae631a3 and observed main 7091697f. The [exact-base run](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39701910009/job/119578366431) completed its Node/Bun standalone probes and later failed a different no-AK wiring assertion—not this download failure or a fully green baseline. I changed no code, thresholds or retries for this. The Linux job needs a maintainer-side rerun; current browser smoke and automated review are still pending. On validated source commit **0ff2926534**, before the main merge, Linux/Node 22: root build/bundle, repository typecheck, formatting of all ten PR files, lint of the seven TypeScript files, the full memory suite (1,136 passed, one existing macOS-only skip; all 32 diagnostic regressions passed), built CLI version/help, startup bundle closure and the restored tracked-tree check passed. My first October 22 [attempt](https://github.com/jabrailkhalil/qwen-code/actions/runs/39701862279) remains red: my fork-only harness did not recognize Vitest's serialized `.rejects` assertion for the intended symlink mutation. I corrected only that classifier, not product tests or expected counts. [Validation and artifacts](https://github.com/jabrailkhalil/qwen-code/actions/runs/39706725760). On exact previous d115d1ef production source, the 15 selected new cases produced ten expected assertion failures and five passing controls. All five targeted mutations were detected (six expected assertion failures and two passing controls), without setup failures; source was restored after each control. Fresh isolated Windows source-runtime verification passed 14 grouped records, including 24 separator/line-ending variants, all scoped/arbitrary-root modes and relocated project storage. Retained bodies/order and 205-topic content/mtime manifests matched the baseline; four large-notice/grouping fixtures stayed at or below 888/1024 units. The same 14 grouped witnesses passed again independently on merged head **5f93cd5dcb**, from a freshly generated 152-input source bundle whose digest matches 0ff29265. This is new-base source sanity, not binary E2E or a completed new-base CI claim.

Historical qualifications: the d115d1ef author aggregate preflight remains red because a fork-only validation workflow lacked size-baseline metadata; that workflow is absent from this PR. Exact-d115 upstream workspace/script tests and startup closure passed. Those are historical receipts, not a full-repository preflight claim for this head. The d115 browser smoke was 348 passed/3 failed; the same symptoms were reproduced on its integrated base and observed main in [the focused comparison](https://github.com/jabrailkhalil/qwen-code/actions/runs/39691342202). The hover outcome was intermittent, not fixed. I made no browser UI/test change. Current upstream review and CI remain separate gates.

Windows x64 / Node 22.21.1: isolated actual-source fallback, not interactive CLI/TUI/ACP/model E2E. Linux / Node 22: remote checks above. macOS not tested; no provider credentials or model requests used.

## Risk & Scope

The 200-file scan cap, 200-line cap, 25,000 UTF-16-unit body budget, 150-unit ordinary-entry priority, intact paths and non-deletion are unchanged. Only a known trailing single-paragraph writer notice of at most 1024 units is exempt from entry budgeting; legacy wording remains recognized. Existing scanner compatibility exports and trust rules are retained. No migration, routing, retention or headless lifecycle change.

Design: [English](https://github.com/jabrailkhalil/qwen-code/blob/0ff2926534c784b11ba28ccee8cb8a898cc5bccc/docs/design/memory-index-omission-notice.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/jabrailkhalil/qwen-code/blob/0ff2926534c784b11ba28ccee8cb8a898cc5bccc/docs/design/memory-index-omission-notice.zh-CN.md).

Fixes #14877.

prs.title: fix(core): widen the agent workspace lock retry budget (#14028)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Raises the cross-process workspace lock's acquisition retry budget from 10 retries (5–100ms randomized exponential backoff, ~0.65–1.3s worst case) to 30 retries (~5s worst case), matching the budget the Agent Board lock already uses for the same two-tier locking pattern. Everything else about the lock is unchanged: the in-process mutex still serializes same-process writers, and stale-lock breaking (`stale: 10_000`) still recovers a dead holder's lock after 10 seconds.

## Why it's needed

`main` CI failed on `agent workspace lock > loses no roster update when two processes write at once` (#14028). The test spawns two child processes that each perform 8 read-modify-write roster updates under the store's file lock. On an oversubscribed CI host, one holder's critical section — an fsync-bound atomic JSON write — can outlast the ~1s retry budget, so the competing process exhausted its retries, exited with `ELOCKED: Lock file is already being held`, and failed the test. CI's `--retry=2` does not help because every attempt on a badly placed host hits the same contention. I reproduced this locally: pinned to 2 CPUs with CPU and fsync competitors, the pre-fix code failed 6 of 30 rounds with ELOCKED; with this change, 30 of 30 rounds passed. A longer wait is strictly safer here: the lock guards a low-frequency roster/registry store, so waiting a few seconds for a slow live holder is always preferable to erroring.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Confirm the change is confined to the workspace store's lock options and that the concurrency test passes: run `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/agents/workspace-agents/workspace-lock.test.ts` and expect 1 passed test. To observe the original failure mode, revert the one-line change (`retries: 30` back to `10`) and run the same test on a heavily loaded machine (or pinned to few CPUs with competing load): the worker processes intermittently exit 1 with `ELOCKED: Lock file is already being held`. With the fix, the waiters simply wait out the slow holder instead of erroring.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (no user-visible behavior change; the observable difference is CI stability under host contention: before, 6/30 contended probe rounds failed with ELOCKED; after, 0/30 failed).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests under `packages/core` (vitest), plus a local contention harness pinning the test scenario to 2 CPUs with busy CPU/fsync competitors.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a waiter now holds on for up to ~5s (was ~1s) before failing lock acquisition when a live holder is slow; a dead holder's lock is still broken after 10s via the unchanged stale detection, so crash recovery latency is unaffected.
- Not validated / out-of-scope: macOS and Windows lanes (left to CI; the change is a platform-independent timing budget). A deeper hardening — aborting a transaction whose lock is compromised mid-flight instead of only warning — is deliberately out of scope for this flake fix.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14028

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

将跨进程 workspace 锁的获取重试预算从 10 次(5–100ms 随机指数退避,最坏约 0.65–1.3 秒)提高到 30 次(最坏约 5 秒),与 Agent Board 锁在相同双层锁模式下已有的预算一致。锁的其他行为完全不变:进程内互斥锁仍然串行化同进程写入者,过期锁打破机制(`stale: 10_000`)仍然会在 10 秒后回收已崩溃持锁者留下的锁。

## 为什么需要

`main` 分支 CI 在 `agent workspace lock > loses no roster update when two processes write at once` 上失败(#14028)。该测试派生两个子进程,各自在存储的文件锁下执行 8 次 roster 读-改-写更新。在超额订阅的 CI 主机上,持锁者的一次临界区——带 fsync 的原子 JSON 写入——可能超过约 1 秒的重试预算,导致竞争进程重试耗尽后以 `ELOCKED: Lock file is already being held` 退出,测试失败。CI 的 `--retry=2` 帮不上忙,因为在被调度到繁忙主机时,每次尝试都会遇到同样的争用。我已在本地复现:固定到 2 个 CPU 并加入 CPU 与 fsync 竞争负载时,修复前的代码在 30 轮中有 6 轮以 ELOCKED 失败;应用本改动后,30 轮全部通过。此处更长的等待严格更安全:该锁守护的是低频的 roster/注册表存储,为一个缓慢的活跃持锁者多等几秒永远优于直接报错。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

确认改动仅限于 workspace 存储的锁参数,且并发测试通过:运行 `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/agents/workspace-agents/workspace-lock.test.ts`,预期 1 个测试通过。若要观察原始失败模式,可将这一行改动回退(`retries: 30` 改回 `10`),并在负载较重的机器上(或绑定到少量 CPU 并施加竞争负载)运行同一测试:worker 进程会间歇性地以退出码 1 失败,报 `ELOCKED: Lock file is already being held`。应用修复后,等待者会等待缓慢的持锁者完成,而不是报错。

### 前后对照证据

N/A(无用户可见的行为变化;可观察的差异是主机争用下的 CI 稳定性:修复前,30 轮带载探测有 6 轮以 ELOCKED 失败;修复后,30 轮无一失败)。

### 已测试平台

|     系统    |  状态  |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 已测试 |

### 环境(可选)

`packages/core` 下的单元测试(vitest),以及一个将测试场景固定到 2 个 CPU 并施加 CPU/fsync 竞争负载的本地争用 harness。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍:当活跃持锁者较慢时,等待者现在最多坚持约 5 秒(原来约 1 秒)才会放弃锁获取;已崩溃持锁者的锁仍会通过未改动的过期检测在 10 秒后被打破,因此崩溃恢复延迟不受影响。
- 未验证 / 超出范围:macOS 与 Windows 通道(交由 CI 覆盖;本改动是平台无关的计时预算)。更深一层的加固——在锁中途被夺时中止事务而不是仅告警——刻意不纳入本次抖动修复的范围。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明:无。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #14028

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): allow hosts to inject disabled catalog models
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Lets an embedding host pass extra models that are not currently usable. Those models appear in the composer picker as disabled rows. Hover or keyboard focus opens a hint that can be plain text or host-owned UI, including action buttons such as authorize.

The custom hint uses a `mount(container, info)` slot that returns `{ update, dispose }`, so Solid and vanilla DOM hosts do not need to construct React elements. A colliding id stays on the daemon-available row and remains selectable.

## Why it's needed

Hosts often have a product catalog of models the current account cannot use. They still need those models visible in the input picker, with a reason and an optional next action, without treating this as backend authorization.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Pass `unavailableModels` (and optionally `mountUnavailableModelTooltip`) into `WebShell` or `WebShellWithProviders`. Open the composer model picker.

- Injected models appear after available ones and cannot be selected.
- Hover and focus show the host string tooltip, or host-mounted content when the mount function succeeds.
- A button inside the hint does not switch models and does not close the picker.
- Search still finds the disabled row.
- `/model`, Settings, StatusBar, and footer `availableModels` stay unchanged.

Unit evidence: `packages/web-shell` vitest for `composerModels`, `UnavailableModelTooltip`, `ChatEditor`, `ChatPane`, and `SideTaskPanel` (476 tests in those files). Also `npm run typecheck --workspace=@qwen-code/web-shell`. Browser evidence: `packages/web-shell` Playwright `web-shell.unavailable-models.spec.ts`.

![Host string tooltip on a disabled model](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/raw/feat/web-shell-unavailable-models/docs/design/assets/web-shell-unavailable-models-tooltip.png)

Host-mounted authorize action in the hint:

![Host-mounted authorize action in the hint](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/raw/feat/web-shell-unavailable-models/docs/design/assets/web-shell-unavailable-models-authorize.png)

|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested (unit + typecheck + Playwright capture) |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Local unit tests, package typecheck, and Playwright Chromium capture in an isolated worktree from latest `main`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the hint is a hover-intent popover nested in the model picker; clicks in the host mount must not dismiss the parent list. The picker now ignores pointer events on the hint.

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): Add durable manual context compression
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds idle-only manual context compression for Workspace-bound public Managed Sessions through the public API and the existing WebShell context-usage popover. Compression is a durable operation with actor-scoped idempotency, its own compaction revision, native capability negotiation and recovery barriers. It reuses Core compression without creating a user Turn, preserves the audit transcript, and restores the compressed model history for later Turns and reopened Sessions.

The implementation persists chunked candidates before PostCompact, commits the compaction and its terminal maintenance result atomically, fences stale writers, and reconciles uncertain submissions from their original evidence. Automatic compression shares the persisted history restoration path, including pending input and tool-result recovery. The browser resumes the original operation after reload and shows context usage as unknown until the next primary-model observation.

## Why it's needed

Managed Sessions currently provide no manual compression action, and their model-input projection does not apply persisted compression checkpoints. An entry point alone would therefore lose the compression on the next Turn. This change provides the action together with durable model-history restoration and recovery, while keeping approval policies and the Workspace installation revision independent.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open a Workspace-bound public Session as an OPERATOR or OWNER on a compatible Harness. Compress from the context-usage popover while idle; expect HTTP 202 and a queryable context_compression operation, with no new user Turn. Unsupported Harnesses and unauthorized callers must not expose an enabled WebShell action.
2. Race compression with a queued or running Turn, pending approval, unsettled Hook, model/CWD change or close. Expect session_context_busy for conflicts. Retry the original actor/session/key and body to obtain the original operation; changing the body must return idempotency_conflict, and a new request with a stale revision must be refused.
3. Compress a long history, send another Turn, reopen the Session and exercise writer recovery. Confirm that model requests use the compressed history, tool calls and results remain paired, and the original chat records remain readable. Cover snapshots larger than 64 KiB and NOOP outcomes.
4. Reload during compression. Confirm that the original key/operation is resumed without a second POST, conflicting controls stay disabled, the draft survives, and completion enables controls while displaying context usage as unknown until a real primary-model observation.
5. Exercise interruption before and after candidate persistence, PostCompact and final commit. A fenced old summary must not publish a candidate, dispatch a Hook or commit history; uncertain acceptance and unknown Hooks must reconcile existing evidence, and a duplicate terminal receipt must not erase a later usage observation.

Local validation passed root build/typecheck/bundle, focused Core/CLI/WebShell checks, the full Managed Agent Server and Java SDK verification, MySQL concurrency tests and Hosted process-fault regressions. A separate PR comment records counts and validation boundaries.

### Evidence (Before & After)

| Scenario | Before | After / observed evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Managed manual action | No Managed compression endpoint or supported WebShell action. | Public and WebShell compression admission contracts pass; browser smoke exposes the existing popover action at 1280 px and 390 px. |
| Reload during compression | No durable manual operation to resume. | Browser smoke records one compression POST across reload, no Turn submission, a retained draft and enabled controls after settlement. |
| Model history after compression and reopen | The summarizer receives the original history containing RAW_BEFORE_COMPRESSION. | Actual Hosted Config/Core plus loopback OpenAI HTTP integration observes MANUAL_MEMORY_BLUE in the next primary-model request and no RAW_BEFORE_COMPRESSION; both original audit records remain. |
| Usage after completion | Previously observed occupancy describes the old model context. | Browser and persistence checks show unknown occupancy after compaction and preserve later real-model observations across receipt replay. |

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64, Node.js 24.19.0, JDK 21.0.8, Maven 3.9.14, disposable MySQL 8.4.11 and Chromium. Model-facing verification uses deterministic providers or a loopback OpenAI HTTP fixture with the actual Hosted configuration and Core engine; no paid upstream model was called.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: interrupted pure summarization may be attempted again after writer fencing, so model billing may repeat while history commits at most once. Unknown Hook execution remains recovery_blocked until original execution evidence resolves it. Concurrency and durable history recovery are the main review focus.
- Not validated / out of scope: production-model Java HTTP → SDK → Harness deployment acceptance, local Windows/Linux execution, custom compression instructions, busy-session compression, queued compression and new slash-command dispatch. The process-fault profile is regression coverage, not a new live public compression acceptance test.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: additive API contract 1.81.0, context-compression/1 Harness capability and incremental schema V16; published baseline migrations are unchanged. Deploy schema and Java/Broker readers first, then Harness writers, then WebShell. Stop new admission and settle accepted operations before rollback.

The synchronized design documents cover decisions, constraints, acceptance criteria and deployment boundaries: [English design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-context-compression-15080/docs/design/2026-10-22-managed-context-compression.md) and [中文设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-context-compression-15080/docs/design/2026-10-22-managed-context-compression.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Closes #15080

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

为绑定 Workspace 的 PUBLIC Managed Session 增加仅空闲可用的手动上下文压缩，提供公开 API，并复用 WebShell 现有上下文用量弹层。压缩以持久化 Operation 执行，具备按 actor 隔离的幂等语义、独立压缩 revision、原生能力协商和恢复屏障。复用 Core 压缩，不创建用户 Turn，保留审计聊天记录，并在后续 Turn 和重新打开 Session 后恢复压缩后的模型历史。

实现在 PostCompact 前持久化分片候选，将压缩快照和终局维护结果原子提交，隔离旧 writer，并依据原始证据对账接纳结果不确定的提交。自动压缩共享持久化历史恢复路径，包括待发送输入及工具结果恢复。浏览器刷新后继续原 Operation，并在下一次主模型真实观测前将上下文用量显示为未知。

## 为什么需要

Managed Session 当前没有手动压缩入口，模型输入投影也不会应用已持久化的压缩检查点。因此，仅增加入口会在下一 Turn 丢失压缩效果。本改动同时提供入口、持久化模型历史恢复和故障恢复，并保持审批策略和 Workspace 安装 revision 相互独立。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 使用 OPERATOR 或 OWNER 身份，在兼容 Harness 上打开绑定 Workspace 的 PUBLIC Session。空闲时从上下文用量弹层压缩；预期返回 HTTP 202 和可查询的 context_compression Operation，且没有新增用户 Turn。不兼容 Harness 和未授权调用者不应看到启用的 WebShell 入口。
2. 让压缩与排队或执行中的 Turn、待审批 Action、未结算 Hook、模型/CWD 变更及关闭竞争。冲突时预期返回 session_context_busy。相同 actor/session/key 和请求体重试应返回原 Operation；改变请求体应返回 idempotency_conflict，新请求使用过期 revision 应被拒绝。
3. 压缩较长历史，再发起下一 Turn、重新打开 Session 并验证 writer 恢复。确认模型请求使用压缩历史、工具调用和结果仍然配对、原始聊天记录仍可读取。覆盖超过 64 KiB 的快照及 NOOP 结果。
4. 压缩过程中刷新。确认沿用原键和 Operation，不产生第二次 POST；冲突控件持续禁用，草稿保留；完成后控件启用，上下文用量显示未知，直到主模型给出真实观测。
5. 在候选持久化、PostCompact 和最终提交前后注入中断。已隔离的旧摘要请求不得发布候选、分发 Hook 或提交历史；接纳不确定和未知 Hook 必须对账原始证据；重复终局回执不得清除之后产生的用量观测。

本地已通过根 build/typecheck/bundle、相关 Core/CLI/WebShell 检查、Managed Agent Server 和 Java SDK 完整验证、MySQL 并发测试及 Hosted 进程故障回归。独立 PR 评论记录测试数量和验证边界。

### 证据（前后对比）

| 场景 | 改动前 | 改动后 / 已观察证据 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Managed 手动入口 | 没有 Managed 压缩接口或支持的 WebShell 入口。 | 公开及 WebShell 压缩准入合约通过；1280 px 和 390 px 浏览器冒烟测试显示现有弹层中的入口。 |
| 压缩过程中刷新 | 没有可恢复的持久化手动 Operation。 | 浏览器冒烟记录刷新前后只有一次压缩 POST、没有 Turn 提交、草稿保留且结算后控件启用。 |
| 压缩并重新打开后的模型历史 | 摘要请求接收包含 RAW_BEFORE_COMPRESSION 的原始历史。 | 实际 Hosted Config/Core 与本地 OpenAI HTTP 集成观察到下一主模型请求包含 MANUAL_MEMORY_BLUE 且不包含 RAW_BEFORE_COMPRESSION；两条原始审计记录仍保留。 |
| 完成后的用量 | 已有占用观测描述旧模型上下文。 | 浏览器和持久化检查显示压缩后占用未知，回执重放保留之后的真实模型观测。 |

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 已测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未测试 |

### 环境（可选）

macOS arm64、Node.js 24.19.0、JDK 21.0.8、Maven 3.9.14、一次性 MySQL 8.4.11 和 Chromium。模型链路验证使用确定性 provider，或通过本地 OpenAI HTTP fixture 运行实际 Hosted 配置及 Core 引擎；未调用付费上游模型。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：纯摘要请求中断后，可以在隔离旧 writer 后重新尝试，因此模型计费可能重复，但历史至多提交一次。未知 Hook 执行保持 recovery_blocked，直到原执行证据确定结果。并发和持久化历史恢复是主要审阅重点。
- 未验证 / 范围外：使用生产模型的 Java HTTP → SDK → Harness 部署验收、本地 Windows/Linux 执行、自定义压缩指令、忙碌会话压缩、压缩排队及新 slash-command 分发。进程故障 profile 提供回归覆盖，不是新增的公开压缩在线验收。
- 兼容性变更 / 迁移说明：增加 API 合约 1.81.0、context-compression/1 Harness 能力及增量 schema V16；已发布 baseline 迁移不变。先部署 schema 和 Java/Broker reader，再部署 Harness writer，最后部署 WebShell。回滚前停止新准入并结算已接纳 Operation。

同步的设计文档包含设计决策、约束、验收标准及部署边界：[英文设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-context-compression-15080/docs/design/2026-10-22-managed-context-compression.md) 和 [中文设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-context-compression-15080/docs/design/2026-10-22-managed-context-compression.zh-CN.md)。

Closes #15080

prs.title: test(sdk-java): pin the idle watchdog tick without a wall-clock race
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Stabilizes the SDK Java test that pins the Hosted Harness idle-abort window. The test now reads the watchdog's queued tick delay and asserts it is at most 250 ms, which pins the published `max(100 ms, budget / 10)` interval when the stream is created instead of relying on a wall-clock ceiling to distinguish the correct interval from a half-bound one. The timeout still has to arrive after the budget, and a generous ceiling still catches a watchdog that never fires.

## Why it's needed

`HostedHarnessClientTest.anIdleAbortLandsInsideThePublishedWindow` failed on main in the SDK Java fast lane on `22a80c2cbc32` (run 39604367626). Its 2400 ms ceiling sat only about 300 ms above the ~2100 ms nominal abort, and that ceiling was carrying the mutation check for a half-bound 1000 ms tick. On a loaded runner the scheduler can fire the 200 ms tick late enough to cross 2400 ms even though the interval is correct, so the test reported a product failure that did not exist. Reading the tick directly keeps the mutation coverage — a 1000 ms or 400 ms interval fails immediately — without tying the assertion to OS scheduling latency.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the affected idle-abort case: it should pass in about three seconds on the shipped code. Then temporarily make the watchdog tick half the budget and rerun: the case should fail in well under a second at the interval assertion, before the consumer ever parks, rather than after the two-second wait. Revert the change and run the whole client test class; all 216 cases should pass.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the abort had to land before 2400 ms; the nominal shipped abort is ~2100 ms and a half-bound 1000 ms tick aborts at ~2700 ms, leaving only ~300 ms for scheduler latency. After: the queued tick delay is asserted at <=250 ms (the shipped 200 ms tick), which catches both the half-bound and fifth-bound interval mutants in 0.3 s; the timeout still has to arrive at >=1950 ms, and the fire-at-all ceiling is 5 s.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Local Linux x86_64, Temurin JDK 21.0.12.1, Maven 3.9.11; repository build, typecheck, and lint via npm.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the wall-clock upper assertion is now a coarse 5 s ceiling, because the interval itself is pinned structurally; a mutation that made the scheduler fire the tick extremely late would still pass on a pathologically starved runner, but that is not the failure mode this test covers.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS and Windows lanes were not run locally, and the CI runner's exact scheduling delay was not reproduced; the fix removes the dependency on that delay rather than tuning it.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; test-only change.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15097

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

稳定 SDK Java 中固定 Hosted Harness 空闲中止窗口的测试。测试现在直接读取看门狗排队 tick 的延迟，并断言其不超过 250 ms；这样在流创建时就固定了公布的 `max(100 ms, budget / 10)` 间隔，而不是依赖墙钟上限来区分正确间隔与半预算间隔。超时仍然必须在预算之后到达，宽松的上限仍然能抓住“看门狗根本不触发”的情况。

## 为什么需要

`HostedHarnessClientTest.anIdleAbortLandsInsideThePublishedWindow` 在 main 的 SDK Java 快速通道 `22a80c2cbc32`（run 39604367626）上失败。它的 2400 ms 上限只比约 2100 ms 的标称中止高约 300 ms，而这个上限当时还承担着对半预算 1000 ms tick 的变异检查。在负载较高的 runner 上，调度器可能把 200 ms 的 tick 推迟到超过 2400 ms，即使间隔本身是正确的，于是测试报告了一个并不存在的产品故障。直接读取 tick 既保留了变异覆盖——1000 ms 或 400 ms 的间隔会立刻失败——又不再把断言绑在操作系统调度延迟上。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

运行受影响的空闲中止用例：在已发布的代码上它应在约三秒内通过。然后临时把看门狗 tick 改成预算的一半并重跑：该用例应在不到一秒内、在消费者停住之前就于间隔断言处失败，而不是等满两秒之后。还原改动并运行整个客户端测试类；216 个用例都应通过。

### 证据（修改前 / 修改后）

修改前：中止必须落在 2400 ms 之前；已发布代码的标称中止约为 2100 ms，而半预算的 1000 ms tick 会在约 2700 ms 中止，只给调度延迟留下约 300 ms。修改后：排队 tick 的延迟被断言为 <=250 ms（已发布的 200 ms tick），这能在 0.3 秒内抓住半预算和五分之一预算两种间隔变异；超时仍然必须在 >=1950 ms 之后到达，最终触发上限为 5 秒。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

本地 Linux x86_64、Temurin JDK 21.0.12.1、Maven 3.9.11；仓库的 build、typecheck 与 lint 通过 npm 运行。

## 风险与范围

- 未验证 / 超出范围：未在本地运行 macOS 和 Windows 通道，也未复现 CI runner 的确切调度延迟；本修复消除的是对该延迟的依赖，而不是去调参它。

prs.title: fix(ci): keep the sdk-java host lock out of surviving children
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The Managed Agent gate's fast lane can no longer starve behind a leaked sdk-java host lock. Every child that runs while the lock is held now closes the lock descriptor, so a cancelled step's surviving seed or cache-write-back process can no longer keep the `flock` alive after its shell dies. The workflow pin enforces this for every external command and for both stages of the cache-write-back pipeline, not just for Maven, and the blocked-head lock test now seeds its ticket counter so it is deterministic.

## Why it's needed

Run 39608557201's fast-tier job failed before any test ran: it waited the full 90-minute host-lock budget as the head of the ticket queue (`sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes as queue ticket 84`). The first attempt of the same run and every lock-bearing job on the pool had been timing out the same way, so the flock was held for hours by an unticketed holder.

The MariaDB / full-tier lane closes the lock fd on its Maven children, but its `cp -aln` seed and `tar | tar` cache write-back inherited fd 9. A cancelled job's surviving child can keep the host lock until it exits, wedging the whole shared pool; that is the leak path in the locked section, and it matches the observed multi-hour hold. A local `flock` probe reproduces this: a forked child without `9>&-` keeps the lock after the shell is killed, while `9>&-` releases it with the shell.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Inspect the MariaDB lane's locked section: the `cp` seed, the `mkdir`, and both `tar` stages must close fd 9, while the step shell keeps it so the lock stays held for the whole section and releases at the step boundary. Run the focused workflow and lock tests; the generalized pin should pass, and removing any one of the new `9>&-` closures should make `keeps the host lock out of every child that can outlive the step` fail. The blocked-head lock test should pass repeatedly rather than depending on the spawned acquirer's PID ordering.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for a user-visible surface — this is CI-only. Before: a forked `cp`/`tar` inherited fd 9 and kept the host lock after the step shell was killed. After: those children have no fd 9 and the lock releases with the shell; the local `flock` probe shows the same before/after.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Local Linux checkout with Node 22.23.2. The sandbox's default corepack cache is not writable, so build and Vitest were run with `COREPACK_HOME=/tmp/corepack-home`; that override is sandbox-only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a cancelled job's surviving seed/write-back process can now keep writing after the lock releases. The runner still owns killing it, and the previous behavior — a permanently wedged pool — is strictly worse; the step shell still holds the lock for all normal holds.
- Not validated / out of scope: the real self-hosted cancellation timing cannot be reproduced locally; the fix is verified by the descriptor-lifetime probe and the static pin. Shrinking the 90-minute queue budget or adding pool capacity is out of scope, consistent with the existing fair-lock design.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; the lock's acquisition, wait budget, error signature, and release semantics are unchanged.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15099

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

Managed Agent gate 的 fast 泳道不会再因为 sdk-java 主机锁泄漏而饿死。现在，持有锁期间运行的每个子进程都会关闭锁描述符，因此被取消步骤遗留的预热或缓存回写进程无法在其 shell 死亡后继续让 `flock` 保持存活。工作流校验把这条规则应用到两个加锁步骤里的每个外部命令，以及缓存回写管道的两端，而不只是 Maven；阻塞头部锁测试现在会预置 ticket 计数器，因此是确定性的。

## 为什么需要它

运行 39608557201 的 fast-tier 任务在任何测试开始前就失败了：它作为队列头部等待了整整 90 分钟的主机锁预算（`sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes as queue ticket 84`）。同一次运行的第一次尝试，以及池里所有带锁任务，都以同样方式超时，说明 flock 已被一个没有 ticket 的持有者占用数小时。

MariaDB / full-tier 泳道在其 Maven 子进程上关闭了锁 fd，但它的 `cp -aln` 预热和 `tar | tar` 缓存回写继承了 fd 9。被取消任务遗留的子进程可能一直持有主机锁直到退出，卡死整个共享池；这就是加锁段里的泄漏路径，也与观察到的数小时持锁一致。本地 `flock` 探针可以复现：没有 `9>&-` 的 fork 子进程在 shell 被杀死后仍持有锁，而带 `9>&-` 时锁会随 shell 一起释放。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

检查 MariaDB 泳道的加锁段：`cp` 预热、`mkdir` 和 `tar` 的两端都必须关闭 fd 9，而步骤 shell 仍保留它，因此整个加锁段仍然持锁，并在步骤边界释放。运行相关的工作流与锁测试；泛化后的校验应当通过，而移除任意一个新加的 `9>&-` 都会让 `keeps the host lock out of every child that can outlive the step` 失败。阻塞头部锁测试应当可以重复通过，而不依赖拉起的获取者 PID 顺序。

### 证据（修改前与修改后）

针对用户可见界面为 N/A——这是纯 CI 改动。修改前：fork 出的 `cp`/`tar` 继承 fd 9，在步骤 shell 被杀死后仍持有主机锁。修改后：这些子进程没有 fd 9，锁随 shell 释放；本地 `flock` 探针展示了同样的前后对比。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

本地 Linux 检出环境，Node 22.23.2。沙箱默认的 corepack 缓存不可写，因此 build 和 Vitest 使用 `COREPACK_HOME=/tmp/corepack-home` 运行；该覆盖仅用于沙箱。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：被取消任务遗留的预热/回写进程现在可能在锁释放后继续写入。运行器仍负责终止它，而之前的行为——整个池永久卡死——显然更糟；正常持锁时步骤 shell 仍然持有锁。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：无法在本地复现真实 self-hosted 的取消时序；该修复由描述符生命周期探针和静态校验验证。缩短 90 分钟队列预算或增加池容量超出本 PR 范围，与现有公平锁设计保持一致。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无；锁的获取、等待预算、错误签名和释放语义均未改变。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #15099

prs.title: fix(ci): keep the sdk-java fast tier out of multi-hour lock holds (#15108)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The self-hosted SDK Java integration lane now takes the per-host Maven lock only for the operation that mutates the host-shared Maven cache: the write-back that runs after both of its Maven commands. Its seed is a read-only, best-effort hard-link copy and no longer takes the lock, and its `install` and MySQL `clean verify` resolve from a job-local repository without holding the lock. The integration job's ceiling moves from 200 to 300 minutes so the post-Maven wait fits the same bound. The workflow pins now assert that both Maven commands finish before the lock is acquired and that the write-back runs while it is held. The existing lock design document records the narrower lock scope in both languages. The workflow size baseline is bumped to the new byte size because the added comments are real growth rather than banked slack.

## Why it's needed

The Managed Agent gate failed on `86875ee18b9d` because the fast-tier Java 21 job spent its entire 90-minute wait on the host lock and failed before Maven started. The holder was the MySQL integration lane from another run: it held the lock for about three hours while running `clean verify`, even though that command already resolves from a job-local repository. The holder's own ceiling (200 minutes) is longer than the fast-tier job's entire ceiling (150 minutes), so no wait budget can absorb that hold; any fast-tier job arriving during one is guaranteed to fail. That is a deterministic failure of a required check, not a queue race.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Read the integration job's single lock-bearing step in `.github/workflows/sdk-java.yml`: the seed, `mvn install`, `cd`, and `mvn -Pmysql-integration clean verify checkstyle:check` all run before the lock acquisition, and only the `mkdir` plus `tar` cache write-back runs while the lock is held. Run the pins with `npx vitest run scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/sdk-java-lock.test.js scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js` and confirm all pass. To see the invariant is actually witnessed, temporarily move the lock block above the seed and re-run the workflow pins: the three tests named in the report should fail, and restoring the fix should return them to green. On the next pool run of the integration lane, its lock hold should be seconds rather than the duration of the suite, and a concurrently arriving fast-tier job should reach Maven.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the failed job's annotation read `sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes as queue ticket 98; head of queue is 0000000098-3253637`, and the integration job in run 39628985638 held the lock from 15:53:59Z to 18:57:29Z. After: the integration lane only holds the lock for its cache write-back, so the longest hold is a fast-tier suite again.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Workflow pins and repository checks ran on Linux. The Java/Maven suites and the real self-hosted lock scenario were not run locally because this environment has no JDK or Maven; the deterministic CI run is the final verification for those.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the integration lane's Maven run is no longer serialized with the fast tier on a shared host. That is deliberate: it already uses a job-local repository and a per-job database, the pool's other long Maven suites do not take this lock at all, and the alternative is a required check that cannot survive the hold. If host contention returns, the lock can be re-scoped with a shard rather than restored as a multi-hour hold.
- Not validated / out of scope: the exact self-hosted runner timings and the Java suites; this PR does not change Maven commands, test selection, or the lock helper itself.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The lock path, helper, ticket queue, 5400 s budget, and error signature are unchanged.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15108

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

self-hosted SDK Java 集成车道现在只在唯一会修改宿主共享 Maven 缓存的操作周围获取每宿主机 Maven 锁：两条 Maven 命令之后执行的缓存回写。它的播种是一次只读、尽力而为的硬链接拷贝，不再取锁；它的 `install` 和 MySQL `clean verify` 从 job 本地仓库解析依赖，不持锁运行。集成 job 的上限从 200 分钟移到 300 分钟，让 Maven 之后的等待落在同一个边界内。工作流 pin 现在断言两条 Maven 命令都在取锁之前结束，而回写在持锁期间运行。现有锁设计文档用中英双语记录了更窄的锁范围。工作流尺寸基线已更新到新的字节数，因为新增注释是真实增长，而不是囤积余量。

## 为什么需要

`86875ee18b9d` 上的 Managed Agent gate 失败，是因为快速档 Java 21 job 把整个 90 分钟等待都花在宿主机锁上，在 Maven 启动前就失败了。持锁者是另一次运行的 MySQL 集成车道：它在运行 `clean verify` 时持有锁约三个小时，尽管该命令已经从 job 本地仓库解析依赖。持锁者自己的上限（200 分钟）比快速档 job 的整个上限（150 分钟）还长，因此没有任何等待预算能吸收这段持锁；任何在此期间到达的快速档 job 都必然失败。这是必需检查的确定性失败，不是队列竞争。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

阅读 `.github/workflows/sdk-java.yml` 中集成 job 唯一的持锁 step：播种、`mvn install`、`cd`、`mvn -Pmysql-integration clean verify checkstyle:check` 都在取锁之前运行，只有 `mkdir` 加 `tar` 缓存回写在持锁期间运行。用 `npx vitest run scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/sdk-java-lock.test.js scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js` 运行 pin，确认全部通过。要确认这个不变量确实被见证，可临时把取锁块移到播种之前并重跑工作流 pin：报告中点名的三个测试应当失败，恢复修复后应重新变绿。在下一次池上运行集成车道时，它的持锁时间应是秒级而不是整个套件的时长，同时到达的快速档 job 应当能够进入 Maven。

### 证据（修改前后）

修改前：失败 job 的注解说 `sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes as queue ticket 98; head of queue is 0000000098-3253637`，而 run 39628985638 的集成 job 从 15:53:59Z 持锁到 18:57:29Z。修改后：集成车道只在缓存回写时持锁，因此最长持锁段重新变成一次快速档套件。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

工作流 pin 和仓库检查在 Linux 上运行。Java/Maven 套件和真实 self-hosted 锁场景没有在本地运行，因为此环境没有 JDK 和 Maven；这些由确定性的 CI 运行做最终验证。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：集成车道的 Maven 运行不再与快速档在同一宿主机上串行。这是有意的：它已经使用 job 本地仓库和每 job 独立的数据库，池上其他长时间 Maven 套件根本不取这把锁，而另一种选择是一个无法在持锁期间存活的必需检查。如果宿主机竞争回归，可以用分片重新划分锁范围，而不是恢复数小时的持锁。
- 未验证 / 范围之外：确切的 self-hosted runner 时序和 Java 套件；本 PR 不修改 Maven 命令、测试选择或锁辅助脚本本身。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。锁路径、辅助脚本、票据队列、5400 秒预算和错误签名都没有改变。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #15108

</details>

prs.title: fix(acp): persist embedded text resources for transcript replay
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Persists bounded, original ACP embedded text `resource` blocks with their owning user prompt and replays them as typed user chunks. The daemon UI SDK now exposes these blocks separately from `resource_link` and native attachments, including offline transcript projection. Native attachment expansions are identified by their input positions, so a separate direct resource remains replayable even when it shares the same URI.

## Why it's needed

Qwen Code already accepts embedded resources as model context, but refresh or restart previously restored only the prompt text. Clients therefore lost the original context selection while the assistant reply remained visible. This closes the persistence/replay gap tracked in #12538; it is separate from the `resource_link` fix in #12088.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Send an ACP prompt with text and a text resource, then a resource-only prompt and a later text-only prompt. Inspect the saved user records and load the transcript: each resource should appear as a typed user chunk on its original prompt with its URI, MIME type, text, metadata, prompt ID, and source-record identity; it must not migrate to the later turn or be fetched by URI. Also check rewind/active-branch replay, native attachments over 256 KiB, a direct resource sharing a native attachment URI, and rejection of an oversized direct text resource before the daemon peer echo. Focused bridge, CLI, persistence, and SDK tests cover these cases.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the new recording/replay regressions failed against the pre-fix source because typed resources were absent after replay. After: the focused tests pass, including resource-only, same-URI coexistence, and daemon pre-echo rejection. No running-daemon or browser recording is claimed here.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ build, bundle, typecheck, targeted lint and tests |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.23.1; package-level test scripts and bundled `dist/cli.js` sanity check. A live ACP daemon session was not run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: directly supplied embedded text resources add bounded user content to durable transcripts; the aggregate serialized replay budget is 256 KiB per prompt. Oversized direct text resources are rejected before live echo. Native attachments use their existing separate storage path; current daemon requests exclude them by provenance. Legacy metadata without positions excludes only unambiguous URI matches; ambiguous blocks are retained and may hit the inline limit.
- Not validated / out of scope: running-daemon JSONL and `session/load` readback after restart, browser refresh acceptance, persistence of inline blob resources, and recovery of resources absent from historical records. Downstream clients must render the new typed SDK field to display a card.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no record migration is required; old records remain readable. A direct ACP prompt above the new text-resource replay limit now returns invalid parameters.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/issue-12538-embedded-resource-replay/docs/design/daemon-embedded-resource-replay.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/issue-12538-embedded-resource-replay/docs/design/daemon-embedded-resource-replay.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Fixes #12538.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

将有大小上限的原始 ACP 嵌入式文本 `resource` 块与所属用户 Prompt 一同持久化，并在回放时恢复为带类型的用户消息块。Daemon UI SDK 将其与 `resource_link`、原生附件区分，并支持离线 transcript 投影。原生附件展开结果按输入位置识别，因此即使另一个直接资源与它使用相同 URI，也仍可独立回放。

## 为什么需要

Qwen Code 已能把嵌入式资源用作模型上下文，但刷新或重启后此前只恢复 Prompt 文字。客户端因此丢失原始上下文引用，尽管助手回复仍可见。本 PR 修复 #12538 的持久化与回放缺口；它不同于 #12088 的 `resource_link` 修复。

## 审查验证计划

### 如何验证

依次发送包含文字和文本资源的 ACP Prompt、纯资源 Prompt、以及后续纯文字 Prompt。检查保存的用户记录与加载后的 transcript：每个资源都应作为带类型的用户消息块保留在原轮次，包含 URI、MIME 类型、文本、元数据、Prompt ID 和来源记录身份；不得迁移到后续轮次，也不得根据 URI 抓取内容。另需检查 rewind/有效分支回放、超过 256 KiB 的原生附件、与原生附件同 URI 的直接资源，以及超限直接文本资源在 Daemon 向其他客户端回显前被拒绝。定向桥接、CLI、持久化和 SDK 测试覆盖这些场景。

### 前后证据

修复前：新增的录制与回放回归测试在旧源码上失败，类型化资源在回放后缺失。修复后：定向测试通过，包括纯资源、同 URI 并存和 Daemon 回显前拒绝。本 PR 未声称完成运行中 Daemon 或浏览器录屏。

### 已测试系统

|     系统     | 状态 |
| :----------: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 构建、打包、类型检查、定向 lint 与测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境（可选）

Node 22.23.1；包级测试脚本与打包后的 `dist/cli.js` 基础检查。未运行真实 ACP Daemon 会话。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：直接提供的嵌入式文本资源会作为有界的用户内容进入持久 transcript；每个 Prompt 的序列化资源回放预算为 256 KiB。超限直接文本资源在实时回显前被拒绝。原生附件沿用独立存储路径；新 Daemon 请求按来源排除。缺少位置字段的旧元数据只排除 URI 唯一对应的块；歧义块会保留，也可能触及内联限额。
- 未验证／范围外：运行中 Daemon 的 JSONL 与重启后 `session/load` 回读、浏览器刷新验收、内联 blob 资源持久化，以及从未保存资源的旧记录恢复。下游客户端需要渲染新的类型化 SDK 字段才能显示卡片。
- 破坏性变更／迁移：无需记录迁移，旧记录继续可读。超过新文本资源回放上限的直接 ACP Prompt 现在返回参数错误。

prs.title: test(managed-agent): refuse a second fire while the turn runs (FG11d)
prs.body:
## What

Adds one cell to the FG11d cancellation matrix. Under the definition's default `skip` overlap policy, a second manual fire under a fresh key while the first run is still active is refused with `409 automation_run_skipped` and `overlap`; the decision is recorded as `skipped`/`overlap` with zero attempts, no second run commits and no second Turn starts.

What the cell does **not** pin: the open-Turn admission arm. That arm reads only public `ma_turn` rows, and none is open here — the automation wake turn is journal-side, and this cell's only public turn is the warm turn `createSession` completes. The refusal is answered by the count arm at one active run. Under the public `queue_one` policy (and `allow` below its quota) the same fire is admitted and a queued run does form, so the matrix criterion "a queued input cancelled before any attempt settles with no model call" stays **open** in the design record rather than being booked delivered.

## Why

The matrix listed that criterion as open with nothing behind it, and an earlier draft of this PR booked it delivered on the claim that no queue could form. That claim was measured false in review (a `queue_one` definition admits a second fire while the first turn is parked), so the record now states the reachable paths and what this cell really covers: the refusal, not the arm.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Read the new cell next to the cancel cells it follows: the first fire is parked on the fixture model, so its run stays non-terminal and `countActive` still sees it. The refusal comes from `AutomationScanner`'s default count arm, not the open-Turn arm; every admission arm answers the same reason, so a refusal-body assertion cannot tell them apart.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the criterion carried no gate, and the first draft's design bullet claimed the queue could not form.

After: `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0 -- in HostedAutomationFaultGatesIT` (12.27 s, then 13.39 s after a comment-only edit) on JDK 21 + MySQL 8.0.46. The cell is booked at 25 s (2× its slower sample), moving the fork to 11212 s and leaving Verify at 197 minutes with 8 s of margin.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
| 🐧 Linux  |   N/A  |

JDK 21 (`Zulu 21.0.11`) and MySQL 8.0.46 on `127.0.0.1:3401`, selected with `-Phosted-automation-gates`.

### Environment (optional)

N/A.

## Risk & Scope

No production code changes; a test cell, both language versions of the design record, and the budget ledger that carries it. The ledger step is the real tradeoff: the cell books 25 s against samples of 12.27 s and 13.39 s, and 2× the slower sample leaves Verify at 197 minutes with only 8 s of margin — a ceiling sized on two local samples rather than a fleet measurement, the same convention every cell in this class uses. Not validated here: the `queue_one` path itself (no cell covers it), and the scheduled-slot refusal.

## Linked Issues

Part of #14446. This PR does not close it — the tracker stays open across the whole FG11d chain, and the queued-input criterion is recorded there as still open.

## Base

Based on `main`. The three FG11d cells in this chain edit the same budget carriers (pom ledger, workflow comments and ceilings, the CI meta-test, and both design records), so they land in order rather than in parallel branches.

## Verification

- `HostedAutomationFaultGatesIT#fg11dSecondFireIsRefusedWhileTheFirstRunsOnMySql` green locally (12.27 s, then 13.39 s).
- `npx vitest run scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js` — 73/73.
- `mvn -o -Phosted-automation-gates -DskipTests test-compile` — BUILD SUCCESS.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做什么

给 FG11d 取消矩阵加一格。在定义默认的 `skip` overlap 策略下，第一个 run 仍活跃时用新的 key 发第二次手动 fire，会被 `409 automation_run_skipped` + `overlap` 拒绝，决定以 `skipped`/`overlap`、attempts 为 0 落库，其后不提交 run、也不起 Turn。

这一格**不**钉 open-Turn 准入臂：那条臂只读公开的 `ma_turn` 行，而这里没有开启的公开 turn——自动化 wake turn 在 journal 侧，本格唯一的公开 turn 是 `createSession` 完成的预热 turn。拒绝来自「一个活跃 run 时的计数臂」。在公开的 `queue_one` 策略下（以及 `allow` 未满额度时），同一次 fire 会被准入，队列确实会形成，因此矩阵里「在任何尝试前被取消的排队 input 不调用模型地结算」这条 criterion 在设计记录中保持**未结清**，而不是记为已交付。

## 为什么要做

矩阵把这条 criterion 列为未结清却没有任何门禁；本 PR 早先的草稿还基于「队列不可能形成」把它标成已交付。评审实测证明该说法不成立（`queue_one` 定义会在第一个 turn 被扣住时准入第二次 fire），所以记录现在改为写明可达路径，以及这一格真正覆盖的是「这次拒绝」，不是那条臂。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

把新格与它前面的取消格并读：第一次 fire 被扣在模型桩上，run 保持非终态，`countActive` 因此仍能看到它。拒绝来自 `AutomationScanner` 的默认计数臂，不是 open-Turn 臂；所有准入臂回答同一个理由，所以基于拒绝正文的断言分辨不出是哪一条。

### 证据（改动前后）

改动前：该 criterion 没有任何门禁，且初稿的设计 bullet 声称队列不可能形成。

改动后：`Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0 -- in HostedAutomationFaultGatesIT`（12.27 s，仅改注释后重跑 13.39 s），JDK 21 + MySQL 8.0.46。本格按 25 s 计入预算（2× 较慢样本），fork 抬到 11212 s，Verify 仍 197 分钟、余量 8 s。

### 测试平台

|    系统    | 结果 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  | N/A  |

JDK 21（`Zulu 21.0.11`）与 MySQL 8.0.46，地址 `127.0.0.1:3401`，用 `-Phosted-automation-gates` 选择。

## 风险与范围

无生产代码改动；只涉及一个测试格、双语设计记录，以及承载它的预算台账。台账这一步是真正的取舍：本格按 12.27 s 与 13.39 s 两个样本按 25 s 计入，而 2× 较慢样本后 Verify 仍停在 197 分钟、仅剩 8 s 余量——这个上限是按两份本机样本定的，不是机群实测，与本类其它格同一口径。本 PR 未验证：`queue_one` 路径本身（没有格子覆盖），以及排定 slot 的拒绝。

## 关联 Issue

Part of #14446。本 PR 不关闭它——tracker 需在整条 FG11d 链上保持开启，排队 input 那条 criterion 在其中仍记为未结清。

## Base

基于 `main`。这条链上的三个 FG11d 格改同一批预算载体（pom 台账、workflow 注释与上限、CI 元测试、两份设计记录），因此按顺序落地，不开并行分支。

## 验证

- `HostedAutomationFaultGatesIT#fg11dSecondFireIsRefusedWhileTheFirstRunsOnMySql` 本机通过（12.27 s，改注释后 13.39 s）。
- `npx vitest run scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js` — 73/73。
- `mvn -o -Phosted-automation-gates -DskipTests test-compile` — BUILD SUCCESS。

</details>
