prs.title: fix(ci): keep the sdk-java host lock out of every child (#15106)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The Java host lock can no longer outlive a cancelled step through a surviving child. Every external command in the lock-bearing MariaDB section — the cache seed, the directory creation, and both stages of the cache write-back pipeline — now closes the lock descriptor, so the step shell still holds the lock for the whole section and releases it at the step boundary. The workflow pin is generalized from Maven commands to every child that can outlive the step, and the blocked-head lock test seeds its ticket counter so it no longer depends on the spawned acquirer's PID ordering.

## Why it's needed

Run 39592794778's fast-tier job failed both attempts before any test ran: each waited the full 90-minute host-lock budget while its ticket was the head of the queue (`sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes as queue ticket 44/85`). A head that is already at the front of the ticket queue can only be blocked by an unticketed holder. The MariaDB lane closes the lock descriptor on its Maven children, but its cache seed, directory creation, and both cache write-back stages inherited fd 9. When a cancelled or killed job left one of those children running, it kept the flock until it exited, starving every later job on the shared host for hours. Closing the descriptor on every child removes that leak path while leaving acquisition order, the wait budget, the error signature, and release-at-step-boundary semantics unchanged.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Inspect the MariaDB lane's locked section: the cache seed, the directory creation, and both cache write-back stages must close fd 9, while the step shell keeps it so the lock is held for the whole section. Run the focused workflow and lock tests; the generalized pin should pass. Remove any one of the four new `9>&-` closures and re-run the pin test — it must fail. Run the blocked-head lock test repeatedly; it should pass without depending on PID ordering.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for a user-visible surface — this is CI-only. The descriptor-lifetime probe shows the mechanism directly: a forked child without `9>&-` kept the lock after the shell was killed (`lock STILL HELD after shell kill`), while a child started with `9>&-` released it with the shell (`lock RELEASED after shell kill`).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Local Linux checkout with Node 22.23.2. The sandbox's default Corepack cache is not writable, so build and Vitest ran with `COREPACK_HOME=/tmp/corepack-home`; that override is sandbox-only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a cancelled job's surviving seed or write-back process can now keep writing after the lock releases. The runner still owns killing it, and the previous behavior — a permanently wedged shared host — is strictly worse.
- Not validated / out of scope: the real self-hosted cancellation timing cannot be reproduced locally; the fix is verified by the descriptor-lifetime probe and the static workflow pin. Shrinking the 90-minute queue budget or adding pool capacity is out of scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; lock acquisition, wait budget, error signature, and release semantics are unchanged.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15106

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

Java 主机锁不会再因为幸存的子进程而比被取消的步骤活得更久。加锁的 MariaDB 段里的每个外部命令——缓存预热、目录创建以及缓存回写管道的两端——现在都会关闭锁描述符，因此步骤 shell 仍然在整个段内持有锁，并在步骤边界释放。工作流校验从只检查 Maven 命令推广到检查每个可能比步骤活得更久的子进程；阻塞头部锁测试会预置 ticket 计数器，因此不再依赖拉起的获取者的 PID 顺序。

## 为什么需要它

运行 39592794778 的 fast-tier 任务两次尝试都在任何测试开始前失败：两次都等满了 90 分钟的主机锁预算，而它的 ticket 已经是队列头部（`sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes as queue ticket 44/85`）。已经处于 ticket 队列头部的等待者只可能被没有 ticket 的持有者挡住。MariaDB 泳道在其 Maven 子进程上关闭了锁描述符，但它的缓存预热、目录创建和两个缓存回写阶段继承了 fd 9。当被取消或被杀死的任务留下其中一个子进程继续运行时，它会一直持有 flock 直到退出，从而让共享主机上的后续任务饿死数小时。在每个子进程上关闭描述符消除了这条泄漏路径，同时不改变获取顺序、等待预算、错误签名和步骤边界释放语义。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

检查 MariaDB 泳道的加锁段：缓存预热、目录创建和两个缓存回写阶段都必须关闭 fd 9，而步骤 shell 保留它，因此整个段内仍然持锁。运行相关的工作流与锁测试；推广后的校验应当通过。移除四个新 `9>&-` 中的任意一个并重新运行校验测试——它必须失败。重复运行阻塞头部锁测试；它应当在不受 PID 顺序影响的情况下通过。

### 证据（修改前与修改后）

针对用户可见界面为 N/A——这是纯 CI 改动。描述符生命周期探针直接展示了机制：没有 `9>&-` 的 fork 子进程在 shell 被杀死后仍持有锁（`lock STILL HELD after shell kill`），而以 `9>&-` 启动的子进程会随 shell 一起释放（`lock RELEASED after shell kill`）。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

本地 Linux 检出环境，Node 22.23.2。沙箱默认 Corepack 缓存不可写，因此 build 和 Vitest 使用 `COREPACK_HOME=/tmp/corepack-home` 运行；该覆盖仅用于沙箱。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：被取消任务遗留的预热或回写进程现在可能在锁释放后继续写入。运行器仍负责终止它，而之前的行为——整个共享主机永久卡死——显然更糟。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：无法在本地复现真实 self-hosted 的取消时序；该修复由描述符生命周期探针和静态工作流校验验证。缩短 90 分钟队列预算或增加池容量超出本 PR 范围。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无；锁的获取、等待预算、错误签名和释放语义均未改变。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #15106

</details>

prs.title: feat(core): attribute 千问AI平台 / QwenCloud requests with the source-config header
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Qwen Code now sends the `X-DashScope-Source-Config` usage-attribution header on model requests to 千问AI平台 (China site) and QwenCloud (international site). The header is added only when the request's host is exactly `maas.qianwenaiapi.com`, `maas.qwencloudapi.com`, or the `token-plan.` subdomain of either. Every other endpoint — Bailian, Coding Plan, Qwen OAuth, OpenAI, Anthropic, local models — sends byte-identical requests to before. The API key is never inspected.

The value is `{"channel":"<site>-inner-agents","source":"model","tags":{"t1":"qwen-code","t2":"payg"}}`, with the site taken from the host. The `inner-agents` ownership is provisional: the integration guide does not classify Qwen Code, so it is inferred from Qwen Code being published by the Alibaba-run QwenLM organization and still needs confirmation with the platform. Token Plan endpoints omit `t2`, because the client cannot tell the Personal and Team editions apart and the platform resolves the plan from the API key. The header is first-party: a same-named user custom header, in any casing, is replaced rather than sent alongside it.

It covers the three request paths that reach these hosts in a default setup: Chat Completions (main session, subagents, fast model, compaction, vision bridge), the Responses API wire, and the WebSearch side request that the QwenCloud presets enable.

## Why it's needed

The platforms' integration guide for Agent source attribution asks every Agent to send this header on each model request, so that usage can be counted per site, per Agent ownership and per Agent. Without it, Qwen Code's traffic on these platforms cannot be attributed to Qwen Code.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Configure a model on a QwenCloud or 千问AI平台 endpoint (Standard or Token Plan) and run any prompt: requests to that host carry exactly one `X-DashScope-Source-Config` header with the value above, and the request succeeds.
- Configure a model on any other endpoint (for example `dashscope.aliyuncs.com` or a `*.maas.aliyuncs.com` workspace domain): no such header is sent.
- Add `X-DashScope-Source-Config` to a QwenCloud entry's `customHeaders`: the first-party value is sent, once.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Unit tests: a host matrix for both sites and both plans, case and port, lookalike hosts (`maas.qwencloudapi.com.evil.example`), path-embedded hosts and Bailian hosts, plus the custom-header precedence. Each of the three paths has a test asserting the header on a QwenCloud endpoint; disabling the injection fails all three, so the tests discriminate.

Live endpoint: on `token-plan.maas.qianwenaiapi.com`, requests returned HTTP 200 with no header, with the header, and with deliberately malformed values (invalid JSON, a misspelled channel), so the gateway accepts the header and never fails a request over its content. The other three hosts were exercised with an invalid key only (no keys available): each returned the same 401 with and without the header.

Real CLI runs (built `dist`, headless prompt, isolated `QWEN_HOME`), observed at the HTTP client. Each row is one request; `count` is how many `X-DashScope-Source-Config` headers it carried:

```
Chat Completions   token-plan.maas.qianwenaiapi.com  /chat/completions  count=1  {"channel":"qianwenai-inner-agents","source":"model","tags":{"t1":"qwen-code"}}
Chat Completions   <workspace>.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com  /chat/completions  count=0
Responses API      token-plan.maas.qianwenaiapi.com  /responses  count=1  (same value)
WebSearch tool     token-plan.maas.qianwenaiapi.com  /responses  count=1  (same value; plus count=1 on each main-session request)
Before (main build, same config, Responses API)  /responses  count=0
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Built `dist` CLI against a real 千问AI平台 Token Plan key; unit tests in `packages/core`.

## Risk & Scope

- Pending platform confirmation before this leaves draft: the `inner-agents` vs `outer-agents` ownership, whether `qwen-code` must be registered in the channel list, and whether omitting `t2` on Token Plan is acceptable. Each is a string change.
- Main risk or tradeoff: a gateway that rejects unknown headers would fail; the scope is limited to the platforms' own hosts, and the live endpoint accepts the header. The value carries no user, session or request data.
- Not validated / out of scope: the international site and the pay-as-you-go endpoints were not hit with a valid key (none available; same gateway family). Model discovery, Batch, omni media tools, Responses embeddings, voice transcription, Qwen Live and the Anthropic protocol are out of scope, as are requests routed through a proxy host — see the design doc for each reason. Whether the platform actually counts the header could not be observed from the client.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No new setting.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/qwencloud-source-config/docs/design/qwencloud-source-attribution.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/qwencloud-source-config/docs/design/qwencloud-source-attribution.zh-CN.md)

None.

prs.title: test(core): pin that setTools writes the tool declarations
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds two unit tests pinning that the chat client's tool declarations actually reach the generation config that is sent to the model. The declaration setter is the only writer of that config field, and until now no test in the client's own suite exercised it, so the write was unpinned.

## Why it's needed

A refactor that dropped the write would have been invisible. The whole suite stayed green with the write removed, while every request would have gone out tool-less — the model would silently lose access to every tool.

The ACP-level suites do mention the setter, but only as a mock: they assert that it *was called*, which cannot observe whether the real implementation writes anything. So there was no test anywhere that would fail.

This is the remaining open item of a deferred review finding; a maintainer already ruled it still open.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The gap and the pin were both established by mutation on this tree, which a reviewer can repeat:

1. Baseline, unmodified: `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core/llm-chat.test.ts` → **592 passed (592)**.
2. Reproduce the gap: delete the single assignment in the declaration setter so the method body does nothing, then re-run → **592 passed (592)**, byte-identical to baseline. That is the defect: nothing observes the write.
3. Restore the assignment and keep the two new tests → **594 passed (594)**.
4. Re-apply the mutation from step 2 with the new tests present → exactly the two new cases fail and the other 592 stay green:

```
 FAIL  src/core/llm-chat.test.ts > LlmChat > setTools > writes the declarations into the config sent to the model
AssertionError: expected undefined to deeply equal [ { functionDeclarations: [ …(1) ] } ]
 FAIL  src/core/llm-chat.test.ts > LlmChat > setTools > replaces the previous declarations instead of appending to them
AssertionError: expected [ { functionDeclarations: [ …(1) ] } ] to deeply equal [ …(2) ]
 Tests  2 failed | 592 skipped (594)
```

Step 4 is what proves the tests are load-bearing rather than vacuously green. The second case additionally pins replace-not-append semantics: it seeds a stale declaration through the constructor, so an appending implementation would fail it too.

Prettier and ESLint both report no findings on the changed file.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test-only change, no user-visible surface. The before/after is the mutation result above: 592 green without the pin (defect invisible), 2 red with it.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: none to production behaviour; the change is 34 added lines in one existing test file, with no production code touched.
- Not validated / out of scope: the two remaining items of the same deferred finding are untouched — the unbounded-latency property of the in-process latency guard, and the CI reporter inferring "no test result was reported" from an empty log glob. Both need a maintainer ruling rather than a local test.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Part of #11056 — no closing keyword, because this addresses only the one still-open item of that batch and the maintainer has already published a resolved/still-open split there.

prs.title: fix(ci): report swap and a df -h fallback in the lint lane failure dump
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Brings the lint lane's state-at-failure diagnostic in line with the three equivalent dumps elsewhere in the same workflow: it now reports swap alongside RAM, and falls back to a filesystem table without the type column when the runner's `df` does not accept `-T`. Adds a case to the helper suite that executes the dump and asserts both actually reach the uploaded artifact.

## Why it's needed

That dump exists to explain a resource death after the fact, and it was the thinnest of the four. Swap exhaustion is a realistic cause on the contended pool this lane runs on, but the artifact could not show it — the memory grep asked for total and available RAM only, so a host that died because swap ran out looked identical to one that died with swap to spare. And on a runner whose `df` has no `-T` support, the command failed and nothing retried, so the artifact carried no filesystem table at all: the disk half of a disk-pressure investigation came back empty.

The three sibling dumps already carry both swap fields and the retry. This one had diverged, and it is the dump belonging to the lane that runs the longest static work.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The helper suite for this workflow already executes the step body under bash rather than pinning its text, so the new case inherits that. Run it:

```
node --test .github/scripts/ci-disk-pressure.test.mjs
```

Before this PR: 4 pass. After: 5 pass. On the unfixed workflow the new case fails with the artifact it actually produced:

```
AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: swap exhaustion is invisible in the artifact
stdout: DISKCONTEXT failure-dump 2026-10-21T17:10:18Z
MemTotal:        7599372 kB
MemAvailable:    2796420 kB
```

Note what is missing from that output: no swap line, and no filesystem table either. The case stubs `df` so that any option cluster carrying `T` exits non-zero — which is what a `df` without `-T` support does — so the marker line can only come from the `-h` retry, and `df -i` stays silent to keep that output attributable. Matching on `-T` alone is not enough: `df -hT` arrives as one argument, and a stub keyed on `-T` lets it through and fakes the fallback.

Artifact content from executing the step body against that stub, before and after:

Before
```
DISKCONTEXT failure-dump 2026-10-21T17:10:18Z
MemTotal:        7599372 kB
MemAvailable:    2796420 kB
```

After
```
DISKCONTEXT failure-dump 2026-10-21T17:17:34Z
STUB-DF-H  (df -h fallback ran)
MemTotal:        7599372 kB
MemAvailable:    2992452 kB
SwapTotal:       2097148 kB
SwapFree:             48 kB
```

The host this was captured on is a useful illustration of the gap: 2 GB of swap, 48 kB free. Under the old grep that state was invisible in the artifact.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-visible or TUI surface. The textual before/after above is the executed artifact content.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

The helper suite containing this file is wired only into the ubuntu lane, so Linux is the only platform that runs it.

### Environment (optional)

N/A — `node --test` helper suites only, no build.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: this edits a shared workflow, so here is the accounting. **No new check, job, lane, or runtime.** The step already existed and only runs on failure; the change adds two field names to an existing grep and one `||` retry to an existing command. The workflow grows by 28 bytes (147040 → 147068), still under its recorded 147136 size baseline, so the ratchet needs no bump and `check-workflow-size.sh` passes clean. The step is unique to this job and is not in the intersection compared by the shared-prelude identity guard, so that pin is unaffected.
- Not validated / out of scope: an A/A control across the 11 helper suites that read this workflow gives 299 tests / 259 pass / 40 fail pristine versus 300 / 260 / 40 with this change, and the failing-name sets are line-for-line identical — those 40 are pre-existing fixture gaps in a partial checkout, not regressions. Real swap-exhaustion behaviour on an actual runner was not reproduced; the witness stubs `df` and reads the host's real `/proc/meminfo`. The other two deferred items on the linked issue are untouched.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The dump only ever appends to a diagnostic artifact, and every command in it is already `|| true`.

## Linked Issues

Part of #11032 — deliberately no closing keyword. This addresses the state-at-failure dump item; the two items about step command bodies and the action pin not being covered by the platform-lane suite remain open.

prs.title: test(core): pin the no-upstream branch shape the web-shell push hint reads
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds one test pinning the shape a local branch reports when it has no upstream configured and git resolves no push destination: no upstream, no push target, and no push-side counts, while the branch itself is still listed as the checked-out branch.

## Why it's needed

The suite already asserts "no push destination" four times, but every one of those cases carries a live upstream — a triangular push configuration, a name-mismatched upstream, a push policy that names nothing, and a Gerrit-style refspec. The shape with no upstream at all was unpinned.

That shape is load-bearing for the UI: the branch picker renders its "Sets upstream on push" hint exactly when a branch has no upstream and no known push destination. A regression that started inventing an upstream or a push target there would move that hint and still pass the whole suite.

The realistic way to reach the shape is pushing without `-u`: the remote ref exists, but git still resolves no upstream and names no push destination.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the branch-listing suite filtered to the new case:

```
cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/utils/git-branches.test.ts -t 'pushed but untracked'
```

Expected: 1 passed. The test asserts the branch was actually found first (`name`, `isHead`) so the subsequent `toBeUndefined()` checks cannot pass vacuously on a listing that failed to find the branch at all.

For the opposite direction, the existing triangular-workflow case already asserts that a branch pushed *with* `-u` does report `pushTarget === 'origin/master'`, so the new assertions are not true of every branch.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test-only change, no user-visible behavior changes.

Local verification note, so the gap is explicit rather than implied: this machine's git is 2.19 and the suite's repo helper uses `git init -b` (git >= 2.28), so the committed file cannot execute here. It reports the same environmental failure with and without this change — 96 failed / 23 passed before, 97 failed / 23 passed after, i.e. exactly the one added test, on an identical `unknown switch 'b'` signature. The asserted shape was therefore confirmed by running the identical assertions against the real branch-listing implementation with a git-2.19-compatible repo construction. It returned `{name: 'master', isHead: true, ahead: 0, behind: 0, commitDate, commitSubject}` with no `upstream`, `upstreamGone`, `pushTarget`, `pushAhead`, `pushBehind`, or `pushGone` key present. A negative control on a branch pushed with `-u` returned `upstream: 'origin/master'` and `pushTarget: 'origin/master'` and failed those same assertions, so the test is not vacuously green in either direction. Prettier and ESLint are clean on the changed file. CI runs the committed test on modern git.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Marked not-tested everywhere because the committed file itself never ran green locally — see the verification note above for what was actually executed instead.

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: none to production behavior; this is test-only with no source change. The new case builds two temporary repositories, so it adds a little runtime to the suite.
- Not validated / out of scope: the other two findings recorded on the linked issue — a duplicated `--format` literal shared by the two branch-listing calls, and the track grammar being parsed twice — are deliberately untouched. Both are refactors that close no defect, and either would widen this change well past the coverage gap it fixes.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Refs #10964 — this resolves the third deferred finding (the missing coverage). The issue stays open because its other two findings are untouched, so this intentionally avoids a closing keyword.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

新增一个测试，钉住「本地分支既没有配置 upstream、git 也解析不出 push 目标」时分支列表返回的形状：没有 upstream、没有 push 目标、没有 push 侧的 ahead/behind 计数，但该分支本身仍然作为当前检出分支被列出。

## 为什么需要

现有测试套件里已经断言了四次「没有 push 目标」，但那四次都带着一个有效的 upstream —— 三角推送配置、upstream 名字与分支不一致、push 策略故意不指名、以及 Gerrit 式 refspec。「完全没有 upstream」这个形状一直没人钉住。

而这个形状对 UI 是有实际作用的：分支选择器恰好是在「分支没有 upstream 且 push 目标未知」时渲染 "Sets upstream on push" 这条提示。如果将来解析逻辑在这里凭空造出一个 upstream 或 push 目标，这条提示就会变，而整个测试套件依然全绿。

现实中进入这个形状的方式就是推送时不带 `-u`：远端 ref 存在，但 git 仍然解析不出 upstream，也不会指名 push 目标。

## 审阅测试计划

### 如何验证

只跑新增的那个用例：

```
cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/utils/git-branches.test.ts -t 'pushed but untracked'
```

预期：1 passed。测试会先断言分支确实被找到（`name`、`isHead`），这样后面那些 `toBeUndefined()` 断言就不可能在「列表根本没找到该分支」的情况下空过。

反方向上，已有的三角工作流用例已经断言了带 `-u` 推送的分支确实会返回 `pushTarget === 'origin/master'`，所以新增断言并非对任何分支都成立。

### 证据（改动前后）

N/A —— 纯测试改动，没有用户可见的行为变化。

本地验证说明，把缺口讲明而不是含糊过去：本机 git 是 2.19，而套件的建仓辅助函数用了 `git init -b`（需要 git >= 2.28），所以这个提交的文件在本机跑不起来。有无这次改动，它报的都是同一个环境性失败 —— 改动前 96 failed / 23 passed，改动后 97 failed / 23 passed，即恰好多了新增的那一个用例，失败签名同为 `unknown switch 'b'`。因此断言的形状是通过对真实的分支列表实现、用兼容 git 2.19 的建仓方式跑同一组断言来确认的：返回 `{name: 'master', isHead: true, ahead: 0, behind: 0, commitDate, commitSubject}`，其中 `upstream`、`upstreamGone`、`pushTarget`、`pushAhead`、`pushBehind`、`pushGone` 六个键一个都不存在。反向对照用带 `-u` 推送的分支，返回了 `upstream: 'origin/master'` 与 `pushTarget: 'origin/master'`，同一组断言随即失败 —— 说明这个测试在两个方向上都不是空绿。改动文件的 Prettier 与 ESLint 均干净。提交进去的测试由 CI 在新版 git 上执行。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

三处都标为未测试，因为提交的文件本身在本地没有跑绿过 —— 实际执行了什么见上面的验证说明。

### 环境（可选）

N/A —— 只有单元测试。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：对生产行为没有风险，纯测试改动、不动源码。新用例会建两个临时仓库，因此给套件增加了一点运行时间。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：关联 issue 上记录的另外两条发现 —— 两次分支列表调用共用的一份重复 `--format` 字面量，以及 track 语法被解析了两遍 —— 都刻意没有动。这两条都是不修复任何缺陷的重构，任一条都会让这次改动远远超出它要补的覆盖缺口。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #10964 —— 本 PR 解决其中第三条延迟发现（缺失的测试覆盖）。该 issue 保持打开，因为另外两条发现未处理，所以这里刻意不使用自动关闭关键字。

</details>

prs.title: fix(ci): write back only the MariaDB lane's Maven delta and size its ceiling (#15000)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes the MariaDB lane's Maven cache write-back publish only the artifacts Maven fetched in this job, by per-file hardlink, with a five-minute backstop, and raises that job's ceiling from 200 to 280 minutes. The host-shared `~/.m2` still gains whatever the job downloaded; it can never receive a partially written file, and a write-back that hits the backstop only leaves artifacts missing for the next job to re-resolve. The gate result is unaffected either way.

## Why it's needed

Run [39563394993](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39563394993) (PR #15000) had its `Runtime Broker and Managed Agent MariaDB / Java 21` job cancelled at the 200-minute ceiling. The single locked step split into three costs:

| phase | elapsed |
| --- | --- |
| queued for the host lock (ticket 30) | 54 min |
| seed + Maven install + verify | ~75 min |
| unbounded `tar` of the shared `~/.m2` | **~60 min** |

The write-back streamed the entire seeded repository through `tar` only for `--skip-old-files` to discard almost all of it, so its cost grew with the host's accumulated cache (26, 51 and 61 minutes in three recent jobs) — the known #14384 cost. Simply putting a wall-clock cap on that pipeline would not work: the cap would trip on every run, and a producer killed mid-member leaves a truncated artifact in the shared cache that `--skip-old-files` never repairs and the next job's hardlink seed picks up.

Because the seed hardlinks every host file into the job-local repository, the files Maven fetched during this job are exactly the ones with a single link. Publishing only those, with no-clobber hardlinks, turns the write-back into a metadata-only merge of the delta; each link is atomic, so stopping it early cannot publish a partial file. The step distinguishes "stopped at the backstop" from other failures in its warning.

The ceiling has to accommodate the 90-minute lock wait, up to ~100 minutes from lock acquisition to the end of verify (one job spent 71 minutes in the seed alone), the backstop and setup; 200 does not.

The other red job in that run, `Hosted process fault gates`, failed on two known flaky Hosted tests; that is tracked separately and untouched here.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

`npx vitest run scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js`. The meta-tests pin the delta predicate, the two in-house excludes, the no-clobber hardlink publish, the separate timeout warning, the absence of any `tar … -xf` into the shared cache, and a ceiling derived from the lock wait plus the measured hold, backstop and setup. On the pool, the next full-tier MariaDB job should finish its write-back in seconds; a `Maven cache write-back stopped after 300 s` warning means the backstop fired.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: run 39563394993 job 119117818954 — step 08:29:11 → 11:43:47, cancelled at 200 minutes, `Terminate orphan process: tar`.

After (GNU coreutils 8.32 / findutils, Ubuntu 22.04 and Oracle Linux containers): the delta publish copies only new files, keeps seeded host files untouched even when Maven replaced them by rename, skips both in-house coordinates and still recaptures third-party `com/alibaba` artifacts. With the backstop forced to fire mid-run over 20 000 new files it exited 124 after publishing ~5 000 of them with zero partial files, and the next run published the rest. Meta-test mutations (dropping the delta predicate, the backstop, `-n`, the 124 arm, or lowering the ceiling to 200) each turn the suite red.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   N/A  |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ meta-tests + container probe of the shell; the lane itself is the runtime check |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — workflow budget and one shell step.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the delta relies on the seed's hardlinks. If the seed fails (it is best-effort), every file has one link and the write-back degrades to the whole tree, which the 300 s backstop still bounds; no file is ever replaced or truncated.
- Not validated / out of scope: the two Hosted test flakes in the same run, and the seed's own cost (#14384 remains the umbrella for cache cost).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Refs #15000
Refs #14384

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

让 MariaDB lane 的 Maven 缓存写回只把本次 job 中 Maven 新下载的构件逐个硬链接回宿主机共享的 `~/.m2`，并设 5 分钟兜底；同时把该 job 的上限从 200 分钟提到 280 分钟。共享缓存仍会获得本次下载的内容，但永远不会收到写了一半的文件；即使触发兜底，也只是少了一些构件，由下一个 job 重新解析。门禁结果不受影响。

## 为什么需要

run [39563394993](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39563394993)（PR #15000）的 `Runtime Broker and Managed Agent MariaDB / Java 21` 在 200 分钟上限被 cancel。持锁步骤拆成三段：

| 阶段 | 耗时 |
| --- | --- |
| 等宿主机锁（ticket 30） | 54 分钟 |
| 播种 + Maven 安装 + 验证 | ~75 分钟 |
| 无上限地 tar 共享 `~/.m2` | **~60 分钟** |

原写回会把整个播种出来的仓库用 `tar` 流一遍，再由 `--skip-old-files` 丢掉几乎全部内容，所以耗时随宿主机缓存累积而增长（最近三次分别为 26、51、61 分钟），即 #14384 的已知成本。单纯给这条管道加墙钟上限行不通：每次都会触发；而且生产端在某个成员写到一半时被杀，会在共享缓存里留下截断的构件，`--skip-old-files` 永远不会修复它，下一个 job 的硬链接播种还会把它带进去。

播种是把宿主机每个文件硬链接进 job 本地仓库，因此本次 Maven 新下载的文件恰好是链接数为 1 的那些。只发布这些文件、且用不覆盖的硬链接，写回就变成只涉及元数据的增量合并；每个链接都是原子的，提前停止也不会发布半个文件。warning 也区分了“兜底超时”和其他失败。

上限要覆盖 90 分钟锁等待、从拿到锁到 verify 结束最多约 100 分钟（有一次仅播种就用了 71 分钟）、兜底时间和 setup；200 分钟不够。

同一次 run 里另一个红的 `Hosted process fault gates` 是两个已知 flaky 的 Hosted 测试，单独跟踪，本次不动。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

`npx vitest run scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js`。meta-test 钉住了增量判据、两个自研坐标的排除、不覆盖的硬链接发布、单独的超时 warning、不再有任何 `tar … -xf` 解包进共享缓存，以及由锁等待 + 实测持锁时间 + 兜底 + setup 推导出的上限。池上下一次 full-tier MariaDB job 的写回应在数秒内完成；若出现 `Maven cache write-back stopped after 300 s`，说明兜底触发。

### 证据（前后对比）

Before：run 39563394993 job 119117818954 —— 步骤 08:29:11 → 11:43:47，在 200 分钟被 cancel，`Terminate orphan process: tar`。

After（GNU coreutils 8.32 / findutils，Ubuntu 22.04 与 Oracle Linux 容器）：增量发布只复制新文件；即使 Maven 以 rename 方式替换了已播种文件，宿主机文件也保持不变；两个自研坐标被跳过，`com/alibaba` 下的第三方构件仍会回收。在 2 万个新文件上强制兜底中途触发：退出码 124，已发布约 5000 个，部分写入文件为 0；下一次运行补齐其余文件。meta-test 变异（去掉增量判据、兜底、`-n`、124 分支，或把上限降回 200）均会让测试变红。

### 测试环境

|    系统     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  | N/A  |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ meta-test + 容器内验证 shell；lane 本身是运行时验证 |

### 环境（可选）

N/A —— 工作流预算与一个 shell 步骤。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：增量依赖播种的硬链接。若播种失败（它是 best-effort），所有文件链接数都为 1，写回退化为全树，但仍受 300 秒兜底约束；任何文件都不会被替换或截断。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：同一次 run 里的两个 Hosted flake，以及播种本身的耗时（#14384 仍是缓存成本的伞形 issue）。
- 破坏性改动 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #15000
Refs #14384

prs.title: feat(memory): opt-in extraction cadence after a no-op run
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds the default-off internal experiment `QWEN_CODE_MEMORY_EXTRACT_NOOP_SKIP_TURNS` (0–3). After a completed extraction successfully accesses memory and saves nothing, up to N following turns skip extraction while pending history stays within 20 entries and the prompt stays below the compaction warning tier. A main-agent memory write disarms the cadence and invalidates older extraction outcomes.

The experiment retains the bounded skipped-history slice. If a later long turn evicts it from the captured 40-entry tail, the next extraction includes that slice alongside the tail; failed extraction also retains it for retry. The persisted cursor remains indexed against raw history, with no migration. ACP session close flushes pending turns within its remaining close budget. The variable is unset by default, preserving the existing once-per-turn behavior.

## Why it's needed

[#13004](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13004) measured roughly 9–10k input tokens per extractor launch even when nothing was saved. This experiment tests whether fewer launches can reduce that overhead while preserving memory quality. It does not claim a demonstrated real-model saving or enable the policy by default.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- With the experiment off, confirm extraction keeps its existing cadence. With N=2, a completed read-only noop can skip two ordinary turns; a failed read or a run that saved memory must not arm it.
- Introduce a durable preference on a skipped turn, then complete a tool-heavy turn that pushes it beyond the captured tail. Confirm that preference reaches extraction and is saved; check failure followed by close-time retry as well.
- Let the main agent write memory while an older extraction is running, then finish the older extraction with a noop. Confirm the next turn extracts normally.
- Close an ACP session while a turn is pending. Confirm the memory is persisted before close returns; overlapping or stale flush requests must not duplicate extraction or replay another session/project.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Controlled-provider tests exercised the actual ACP process, memory tools, outgoing model requests and persisted files. At baseline `505adabd9d`, a skipped preference was absent after a tool-heavy turn even though the cursor advanced to 55; at `6e7e4deb6d732a9a9c9a5c26c4c16c8d2a3164bc`, the same preference reaches the extractor and is persisted. The in-flight noop race likewise changes from skipping the following turn to extracting it. Failed reads do not arm the cadence. See the separate local verification comment for the full evidence and checks.

An earlier real `qwen3.8-flash` feature-toggle pair at `bdc6f5ccb9` did not establish savings: six matched turns produced 5 versus 6 extractor launches and 41,519 versus 73,000 extractor tokens including cached input. Model tool choices and memory quality differed, so those figures are not a causal regression estimate or current-head performance acceptance.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22, local source entrypoint through ACP, isolated configuration/runtime/memory directories. Current repair acceptance uses a loopback scripted provider; earlier real-model evidence is labeled separately.

## Risk & Scope

- Memory extraction may be delayed by up to N turns. ACP close waits for a best-effort flush; a timeout bounds waiting, not the lifetime of an extraction that has already started.
- Compaction, `/clear`, `/resume`, `/branch`, relocation, the OpenTUI switch and process exit do not flush skipped turns. Those losses, the process-global cache-safe slot, and the close/hold ordering remain follow-ups in #13612.
- Crash recovery, replay, default-on rollout and real-model quality/cost acceptance remain outside this change. One long turn can still exceed the existing captured tail; this repair preserves the earlier skipped slice, without promising full extraction of every entry in that long turn.
- No new user setting, dependency, persisted format or cursor migration. The shared fork result adds an optional successful-read observation; the existing attempted-tool signal used by the cursor keeps its meaning.
- Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/6e7e4deb6d732a9a9c9a5c26c4c16c8d2a3164bc/docs/design/auto-memory/structured-auto-memory-recall-design.md), [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/6e7e4deb6d732a9a9c9a5c26c4c16c8d2a3164bc/docs/design/auto-memory/structured-auto-memory-recall-design.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Refs #13004, #13612

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

新增默认关闭的内部实验 `QWEN_CODE_MEMORY_EXTRACT_NOOP_SKIP_TURNS`（0–3）。某次提取完成、成功访问过记忆且没有保存内容后，后续最多 N 轮可以跳过提取，前提是未处理历史不超过 20 条，且 prompt 低于压缩告警线。主 agent 写入记忆会解除跳过，并使更早提取的结论失效。

实验保留有界的被跳过历史片段。如果后续长轮次把它挤出捕获的 40 条尾部，下一次提取会把该片段补入尾部上下文；提取失败也会保留它供重试。持久游标继续使用原始历史下标，无需迁移。ACP 会话关闭会在剩余预算内冲刷积压轮次。环境变量默认不设置，保留现有逐轮提取行为。

## 为什么需要

[#13004](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13004) 实测每次提取即使零产出，也约消耗 9–10k 输入 token。本实验验证减少启动次数能否在保持记忆质量的前提下减少开销；尚未证明真实模型节省，也不默认开启。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 关闭实验时确认提取频率保持原样；N=2 时，成功读取记忆的零产出提取可以跳过后续两轮普通对话。读取失败或保存过记忆的运行不能启用跳过。
- 在被跳过的轮次引入长期偏好，随后执行足以把它挤出尾部的工具密集轮次。确认偏好进入提取并保存；同时检查提取失败后在关闭时重试。
- 让主 agent 在旧提取运行期间写入记忆，再让旧提取以零产出结束。确认下一轮正常提取。
- 有积压轮次时关闭 ACP 会话，确认关闭返回前记忆已落盘；重叠或过期的冲刷不能重复提取，也不能重放其他会话或项目。

### 证据（前后对比）

受控 provider 测试驱动了真实 ACP 进程、记忆工具、模型出站请求和落盘文件。在基线 `505adabd9d`，工具密集轮次后，被跳过的偏好没有保存，游标却已前进到 55；在 `6e7e4deb6d732a9a9c9a5c26c4c16c8d2a3164bc`，同一偏好进入提取器并成功保存。旧零产出提取的竞态也从“下一轮被跳过”变成正常提取。读取失败不会启用跳过。完整证据和检查见单独的本地验证评论。

此前在 `bdc6f5ccb9` 上用真实 `qwen3.8-flash` 做过开关对照，但没有证明节省：六轮相同输入，提取启动为 5 对 6 次，提取 token 为 41,519 对 73,000（含缓存输入）。模型工具选择和记忆质量不同，不能把这些数字当作因果回归判断或当前 head 的性能验收。

### 测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :-- | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ |

### 环境（可选）

Node 22，通过 ACP 运行本地源码，配置、运行和记忆目录均隔离。当前修复验收使用本机脚本化 provider；此前真实模型证据单独注明。

## 风险与范围

- 记忆提取可能延后最多 N 轮。ACP 关闭等待一次尽力冲刷；超时限制等待时间，不终止已经启动的提取。
- 压缩、`/clear`、`/resume`、`/branch`、切目录、OpenTUI 切换和进程退出不冲刷积压轮次。这些丢失边界、进程共享 cache-safe 槽位，以及关闭与 holds 的顺序，仍由 #13612 跟进。
- 崩溃恢复、重放、默认开启和真实模型质量/成本验收不在本次范围。单个长轮次仍可能超过现有尾部；本次修复保全此前被跳过的片段，不承诺提取该长轮次中的每一条内容。
- 不新增用户设置、依赖、持久化格式或游标迁移。共享 fork 结果增加可选的成功读取观测；游标原有的工具尝试信号保持含义不变。
- 设计：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/6e7e4deb6d732a9a9c9a5c26c4c16c8d2a3164bc/docs/design/auto-memory/structured-auto-memory-recall-design.md)、[中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/6e7e4deb6d732a9a9c9a5c26c4c16c8d2a3164bc/docs/design/auto-memory/structured-auto-memory-recall-design.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #13004, #13612

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): accept explicitly named Local Control addresses outside RFC 1918/3927
prs.body:
## What this PR does

An explicitly passed `--local-control-address` is now treated as operator intent: Local Control accepts any non-internal, non-loopback IPv4 the host actually has — including addresses outside RFC 1918/3927 space (some enterprise intranets number their LANs from public ranges) and addresses on VPN/tunnel interfaces (phone and laptop on the same corporate VPN). Automatic advertisement stays RFC 1918/3927-only and untouched; the escape hatch opens only when the operator names the address, and out-of-private-space picks are logged with a loud warning on enable. The explicit pick is also resolved before the no-candidate failure, so a host with zero automatic candidates can still opt in.

## Why it's needed

On a host whose only non-loopback IPv4 is a public-range corporate-intranet address, Local Control was completely unusable: `qwen serve --local-control` exited with "No private IPv4 address is available", and `--local-control-address` could not help because it only disambiguated among candidates that had already passed the RFC 1918 filter. The same dead end hit hosts whose only usable address sits on a VPN/tunnel interface. Refuse-by-default remains the right posture for automatic advertising — the missing piece was a way for an operator to say "yes, this one, I mean it."

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

On a host whose address is outside RFC 1918/3927 (or on a VPN/tunnel interface), run `qwen serve --local-control --local-control-address <that-address>`. Expected: a WARNING that the address is outside private/link-local space, then the pairing QR/URL bound to that address; the LAN listener enforces the pairing token (401 without it, 200 with it). Naming an address the host does not have still fails with `unknown_lan_interface`; naming loopback still fails. Without the flag, behavior is unchanged: automatic selection stays RFC 1918/3927-only, and multiple candidates still surface the explicit-choice error. Unit tests cover the full selection matrix (public-range, tunnel interface, loopback, unknown address, ambiguity, no-candidate ordering).

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before (released 0.25.1, host's only address on a public-range corporate intranet):

```
$ qwen serve --local-control
qwen serve: No private IPv4 address is available. Local Control needs the host to be on a local network (Wi-Fi or Ethernet).
(exit code 1)
```

After (this branch, same host):

```
$ qwen serve --local-control --local-control-address <public-range-address> --port 4399
qwen serve: WARNING: Local Control address <public-range-address> is outside RFC 1918 private / RFC 3927 link-local space. It was accepted only because it was named explicitly — advertise it only on a network you trust.

Local Control is on. Scan this QR code from the same network:
en0: http://<public-range-address>:4399/#token=<pairing-token>
```

LAN listener auth boundary on that address: `GET /` → 200 (Web Shell), `GET /capabilities` → 401 without the pairing token, 200 with it.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Dev CLI (`npm run dev`) on the affected host; `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, ESLint, and Prettier all pass on the change.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the explicit opt-in deliberately widens what `--local-control-address` accepts; automatic (no-flag) behavior is unchanged, and out-of-private-space picks always log a warning. Acceptance requires the address to exist on a live interface, so wildcards, multicast, and typos stay refused.
- Not validated / out of scope: adding CGNAT (100.64/10) to the default allowlist, and a Web Shell settings-card affordance for the opt-in — both deliberately deferred.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14136

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

显式传入的 `--local-control-address` 现在被视为操作员意图：只要主机真实持有该地址，Local Control 就接受任意非 internal、非 loopback 的 IPv4——包括 RFC 1918/3927 范围之外的地址（一些企业内网用公网段给内网编号），以及 VPN/隧道接口上的地址（手机与电脑同挂一个企业 VPN 的场景）。自动 advertise 路径保持 RFC 1918/3927-only 不变；逃生舱只在操作员显式点名地址时开启，且超出私有段的选取会在 enable 时打出醒目警告。显式选取还先于"无候选"报错解析，因此一个没有任何自动候选的主机也能通过显式指定完成配对。

## 为什么需要

当主机唯一的非 loopback IPv4 是企业内网的公网段地址时，Local Control 完全不可用：`qwen serve --local-control` 直接以 "No private IPv4 address is available" 退出，而 `--local-control-address` 也帮不上忙——它此前只能在已通过 RFC 1918 过滤的候选里消歧。唯一可用地址在 VPN/隧道接口上的主机同样无路可走。对自动 advertise 保持默认拒绝仍是正确姿态，缺的是一条让操作员明确表达"就要这个"的通道。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

在地址超出 RFC 1918/3927（或位于 VPN/隧道接口）的主机上运行 `qwen serve --local-control --local-control-address <该地址>`。预期：先打印地址超出私有段的 WARNING，然后输出绑定该地址的配对二维码/URL；LAN listener 强制 pairing token（无 token 401，有 token 200）。指定主机没有的地址仍以 `unknown_lan_interface` 失败；指定 loopback 仍然失败。不带该 flag 时行为不变：自动选取保持 RFC 1918/3927-only，多候选仍然报"需要显式选择"。单元测试覆盖完整选取矩阵（公网段、隧道接口、loopback、未知地址、歧义、无候选顺序）。

### 证据（Before & After）

Before（已发布 0.25.1，主机唯一地址在企业内网公网段）：`qwen serve --local-control` 以 exit 1 退出，报 "No private IPv4 address is available"。After（本分支，同主机）：WARNING 之后正常打印二维码与 URL，LAN listener 鉴权边界实测通过（无 token 401 / 有 token 200）。

### 测试平台

macOS ✅；Windows / Linux ⚠️ 未测。

## 风险与范围

- 主要权衡：显式 opt-in 是有意放宽 `--local-control-address` 的接受范围；无 flag 的自动行为完全不变，超出私有段的选取必打警告。接受以"主机真实持有该地址"为前提，通配、组播、笔误依旧拒绝。
- 未覆盖/刻意排除：CGNAT（100.64/10）进默认白名单、Web Shell 设置卡片的 opt-in 入口——均有意延后。
- 破坏性变更：无。

</details>

prs.title: feat(cli): align OpenTUI input, editing and status lines with Ink
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR delivers OpenTUI input, ordinary editing and configurable status lines together. Text, attachments and input provenance stay with their draft through paste, submission, queuing, rejection and cancellation. Editing and external-editor return preserve the current draft, while `/statusline` supports live command output, preset selection, preview and persistence.

It also closes five interaction gaps: completion navigation and shell-mode Up take precedence over attachment selection, without trapping Up on a single completion; Escape remains usable when a displayed queue has no editable input to return; cancelling a turn discards queued generated command work so it cannot replay after an unrelated prompt; session names appear safely within the composer’s top border; and invalid indexed ANSI colors cannot crash status-line rendering.

## Why it's needed

These behaviors share the composer, queues, session lifetime and footer. Reviewing them together validates delayed paste, cancellation, command execution and continued editing as one complete transaction. The implementation reuses existing submission, native editing, cancellation and status-command facilities.

Against the integrated main base, this is **59 files, +8,843/−1,341 = 10,184 changed lines**. The size reflects consolidation of input, editor and status-line delivery, their regression tests and bilingual designs in one review. The complete regression coverage remains with the corresponding behavior.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Paste multiple images with delayed completion, submit, then type a new draft. Images must retain their arrival order and original owner. Rejected submission must restore text, images and provenance once without overwriting later typing. Compare Enter steering with Ctrl+Q deferral, then return queued input for editing; accepted images must retain their contents.
2. With attachments present, navigate a multi-item completion list and use Up in shell mode; neither should select an attachment accidentally. With one completion, ordinary attachment navigation must still work. Press Escape when a queue indicator is present but no editable entry can be returned: the usual Escape behavior must remain available.
3. Edit multiline text, use undo/redo, and return from an external editor. Changed text should be one undoable replacement; unchanged output should add no edit. Late editor or paste completion must not replace a submitted or switched draft. Cancel a held response and verify eligible editable input returns without replacing a successor; preserve the existing Ctrl+C/Ctrl+D approval and exit behavior.
4. Run a command that generates deferred model work. On normal completion it should execute once. Wait until the generated work is queued, cancel the owning turn, then submit an unrelated prompt and let it finish: the cancelled generated work must not run later. Editable queued input must retain its existing recovery behavior.
5. Configure, preview, save and cancel a status line, then restart and resize the terminal. Current session/model/usage data and valid colors should render, invalid indexed colors should be ignored without losing the text, and command failures or stale output should not disrupt editing. Rename and clear a session; its border label should update, remain one line and fit narrow widths, including long CJK text and control characters.
6. Compare deterministic interactions under Node+Ink, Bun+Ink and strict Bun+OpenTUI. Check visible behavior, actual submitted text/images, request counts, settings persistence and child cleanup; renderer fallback or a process exit alone is not acceptance.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Exact candidate `c1f802b0c1d237d9641b8217bdc97e8d37049f51`, tree `3556c6e8c14740ae03e9a8174a67913d4887da9c`, integrates main `13a4fea51683a6baacbde7f5a3330bfab6804827`. Local validation completed 22 accepted stages: fresh build/typecheck/lint/format, 2,994 distinct unit/harness/workflow/script cases, the original stock `/learn` normal/cancel counterexample, native editing/status/dialog checks and the real-host session-title probe. Three exact platform-specific cases remain LOCAL_NOT_RUN.

The fresh bundle passed 23 product cases per leg under Node+Ink, Bun+Ink and strict Bun+OpenTUI: 69 cases and 102 actual HTTP records. The corrected complete WebShell file passed once at both 1280px and 390px, with zero retries or skipped assertions. The prepared package passed the actual npm-tar permission gate for six spawned vendored binaries. Detailed evidence and the original failure/diagnostic boundaries are in https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14964#issuecomment-6324596852.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS arm64 | Above local acceptance PASS; Linux clipboard, Windows path casing and GNU-realpath wipe cases explicitly LOCAL_NOT_RUN |
| Windows | Complete current-head TUI products NOT_RUN |
| Linux | Current-head remote CI pending; older-head evidence is separate |

### Environment

Node 24.19.0, Bun 1.3.14, OpenTUI 0.5.10; owned configuration/workspaces and a deterministic loopback model. Existing installation reused under recorded dependency/tool integrity checks; build and bundle were fresh. Bundle SHA256 `255b7e3603b0bcb85684f6810b42f50f920759f7414c4a83bc735174dd754e8e`, mode0755, actual commit marker `c1f802b0c1`. Full final source/artifact and cleanup guards passed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk: delayed paste, submission claims, cancellation, session reset, editor suspension and status-command cleanup share state. Recovery must preserve newer input, and a reset must not restore old content. Acceptance by a history owner is not proof of HTTP delivery; returning input does not rewind transcript, core or recording history.
- Declared input boundaries: image-only Enter remains a no-op. Image-bearing slash input, including quit-like text, keeps the existing Ink routing contract; this PR does not redefine it as an unconditional exit. Image-bearing shell input is rejected with its draft retained, and a partly failed image-path paste retains the whole original text. Existing renderer-specific media conversion remains unchanged.
- Separate scope: Vim, broader history/search and live JSON output are in [#15067](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15067); runtime/npm distribution is in [#14959](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14959). Session recovery, retry/rewind and recording completion remain in the unsubmitted recovery batch. Voice, IME, accessibility and native OS clipboard/editor coverage are not established by this PR’s isolated fixtures.
- Exit evidence: five strict interrupt cases exit130 while the Ink legs exit0; those are separately reported, not claimed as equivalent exit behavior. Forty-eight HUP129 exits are fixture cleanup, not graceful product exits.
- Migration: no renderer/runtime default switch, Bun/OpenTUI upgrade or Ink removal. This is a consolidated UI delivery, not completion of the entire migration.

Designs: input ownership: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/c1f802b0c1d237d9641b8217bdc97e8d37049f51/docs/design/2026-10-21-opentui-input-ownership.md) / [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/c1f802b0c1d237d9641b8217bdc97e8d37049f51/docs/design/2026-10-21-opentui-input-ownership.zh-CN.md); editing and cancellation: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/c1f802b0c1d237d9641b8217bdc97e8d37049f51/docs/design/2026-10-21-opentui-editor-transaction.md) / [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/c1f802b0c1d237d9641b8217bdc97e8d37049f51/docs/design/2026-10-21-opentui-editor-transaction.zh-CN.md); status lines: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/c1f802b0c1d237d9641b8217bdc97e8d37049f51/docs/design/2026-10-21-opentui-statusline-parity.md) / [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/c1f802b0c1d237d9641b8217bdc97e8d37049f51/docs/design/2026-10-21-opentui-statusline-parity.zh-CN.md); migration delivery: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/c1f802b0c1d237d9641b8217bdc97e8d37049f51/docs/design/2026-10-20-opentui-migration-delivery.md) / [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/c1f802b0c1d237d9641b8217bdc97e8d37049f51/docs/design/2026-10-20-opentui-migration-delivery.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Related to #8662 and #12505. Consolidates the input/editing scope formerly reviewed in #14946 and #14966. The separate delivery references above do not close the broader migration issues.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

本 PR 统一交付 OpenTUI 输入、常规编辑和可配置状态栏。文字、附件与输入来源在粘贴、提交、排队、拒绝和取消期间始终跟随所属草稿。编辑与外部编辑器返回保护当前草稿；`/statusline` 支持实时命令输出、预设选择、预览和持久化。

同时补齐五处交互缺口：补全导航和 shell 模式的 Up 优先于附件选择，但单个补全候选不会吞掉 Up；队列虽有显示却无可取回的可编辑输入时，Escape 仍正常工作；取消响应会丢弃已排队的命令生成内容，避免它在无关提示结束后重放；会话名安全显示在输入框上边框内；非法 ANSI 调色板索引不会使状态栏渲染崩溃。

## 为什么需要

这些行为共用输入框、队列、会话生命周期和底栏。统一审阅能够把延迟粘贴、取消、命令执行和继续编辑作为完整事务验证。实现复用现有提交、原生编辑、取消和状态命令能力。

相对已整合的 main 基线，实际差异为 **59 文件、+8,843/−1,341，共 10,184 改动行**。规模来自输入、编辑器、状态栏交付及其回归测试和双语设计的统一审查。完整回归覆盖随对应行为保留。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 控制多张图片延迟粘贴完成，提交后继续输入新草稿。图片必须保留到达顺序和原始归属。提交被拒绝时，文字、图片和来源应完整恢复一次，不覆盖后续输入。比较 Enter steering 与 Ctrl+Q 延后提交，再取回排队内容继续编辑；已接收图片的内容必须保留。
2. 带附件时导航多项补全列表，并在 shell 模式按 Up；两者都不应意外选中附件。只有一个补全候选时，普通附件导航仍应可用。队列指示存在但无可取回的可编辑条目时按 Escape，原有 Escape 行为仍应生效。
3. 编辑多行文字、执行 undo/redo，并从外部编辑器返回。变更应构成一次可撤销替换，未变文本不增加编辑记录。迟到的编辑器或粘贴结果不得覆盖已提交或已切换的草稿。取消一个未结束的响应，确认符合条件的可编辑输入返还且不覆盖后继草稿；保留原有 Ctrl+C/Ctrl+D 审批与退出行为。
4. 运行会生成延后模型任务的命令。正常完成后，该任务应执行一次。等待生成内容进入队列，取消所属响应，再提交并完成一个无关提示：已取消的生成内容不得随后执行，可编辑队列仍应保留原有恢复行为。
5. 配置、预览、保存和取消状态栏，再重启并调整终端尺寸。当前会话、模型、用量和合法颜色应正常显示；非法调色板索引应被忽略且文字保留，命令失败或迟到输出不得干扰编辑。重命名并清除会话名，边框标签应同步更新、保持单行并适应窄宽度，包括长 CJK 文字及控制字符。
6. 在 Node+Ink、Bun+Ink、strict Bun+OpenTUI 下对照相同确定性交互。核对可见行为、实际提交的文字与图片、请求次数、设置持久化和子进程清理；renderer 回退或仅进程退出不算验收。

### 前后证据

精确候选 `c1f802b0c1d237d9641b8217bdc97e8d37049f51`，tree `3556c6e8c14740ae03e9a8174a67913d4887da9c`，整合 main `13a4fea51683a6baacbde7f5a3330bfab6804827`。本机完成 22 个接受阶段：新 build/typecheck/lint/format，2,994 个不重复的 unit/harness/workflow/script 用例，原真实 `/learn` 正常/取消反例，原生编辑、状态栏、对话框，以及真实 host 会话标题复验。三个精确平台用例仍为 LOCAL_NOT_RUN。

新 bundle 在 Node+Ink、Bun+Ink、strict Bun+OpenTUI 下各通过 23 个产品场景，共 69 个、102 条实际 HTTP 记录。修正后的完整 WebShell 文件在 1280px 和 390px 各单次通过，没有重试或跳过断言。prepared 包通过真实 npm tar 中六个随包二进制的执行权限门槛。详细证据及原始失败/诊断边界见 https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14964#issuecomment-6324596852。

### 已测平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS arm64 | 上述本机验收通过；Linux 剪贴板、Windows 路径大小写及 GNU-realpath wipe 用例明确 LOCAL_NOT_RUN |
| Windows | 当前 head 的完整 TUI 产品验收未运行 |
| Linux | 当前 head 远端 CI 待运行，旧 head 证据单列 |

### 环境

Node 24.19.0、Bun 1.3.14、OpenTUI 0.5.10；隔离配置/工作区与确定性 loopback 模型。按已记录的依赖/工具完整性检查复用安装，构建和 bundle 为本候选新产物。Bundle SHA256 `255b7e3603b0bcb85684f6810b42f50f920759f7414c4a83bc735174dd754e8e`，mode0755，实际提交标识 `c1f802b0c1`。最终源码、产物与清理守卫通过。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：延迟粘贴、提交认领、取消、会话重置、编辑器暂停和状态命令清理共用状态。恢复必须保护较新的输入，重置不得返还旧内容。历史所有者接收不等于 HTTP 已送达；返还输入不代表回滚 transcript、core 或录制历史。
- 明确的输入边界：仅图片 Enter 保持 no-op。带图片的斜杠输入（包括看似退出命令的文字）保留现有 Ink 路由合同，本 PR 不将其改成无条件退出。带图片的 shell 输入会被拒绝且保留草稿；图片路径粘贴有部分失败时保留整段原文。各 renderer 既有媒体转换保持不变。
- 独立范围：Vim、更完整的历史/搜索和实时 JSON 输出属于 [#15067](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15067)；运行时/npm 分发属于 [#14959](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14959)。会话恢复、重试/回退和录制补齐仍在尚未提交 PR 的恢复批次。本 PR 的隔离夹具不代表语音、IME、无障碍或原生系统剪贴板/编辑器已验收。
- 退出边界：五个 strict 中断场景退出130，Ink 对应场景退出0，分开披露，不宣称退出行为等价；48 个 HUP129 属于夹具清理，不代表优雅产品退出。
- 迁移说明：不切换 renderer/runtime 默认值，不升级 Bun/OpenTUI，不删除 Ink。这是一次统一 UI 交付，不代表整个迁移完成。

设计：输入归属: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/c1f802b0c1d237d9641b8217bdc97e8d37049f51/docs/design/2026-10-21-opentui-input-ownership.md) / [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/c1f802b0c1d237d9641b8217bdc97e8d37049f51/docs/design/2026-10-21-opentui-input-ownership.zh-CN.md); 编辑与取消: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/c1f802b0c1d237d9641b8217bdc97e8d37049f51/docs/design/2026-10-21-opentui-editor-transaction.md) / [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/c1f802b0c1d237d9641b8217bdc97e8d37049f51/docs/design/2026-10-21-opentui-editor-transaction.zh-CN.md); 状态栏: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/c1f802b0c1d237d9641b8217bdc97e8d37049f51/docs/design/2026-10-21-opentui-statusline-parity.md) / [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/c1f802b0c1d237d9641b8217bdc97e8d37049f51/docs/design/2026-10-21-opentui-statusline-parity.zh-CN.md); 迁移交付: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/c1f802b0c1d237d9641b8217bdc97e8d37049f51/docs/design/2026-10-20-opentui-migration-delivery.md) / [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/c1f802b0c1d237d9641b8217bdc97e8d37049f51/docs/design/2026-10-20-opentui-migration-delivery.zh-CN.md).

## 关联问题

关联 #8662 和 #12505；归并此前在 #14946 和 #14966 审阅的输入/编辑范围。上述独立交付引用不关闭更广泛的迁移问题。

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): defensive resume cached reset, telemetry mirror clear, and test pins
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Follow-up to #12066. This is a defensive reset plus test pins, not a user-visible staleness fix. When resume seeds the prompt and output counts, it now also clears the process-global telemetry mirror of the cached-content count, and keeps a defensive reset of the per-chat cached slot. Tests pin both clears after a real usage report (finite and non-finite seed inputs), and a `/context` case pins the fallback to the global cached count when no session chat exists yet.

## Why it's needed

The other review items from #12066 are already on `main`; this PR carries the remaining delta. `seedResumeTokenCounts` always runs on a freshly started chat, so the per-chat cached slot is already `0` at that point: the per-chat reset is an invariant guard, and `/context` output is unchanged between BASE and HEAD for that field (confirmed by the maintainer's real-TUI A/B run). The value that does go stale on an in-process `/resume` is the global telemetry mirror: it kept the previous session's cached count next to the newly seeded prompt count (for example prompt 12000 from session B with cached 64653 from session A). Every other writer of the per-chat cached slot already clears that mirror, and this brings the resume seed in line. The only reader of the mirror today is the no-chat fallback in `/context`, which had no test for a nonzero global value either.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/core/llm-chat.test.ts`: 530/530 pass. The resume case records a usage report with `cachedContentTokenCount: 64_653`, calls `seedResumeTokenCounts` with non-finite and then finite inputs, and after each call expects the per-chat cached slot to be `0` and `uiTelemetryService.setLastCachedContentTokenCount` to have last been called with `0`. With the new telemetry line removed, this case fails (`expected last "spy" call to have been called with [ +0 ]`).
2. `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/ui/commands/contextCommand.test.ts`: 49/49 pass. The no-chat case expects the displayed cached figure to be the global `1_000` when the chat is not initialized (this pins existing behavior).
3. `cd packages/core && npm run typecheck` and `npx eslint src/core/llm-chat.ts src/core/llm-chat.test.ts`: both clean.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for the TUI: `/context` output is the same on BASE and HEAD. The observable difference is the global telemetry mirror after an in-process resume: before, it holds the previous session's cached count; after, it reads `0` until the next API usage report.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ |

### Environment (optional)

N/A (unit tests only).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: after resume, the global cached mirror reads `0` until the next API usage report instead of a value from a different session. The per-chat slot behaves as before.
- Not validated / out of scope: restoring the cached figure on resume (the transcript records `cachedContentTokenCount`, but `ResumeTokenCounts` does not carry it); the daemon deferred-session path.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #12066. Relates to #12047.

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

#12066 的后续。本 PR 是防御性清零加测试固定行为，不是用户可见的残留值修复。resume 恢复 prompt 与 output 计数时，同时清空进程级 telemetry 镜像中的缓存计数，并保留对 per-chat 缓存槽的防御性清零。测试在真实 usage 上报之后（分别用有限值和非有限值调用 seed）固定这两处清零；另有一条 `/context` 用例固定「尚无会话 chat 时回退到全局缓存计数」的行为。

## 为什么需要

#12066 的其它评审项已经在 `main` 上，本 PR 只包含剩余增量。`seedResumeTokenCounts` 总是在新建的 chat 上执行，此时 per-chat 缓存槽本来就是 `0`，所以这一清零只是不变式保护，BASE 与 HEAD 的 `/context` 输出在这一项上完全相同（维护者的真实 TUI A/B 测试已确认）。同一进程内 `/resume` 时真正残留旧值的是全局 telemetry 镜像：它把上一个会话的缓存数和新恢复的 prompt 数放在一起（例如会话 B 的 prompt 12000 配上会话 A 的 cached 64653）。其它写 per-chat 缓存槽的地方都会同时清空镜像，本 PR 让 resume 的 seed 保持一致。镜像目前唯一的读取方是 `/context` 的无 chat 回退路径，此前也没有针对全局值非零的测试。

prs.title: feat(cli): align OpenTUI Vim, history and live output with Ink
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds OpenTUI Vim editing, ordinary/shell history and reverse search, and live JSON output for accepted input. The existing Ink editor remains the sole text, code-point cursor and undo owner; native rendering, selection and mouse input use that state. Streaming updates preserve search selection, recalled drafts retain correct provenance, and cancelled turns cannot finalize a successor’s output.

This single Draft integrates the merged UI baseline #14964 through main `0ac1fcca`. Current source is `b480c2f6898bdceb68f28872c4983652a4136dd4`: 40 files, +6,622/-758 (7,380 changed lines).

## Why it's needed

Editing, recall, admission and output share one input transaction. Keeping them together avoids competing text/undo owners and incomplete cancellation boundaries. This coherent batch exceeds the usual 2–3k target to retain its necessary regression coverage and bilingual designs; it is not split into smaller related PRs. The shared parser corrections also align Ink batched Vim commands with its paced-key behavior.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Compare paced and single-write Vim commands, Unicode next edits, undo/redo, hot toggles, external editing and native keyboard/mouse selection. Cancelling a pending command must retain the draft, including two Escapes within one second; a fresh bare NORMAL Escape retains global clear/cancel behavior.
2. Recall ordinary/shell history and select a later search result during streaming. Same-text recall must discard stale expanded provenance; cancelling search restores the draft and paste/source snapshot. Null recall preserves the draft; empty recall follows its distinct source policy.
3. Exercise queued input, attachments, cancellation and session reset with a successor draft. Accepted input submits once; late callbacks cannot change the successor or replay abandoned generated input.
4. Compare visible output, HTTP requests and closed JSONL across text/thought, tools, allow/deny, cancellation and active-stream exit. Require ordered, nonduplicated records and permission IDs. Only accepted steering emits a user record. Both Ink deny references retain `EXPECTED_INK_GAP` (one request, zero responses); OpenTUI emits one denied response. Steering also repairs an Ink mirror omission, so these are explicit differences.

### Evidence (Before & After)

**Before:** [Original native failure](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15067#issuecomment-6318096461) and [earlier source checkpoint](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15067#issuecomment-6317829644) preserve the failures. Source fixes and fixture corrections remain distinguished.

**Current b480:** Full build and typecheck passed, followed by all 42 selected whole files: 4,291 passed rows, zero failed/todo rows, and one declared Linux-only case LOCAL_NOT_RUN on Darwin. These are executed rows rather than unique titles: the owners/output group has 878 passed rows / 877 distinct titles, and the hosted group has 730 passed rows / 728 distinct titles. All three pre-existing collisions have been mapped to source parameters or separate registrations; the two hosted files are byte-identical to integrated main. Original uniqueness-check failures remain recorded, with no rerun or test changes. Native checks, a fresh bundle, all three 36-case product legs and packaging are **NOT_RUN / not yet accepted for this head**. Main-target CI is pending after this update.

[Historical local artifact validation](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15067#issuecomment-6328151544) and [historical exact-source CI audit](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15067#issuecomment-6328761204) remain separate evidence. Their three-runtime result is **106 functional passes plus two Ink deny-gap characterizations**, not 108 completed features; the 194b artifact is not a b480 artifact.

### Tested on

| OS | Current b480 status |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | Build/typecheck and all 42 whole files above completed; native/artifact/product gates incomplete |
| 🪟 Windows | NOT_RUN for this head |
| 🐧 Linux | NOT_RUN for this head; historical CI linked separately |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64; pinned Node 24.19.0, Bun 1.3.14 and OpenTUI 0.5.10. Product comparisons use an isolated local model service with real CLI/HTTP/PTY paths. Current build evidence does not substitute for a fresh product artifact or installed-package acceptance.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk: shared parser behavior, Unicode cursor/view projection, provenance and output finalization. Component tests alone cannot establish native or product parity.
- Remaining acceptance: the gates above, actual installed JSON-file/steering with #14959, and real middleware. Ordinary/shell history is partial coverage; persistent records, purge, restore/retry/rewind belong to batch C. Voice, device IME, accessibility and full transcript/Markdown parity remain explicit migration obligations.
- Migration: no renderer-default switch, dependency upgrade, new core protocol or Ink removal. This remains Draft pending current-head evidence.

Designs: [Vim/history EN](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/opentui-interaction-output/docs/design/2026-10-21-opentui-vim-history.md), [Vim/history ZH](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/opentui-interaction-output/docs/design/2026-10-21-opentui-vim-history.zh-CN.md), [live-output EN](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/opentui-interaction-output/docs/design/2026-10-21-opentui-dual-output.md), [live-output ZH](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/opentui-interaction-output/docs/design/2026-10-21-opentui-dual-output.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

UI dependency #14964 is merged. Distribution integration remains in #14959; session recovery is the separate, unpublished C batch. This PR closes neither scope.

### 如何验证

4. 对比 text/thought、工具、允许/拒绝、取消及活跃流退出时的可见输出、HTTP 请求和关闭后的 JSONL。记录须有序、不重复且 permission ID 正确；只有已接受 steering 发出 user 记录。两种 Ink deny 参考保留 `EXPECTED_INK_GAP`（一次 request、零次 response）；OpenTUI 发一次拒绝 response。Steering 也修正 Ink 镜像遗漏，因此明确记录这两项差异。

[历史本地产物验证](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15067#issuecomment-6328151544)与[历史精确源码 CI 审计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15067#issuecomment-6328761204)独立保留。其三 runtime 结果是 **106 个功能通过加两个 Ink deny 缺口刻画**，不是 108 项功能完成；194b 产物不是 b480 产物。

prs.title: fix(web-shell): reset follow pause when the session changes (#15038)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A reading pause now ends when the displayed session changes. The reconnect-completion effect added for #15009 keeps the pause across a replay in the same session; this change makes sure the pause does not follow the reader into a different session, where the new transcript would otherwise stay above the latest content.

## Why it's needed

The pause is stored in a ref that outlives the transcript. Before this change, switching sessions while scrolled up left the new session stranded mid-history: nothing had paused its follow behavior, but the old session's flag was still set. Resetting the flag in the existing session-scoped reset keeps the intended reconnect behavior and restores follow for the new session.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open a web-shell session long enough to scroll.
2. Scroll up to pause following.
3. Switch to another session and let its transcript replay.
4. Confirm the new session lands at the bottom and keeps following new messages.
5. Reconnect the same session (for example, reload while streaming) and confirm the reading pause is still preserved, matching #15009.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: switching sessions while paused left the new transcript at the old scroll position (`expected 600 to be 300` in the new DOM test). After: the new transcript lands at the bottom, and the same-session reconnect pause test still passes.

### Tested on

|     OS     |    Status     |
| :--------: | :-----------: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  |     ✅        |

### Environment (optional)

Local unit/DOM tests and the full web-shell Vitest suite; no browser E2E run (Playwright browsers are not installed in this environment).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the pause is dropped on any session-key change, which is the desired boundary; same-session reconnects are unchanged.
- Not validated / out of scope: the exact failed CI job's log was unavailable; the local equivalent suite is green, and the new test covers the regression found in the changed code.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15038

当显示会话发生变化时，阅读暂停现在会结束。#15009 新增的“追赶完成”效果会在同一会话的回放期间保留暂停；本次修改确保暂停不会跟随读者进入另一个会话，否则新会话的记录会停留在最新内容上方。

## 为什么需要

暂停状态保存在一个比记录本身存活更久的 ref 中。修改前，在向上滚动时切换会话会让新会话停留在历史中间：并没有任何操作暂停了新会话的跟随行为，但旧会话的标志仍然存在。在现有的会话级重置中清除该标志，可以保留预期的重连行为，并恢复新会话的跟随。

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): manage MCP servers without recreating sessions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Let an authorized user add, change, remove, enable, disable, reload and restart published MCP servers in an existing Managed Session while continuing to use its ordinary files and Shell tools. The WebShell manager reuses the daemon's server cards and metadata views, with Managed commands operating on the selected Session's original Runtime owner.

Each explicit change records a Session-local MCP settings revision. The original AgentDefinition revision, Skills and approval policy stay pinned. Add and edit select an exact revision and digest from the Runtime's private published inventory; executable recipes and credentials never enter the public API or browser storage. Unknown effects retain their original operation identity and require confirmation before another change.

## Why it's needed

Managed currently exposes a saved MCP catalog but cannot change a Session's server selection or reconnect a server through the public interface. Using daemon commands would target a different execution environment. This provides the missing management path without replacing the Session or its conversation.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open an ordinary local Managed Session with Workspace execution permission. Before sending its first message, open Manage MCP and add a published server. Confirm that the same Session subsequently exposes files, Shell and that server's tools.
2. Exercise change-definition, disable, enable, reload, restart and remove. Confirm that disabled or removed tools disappear from later model requests, restarting one server leaves the other connection and worker running, and conversation identity stays unchanged.
3. Continue using ordinary tools, backups and rewind. Restart the Harness and confirm that settings survive normal Session continuation. A management query alone must refuse cold recovery rather than start a model request or pay resource-cleanup debt.
4. Confirm stale revisions, an unauthorized actor, Plan mode, unsupported profiles and active work cannot mutate settings. Retrying an unconfirmed command must query and resume the same original operation; switching Session or provider must discard late results.
5. Inspect tool schemas, resource metadata and prompt metadata at desktop and mobile widths. Check that the existing daemon manager still uses its own execution environment.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: Managed's catalog is read-only. A global `qwen` 0.25.2 Hosted capability and route probe confirms that the new management surface is absent.

After: local validation uses the built CLI, actual Java control plane and Broker, disposable MySQL, real stdio MCP processes and a controlled model. The separate E2E comment records operation, browser, persistence, recovery and cleanup results, with fixture evidence distinguished from platform acceptance.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | Local process stack, MySQL and Chromium; detailed results in the E2E comment |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Runtime/cgroup acceptance not tested locally |

### Environment

Node 22, JDK 21, MySQL 8.4 and Chromium at 1280px and 390px, using isolated test resources. Existing preview services are untouched.

## Risk & Scope

- This crosses the Session journal, Java/SDK, Broker, Runtime and WebShell boundaries; deploy matching artifacts and enable the exact supported lifecycle profile and capability together.
- Management reattachment reads an already resident Session without implicitly recovering execution. After a Harness restart, continue or recover the Session through its normal execution flow before managing MCP. A fresh empty Session can initialize through management without submitting a Turn.
- This supports ordinary local `shell/1` and the existing MCP profile. Private recipe publication, resource bodies, prompt expansion, OAuth authoring, SSH, CSI, newer Workspace profiles, real upstream models and the complete cross-platform fault matrix are outside this change or unqualified locally.
- Existing logs without management settings keep their admission pins. Session settings use an already registered journal domain; no definition rewrite or schema migration is introduced. Plan stays unavailable after MCP management history, including after removing every server.

Designs: [ordinary tools and MCP (English)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/1ce997a561c540b0623a224725b2c7e4537552cf/docs/design/2026-10-21-managed-mcp-management-reuse.md), [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/1ce997a561c540b0623a224725b2c7e4537552cf/docs/design/2026-10-21-managed-mcp-management-reuse.zh-CN.md); [Session management (English)](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/1ce997a561c540b0623a224725b2c7e4537552cf/docs/design/2026-10-22-managed-session-mcp-management.md), [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/1ce997a561c540b0623a224725b2c7e4537552cf/docs/design/2026-10-22-managed-session-mcp-management.zh-CN.md). Both language pairs are synchronized.

## Linked Issues

Closes #15079

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 做了什么

允许有权限的用户在现有 Managed 会话中添加、更换、移除、启用、禁用、重新加载和重启已发布的 MCP 服务，同时继续使用普通文件和 Shell 工具。WebShell 管理页面复用 daemon 的服务卡片与元数据视图，Managed 命令作用于所选会话的原 Runtime owner。

每次显式修改都会记录独立的会话 MCP 设置修订。原 AgentDefinition 修订、Skills 和审批策略保持固定。新增和编辑从 Runtime 的私有已发布清单中选择精确修订与摘要；可执行 recipe 和凭据不会进入公开 API 或浏览器存储。效果不确定时保留原操作身份，确认前不能开始另一项修改。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

| 🍏 macOS | 本地进程栈、MySQL 和 Chromium，详细结果见 E2E 评论 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未进行本地测试 |

Node 22、JDK 21、MySQL 8.4，以及 1280px 和 390px Chromium，均使用隔离测试资源。现有预览服务未改动。

## 风险与范围

- 变更横跨会话日志、Java/SDK、Broker、Runtime 和 WebShell；需要一起部署兼容产物，并启用精确支持的生命周期 profile 和能力。
